/* ----- 32-bit helpers via hex strings ----- */
num2hex: procedure
   parse arg n
   n = n + 0
   n = n // 4294967296
   h = ''
   do i = 1 to 8
      h = substr('0123456789ABCDEF', n // 16 + 1, 1) || h
      n = n % 16
   end
   return h

hex2num: procedure
   parse arg h
   n = 0
   do i = 1 to length(h)
      c = substr(h,i,1)
      select
         when c='0' then d=0
         when c='1' then d=1
         when c='2' then d=2
         when c='3' then d=3
         when c='4' then d=4
         when c='5' then d=5
         when c='6' then d=6
         when c='7' then d=7
         when c='8' then d=8
         when c='9' then d=9
         when c='A' then d=10
         when c='B' then d=11
         when c='C' then d=12
         when c='D' then d=13
         when c='E' then d=14
         when c='F' then d=15
      end
      n = n * 16 + d
   end
   return n

/* 32-bit operations are arithmetic so they work in any REXX. */
and32: procedure
   parse arg a,b
   a = a // 4294967296
   b = b // 4294967296
   r = 0
   p = 1
   do i = 1 to 32
      ab = a // 2
      bb = b // 2
      if ab = 1 & bb = 1 then r = r + p
      a = a % 2
      b = b % 2
      p = p * 2
   end
   return r

or32: procedure
   parse arg a,b
   a = a // 4294967296
   b = b // 4294967296
   r = 0
   p = 1
   do i = 1 to 32
      ab = a // 2
      bb = b // 2
      if ab = 1 | bb = 1 then r = r + p
      a = a % 2
      b = b % 2
      p = p * 2
   end
   return r

xor32: procedure
   parse arg a,b
   a = a // 4294967296
   b = b // 4294967296
   r = 0
   p = 1
   do i = 1 to 32
      ab = a // 2
      bb = b // 2
      if ab \= bb then r = r + p
      a = a % 2
      b = b % 2
      p = p * 2
   end
   return r

not32: procedure
   parse arg a
   a = a // 4294967296
   r = 0
   p = 1
   do i = 1 to 32
      ab = a // 2
      if ab = 0 then r = r + p
      a = a % 2
      p = p * 2
   end
   return r

rol32: procedure
   parse arg val,n
   val = val // 4294967296
   if n = 0 then return val
   leftpart = (val // (2**(32-n))) * (2**n)
   rightpart = val % (2**(32-n))
   return (leftpart + rightpart) // 4294967296

/* ----- SHA-1 (FIPS 180-1) ----- */
h0 = 0
h1 = 0
h2 = 0
h3 = 0
h4 = 0
sha_init:
   h0 = 1732584193; h1 = 4023233417; h2 = 2562383102
   h3 = 271733878; h4 = 3285377520
   return

sha_block: procedure expose h0 h1 h2 h3 h4
   parse arg block
   do i = 0 to 15
      w.i = 0
      do j = 0 to 3
         w.i = w.i * 256 + c2d(substr(block, i*4+j+1,1))
      end
   end
   do i = 16 to 79
      i3 = i - 3; i8 = i - 8; i14 = i - 14; i16 = i - 16
      w.i = rol32(xor32(xor32(w.i3, w.i8), xor32(w.i14, w.i16)), 1)
   end
   a = h0; b = h1; c = h2; d = h3; e = h4
   do i = 0 to 79
      if i < 20 then do
         f = or32(and32(b,c), and32(not32(b), d))
         k = 1518500249
      end
      else if i < 40 then do
         f = xor32(xor32(b,c), d)
         k = 1859775393
      end
      else if i < 60 then do
         f = or32(or32(and32(b,c), and32(b,d)), and32(c,d))
         k = 2400959708
      end
      else do
         f = xor32(xor32(b,c), d)
         k = 3395469782
      end
      temp = (rol32(a,5) + f + e + k + w.i) // 4294967296
      e = d; d = c; c = rol32(b,30); b = a; a = temp
   end
   h0 = (h0 + a) // 4294967296
   h1 = (h1 + b) // 4294967296
   h2 = (h2 + c) // 4294967296
   h3 = (h3 + d) // 4294967296
   h4 = (h4 + e) // 4294967296
   return

sha1_bin: procedure expose h0 h1 h2 h3 h4
   parse arg data
   call sha_init
   len = length(data)
   do pos = 1 to len - 63 by 64
      call sha_block(substr(data,pos,64))
   end
   rem = len - (pos - 1)
   tail = ''
   do i = 1 to rem
      tail = tail || substr(data, pos + i - 1, 1)
   end
   tail = tail || '80'x
   do while (length(tail) // 64) \= 56
      tail = tail || '00'x
   end
   bitlen = len * 8
   tail = tail || '00000000'x||x2c(num2hex(bitlen))
   do pos = 1 to length(tail) by 64
      call sha_block(substr(tail,pos,64))
   end
   digest = num2hex(h0) || num2hex(h1) || num2hex(h2)
   digest = digest || num2hex(h3) || num2hex(h4)
   bin = ''
   do i = 1 to 40 by 2
      bin = bin || x2c(substr(digest,i,2))
   end
   return bin

/* ----- Adler-32 ----- */
adler32_num: procedure
   parse arg data
   a = 1; b = 0
   do i = 1 to length(data)
      a = (a + c2d(substr(data,i,1))) // 65521
      b = (b + a) // 65521
   end
   return b * 65536 + a

/* ----- DEFLATE stored blocks ----- */
deflate_stored: procedure
   parse arg in
   inlen = length(in)
   out = ''
   ip = 1
   do while ip <= inlen
      blocklen = inlen - ip + 1
      if blocklen > 65535 then blocklen = 65535
      final = (ip + blocklen - 1 = inlen)
      if final then out = out || '01'x
      else out = out || '00'x
      len_low = blocklen // 256
      len_high = blocklen % 256
      nlen_low = 255 - len_low
      nlen_high = 255 - len_high
      out = out || x2c(right(num2hex(len_low),2,'0'))
      out = out || x2c(right(num2hex(len_high),2,'0'))
      out = out || x2c(right(num2hex(nlen_low),2,'0'))
      out = out || x2c(right(num2hex(nlen_high),2,'0'))
      out = out || substr(in, ip, blocklen)
      ip = ip + blocklen
   end
   return out

/* ----- zlib wrapper ----- */
zlib_wrap: procedure
   parse arg deflate, plain
   dlen = length(deflate)
   ad = adler32_num(plain)
   ad_hex = num2hex(ad)
   out = '7801'x || deflate
   do i = 1 to 4
      out = out || x2c(substr(ad_hex, (i-1)*2+1, 2))
   end
   return out

/* ----- Pack object header ----- */
pack_header: procedure
   parse arg typ,size
   out = ''
   firstbyte = typ * 16 + (size // 16)
   cont = (size > 15)
   if cont then firstbyte = firstbyte + 128
   out = out || x2c(right(num2hex(firstbyte),2,'0'))
   size = size % 16
   do while cont
      byteval = size // 128
      size = size % 128
      cont = (size > 0)
      if cont then byteval = byteval + 128
      out = out || x2c(right(num2hex(byteval),2,'0'))
   end
   return out
files.GITPNWLK.EXEC:
/* M13X opt-in native PACK walker; REXX default. */
parse upper arg command extra mode trailing limitarg
if command \= 'WALK' then exit 4
/* Optional fifth argument: bounded diagnostic prefix, never full proof. */
if limitarg\='' & (datatype(limitarg,'W')\=1 | limitarg<1) then exit 4
if trailing \= '' & trailing \= 'STRICT' then exit 4
/* Explicit NATIVE mode only; existing WALK and WALK QUIET stay REXX. */
if extra = 'NATIVE' & mode = '' then do
 mode = 'NATIVE'
 extra = ''
end
if extra \= '' & extra \= 'QUIET' then exit 4
if mode \= '' & mode \= 'NATIVE' then exit 4
strict=(trailing='STRICT')
quiet=(extra='QUIET')
address command
if mode = 'NATIVE' then do
 'STATE GITNDRV MODULE A'
 if rc \= 0 then do
  say 'GITP9PWK: native driver missing'
  exit 12
 end
end
call readhex 0,12
if result='ERROR' then do
 say 'GITPNWLK: no readable finalized PACK in GITPBUF'
 exit 8
end
hdr=result
if substr(hdr,1,8)\='5041434B' then do
 say 'GITPNWLK: GITPBUF does not contain a PACK header'
 exit 8
end
version=x2d(substr(hdr,9,8)); objects=x2d(substr(hdr,17,8))
if version\=2 then do
 say 'GITPNWLK: unsupported PACK version' version
 exit 8
end
 if strict then do
  verifyrc = verifysha()
  if verifyrc \= 0 then do
   say 'GITPNWLK: PACK integrity verification failed'
   exit 8
  end
 drop sm.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR GITPMETA PACK A 1 (STEM SM. FINIS'
 if rc \= 0 | sm.0 \= 1 then exit 8
 parse var sm.1 smtag smsize smtail smfinal smextra
 if smtag \= 'META' | datatype(smsize,'W') \= 1 then exit 8
 expectedend=smsize-20
end
walkcount=objects
if limitarg\='' then do
 if limitarg>objects then exit 4
 walkcount=limitarg
end
pos=12
'EXEC GIT9CTX INIT'
if rc\=0 then exit rc
do entry=1 to walkcount
 if quiet & (entry=1 | entry//5=0) then say 'PACK WALK' entry 'OF' objects
 entrypos=pos
 call readbyte pos
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 b=result; pos=pos+1
 type=(b%16)//8
 size=b//16; shift=4; more=b>=128
 do while more
  call readbyte pos
  if result='ERROR' then exit 8
  b=result; pos=pos+1
  size=size+(b//128)*(2**shift)
  shift=shift+7; more=b>=128
 end
 if quiet then do
  if type=1 then qtype='COMMIT'
  else if type=2 then qtype='TREE'
  else if type=3 then qtype='BLOB'
  else if type=4 then qtype='TAG'
  else if type=6 then qtype='OFS'
  else if type=7 then qtype='REF'
  else qtype='UNKNOWN'
  say 'PACK ENTRY START' entry 'POS' entrypos 'TYPE' qtype
 end
 if type>=1 & type<=4 then do
  if type=1 then otype='COMMIT'
  else if type=2 then otype='TREE'
  else if type=3 then otype='BLOB'
  else otype='TAG'
   if quiet then say 'PACK STAGE INFLATE START' entry
  if mode = 'NATIVE' then 'EXEC GITPZNAT TOOBUF' pos 'NATIVE'
  else 'EXEC GITPZBUF TOOBUF' pos
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull used
  parse pull outlen
   if quiet then say 'PACK STAGE INFLATE DONE' entry 'BYTES' outlen
  if outlen\=size then exit 8
   if quiet then say 'PACK STAGE OID START' entry
  'EXEC GITBOID' otype outlen
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull oid
   if quiet then say 'PACK STAGE OID DONE' entry
   if quiet then say 'PACK STAGE SAVE START' entry
  'EXEC GIT9CTX SAVE' entrypos oid outlen otype
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
   if quiet then say 'PACK STAGE SAVE DONE' entry
  if \quiet then do
   say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE' otype 'SIZE' size
   say 'OBJECT OID' oid
  end
  /* SAVE once; context includes the resolved object type. */
  pos=pos+used
 end
 else if type=7 then do
  call readhex pos,20
  if result='ERROR' then exit 8
  wantoid=result
  pos=pos+20
  'EXEC GIT9CTX LOADOID' wantoid
  if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GITP9PWK: REF base not available'
   exit 8
  end
  parse pull basepos
  parse pull baseoid
  parse pull basesize
  parse pull otype
  if mode = 'NATIVE' then 'EXEC GITPZNAT TOOBUF' pos 'NATIVE'
  else 'EXEC GITPZBUF TOOBUF' pos
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull used
  parse pull dlen
  if dlen\=size then exit 8
  'EXEC GITBDAPP APPLY'
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull outlen
  call installout outlen
  if result\='OK' then exit 8
  'EXEC GITBOID' otype outlen
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull oid
  if \quiet then do
   say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE REF SIZE' size
   say 'BASE OID' wantoid
   say 'OBJECT BYTES' outlen
   say 'OBJECT OID' oid
  end
  'EXEC GIT9CTX SAVE' entrypos oid outlen otype
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  pos=pos+used
 end
 else if type=6 then do
  c=0
  do forever
   call readbyte pos
   if result='ERROR' then exit 8
   b=result; pos=pos+1
   if c=0 then dist=b//128
   else dist=((dist+1)*128)+(b//128)
   c=c+1
   if b<128 then leave
  end
  want=entrypos-dist
  'EXEC GIT9CTX LOADPOS' want
  if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GITP9PWK: OFS base not available'
   exit 8
  end
  parse pull basepos
  parse pull baseoid
  parse pull basesize
  parse pull otype
  if mode = 'NATIVE' then 'EXEC GITPZNAT TOOBUF' pos 'NATIVE'
  else 'EXEC GITPZBUF TOOBUF' pos
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull used
  parse pull dlen
  /* PACK size on a delta entry is delta-program size. */
  if dlen\=size then do
   say 'GITP9PWK: inflated delta size mismatch'
   exit 8
  end
  'EXEC GITBDAPP APPLY'
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull outlen
  call installout outlen
  if result\='OK' then exit 8
  'EXEC GITBOID' otype outlen
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull oid
  if \quiet then do
   say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE OFS SIZE' size
   say 'BASE POSITION' want
   say 'OBJECT BYTES' outlen
   say 'OBJECT OID' oid
  end
  'EXEC GIT9CTX SAVE' entrypos oid outlen otype
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  pos=pos+used
 end
 else exit 8
 if quiet then say 'PACK ENTRY DONE' entry 'NEXT' pos
end
if strict & walkcount=objects & pos \= expectedend then do
 say 'GITPNWLK: object boundary/trailer mismatch' pos expectedend
 exit 8
end
if walkcount<objects then say 'PACK PREFIX ONLY' walkcount 'OF' objects
say 'PACK VERSION' version
say 'PACK OBJECTS' objects
say 'PACK DATA END' pos
exit 0
savebase:
 parse arg n
 'ERASE GITBASE DATA A'
 off=0
 do while off<n
  take=n-off
  if take>64 then take=64
  'EXEC GITOBUF READSTACK' off take
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  parse pull h
  r.1=h; r.0=1
  'EXECIO 1 DISKW GITBASE DATA A 0 (STEM R. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  off=off+take
 end
 m.1='META' n '- 1'; m.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW GITBMETA DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'
installout:
 parse arg n
 'EXEC GITOBUF INIT'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 copied=0
 recno=1
 do while copied<n
  drop r.
  'EXECIO 1 DISKR GITOUT DATA A' recno '(STEM R. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 | r.0\=1 then return 'ERROR'
  h=strip(r.1)
  if h='' | length(h)//2\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  bytes=length(h)%2
  if copied+bytes>n then return 'ERROR'
  'EXEC GITOBUF APPEND' h
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  copied=copied+bytes
  recno=recno+1
 end
 'EXEC GITOBUF FINAL'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'
readbyte:
 parse arg off
 call readhex off,1
 if result='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
 return x2d(result)
readhex:
 parse arg off,n
 'EXEC GITPBUF READSTACK' off n
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 parse pull h
 if length(h)\=n*2 then return 'ERROR'
 return translate(h)

verifysha: procedure
 address command
 drop m.
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR GITPMETA PACK A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc \= 0 | m.0 \= 1 then do
  say 'GITPSHA: pack metadata not found'
  return 8
 end
 parse var m.1 tag size tail final junk
 if tag \= 'META' | junk \= '' | datatype(size,'W') \= 1 then do
  say 'GITPSHA: corrupt pack metadata'
  return 8
 end
 if size < 20 | final \= 1 | tail \= '-' then do
  say 'GITPSHA: finalized pack with trailer required'
  return 8
 end
 payload = size - 20
 'MAKEBUF'
 queue right(d2x(payload),8,'0')
 offset = 0
 do while offset < payload
  count = payload - offset
  if count > 64 then count = 64
  'EXEC GITPBUF READSTACK' offset count
  if rc \= 0 then do
   save = rc
   'DROPBUF'
   return save
  end
  offset = offset + count
 end
 'GITSTRM'
 if rc \= 0 then do
  save = rc
  'DROPBUF'
  return save
 end
 pull digest
 'DROPBUF'
 'MAKEBUF'
 'EXEC GITPBUF READSTACK' payload 20
 if rc \= 0 then do
  save = rc
  'DROPBUF'
  return save
 end
 if queued() < 1 then do
  'DROPBUF'
  say 'GITPSHA: pack trailer missing'
  return 8
 end
 pull trailer
 'DROPBUF'
 trailer = translate(trailer)
 digest = translate(digest)
 if digest \= trailer then do
  say 'GITPSHA: pack checksum mismatch'
  say 'COMPUTED' digest
  say 'TRAILER ' trailer
  return 8
 end
 say 'PACK SHA1' digest
 return 0
files.GITPOBJ.EXEC:
/* M6G isolated Git packed-object header parser. */
parse arg command rest
command = translate(command)

if command = 'HEADER' then do
   parse var rest data extra
   data = translate(data)
   if data = '' | extra \= '' | length(data) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(data,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'Usage: GITPOBJ HEADER object-header-hex'
      exit 4
   end
   pos = 1
   b = nextbyte(data,pos)
   if b = 'ERROR' then exit 8
   pos = pos + 2
   type = (b % 16) // 8
   size = b // 16
   shift = 4
   more = b >= 128
   do while more
      b = nextbyte(data,pos)
      if b = 'ERROR' then exit 8
      pos = pos + 2
      size = size + (b // 128) * (2 ** shift)
      shift = shift + 7
      more = b >= 128
      if shift > 60 then do
         say 'GITPOBJ: object size header too large'
         exit 8
      end
   end
   if type = 0 | type = 5 then do
      say 'GITPOBJ: invalid packed object type' type
      exit 8
   end
   say 'TYPE' type typename(type)
   say 'SIZE' size
   say 'HEADER-BYTES' (pos - 1) % 2
   exit 0
end

say 'GITPOBJ: unknown command' command
exit 4

nextbyte: procedure
   parse arg data, pos
   if pos + 1 > length(data) then do
      say 'GITPOBJ: truncated object header'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return x2d(substr(data,pos,2))

typename: procedure
   parse arg t
   if t = 1 then return 'COMMIT'
   if t = 2 then return 'TREE'
   if t = 3 then return 'BLOB'
   if t = 4 then return 'TAG'
   if t = 6 then return 'OFS_DELTA'
   if t = 7 then return 'REF_DELTA'
   return 'INVALID'
files.GITPOID.EXEC:
/* M8C pack object-id to pack-position index. */
parse arg command rest
command = translate(command)
if command = 'CLEAR' then do
   'ERASE GITPOID PACK A'
   exit 0
end
if command = 'ADD' then do
   parse var rest oid position extra
   oid = translate(oid)
   if extra \= '' | length(oid) \= 40 |,
      verify(oid,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 |,
      datatype(position,'W') \= 1 | position < 0 then do
      say 'Usage: GITPOID ADD oid position'
      exit 4
   end
   call load
   if result \= 'OK' then exit 8
   do i = 1 to count
      if ids.i = oid then do
         say 'GITPOID: duplicate object id' oid
         exit 8
      end
   end
   count = count + 1
   ids.count = oid
   poss.count = position
   call write
   if result \= 'OK' then exit 8
   exit 0
end
if command = 'FIND' then do
   parse upper var rest oid extra
   if extra \= '' | length(oid) \= 40 |,
      verify(oid,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'Usage: GITPOID FIND oid'
      exit 4
   end
   call load
   if result \= 'OK' then exit 8
   do i = 1 to count
      if ids.i = oid then do
         queue poss.i
         exit 0
      end
   end
   say 'GITPOID: object id not found' oid
   exit 8
end
say 'GITPOID: unknown command' command
exit 4

load: procedure expose count ids. poss.
   count = 0
   drop ids. poss. in.
   'STATE GITPOID PACK A'
   if rc \= 0 then return 'OK'
   'EXECIO * DISKR GITPOID PACK A 1 (STEM IN. FINIS'
   if rc \= 0 then return 'ERROR'
   do i = 1 to in.0
      parse upper var in.i tag id p extra
      if tag \= 'OID' | extra \= '' | length(id) \= 40 |,
         verify(id,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 |,
         datatype(p,'W') \= 1 | p < 0 then return 'ERROR'
      count = count + 1
      ids.count = id
      poss.count = p
   end
   return 'OK'

write: procedure expose count ids. poss.
   drop out.
   out.0 = count
   do i = 1 to count
      out.i = 'OID' ids.i poss.i
   end
   'EXECIO' out.0 'DISKW GITPOID PACK A 1 (STEM OUT. FINIS'
   if rc \= 0 then return 'ERROR'
   return 'OK'

/* M170: generalized bounded smart-HTTP upload-pack POST. */

parse arg cmd bridge port authority repo oid storefn extra
cmd=translate(cmd)
oid=translate(oid)
storemode=cmd='STORE'
if (cmd\='POST' & cmd\='STORE') | bridge='' | port='' |,
   authority='' | repo='' | oid='' then do

wire=wire||result||'0D0A'

bad:

  say 'GITPOST: HTTP' hstate cstate cneed total

storefeed:
 parse arg shex
 /* A nearly full A disk used to abort the transfer midway, leaving a PACK
    with no META.  Check once before the first write and fail clearly. */
 if storechecked\=1 then do
  storechecked=1
  call afree
  if result='ERROR' | result<64 then do
   say 'GITPOST: disk G has fewer than 64 free blocks; not storing the pack'
   return 'ERROR'
  end
 end
 sbuf=sbuf||shex
 do while length(sbuf)>=128
  srecs=srecs+1
  sw.srecs=left(sbuf,128)
  sbuf=substr(sbuf,129)
  if srecs=64 then do
   call storeflush
   if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  end
 end
 return 'OK'

storeflush:
 if srecs=0 then return 'OK'
 sw.0=srecs
 'EXECIO' srecs 'DISKW' storefn 'PACK G 0 (STEM SW. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 drop sw.
 srecs=0
 return 'OK'

storefinal:
 if sbuf\='' then do
  srecs=srecs+1
  sw.srecs=sbuf
  sbuf=''
 end
 call storeflush
 if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 /* META needs at least one block.  If A filled during the transfer, roll
    back the partial PACK instead of leaving an unusable pair. */
 call afree
 if result='ERROR' | result<2 then do
  say 'GITPOST: disk G is full; erasing partial' storefn 'PACK G'
  'ERASE' storefn 'PACK G'
  return 'ERROR'
 end
 sm.1='META' oid packbytes pver pobjects
 sm.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW' storefn 'META G 1 (STEM SM. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

storeclean:
 'STATE' storefn 'PACK G'
 if rc=0 then 'ERASE' storefn 'PACK G'
 'STATE' storefn 'META G'
 if rc=0 then 'ERASE' storefn 'META G'
 return

httpfeed:
 parse arg hx
 hx=translate(hx)
 if hstate='HEAD' then do
  header=header||hx
  if length(header)>32768 then return 'ERROR'
  hp=pos('0D0A0D0A',header)
  if hp=0 then return 'OK'
  bodypart=substr(header,hp+8)
  hpart=left(header,hp+7)
  call checkhdr hpart
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  hstate='BODY'
  header=''
  if bodypart\='' then do
   call chunkfeed bodypart
   if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  end
  return 'OK'
 end
 if hstate\='BODY' then return 'ERROR'
 call chunkfeed hx
 return result

checkhdr:
 parse arg hh
 if left(hh,24)\='485454502F312E3120323030' &,
    left(hh,24)\='485454502F312E3020323030' then return 'ERROR'
 call asciitocms hh
 ht=result
 if ht='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
 hu=translate(ht)
 if pos('CONTENT-TYPE:',hu)=0 then return 'ERROR'
 if pos('APPLICATION/X-GIT-UPLOAD-PACK-RESULT',hu)=0 then,
  return 'ERROR'
 if pos('TRANSFER-ENCODING:',hu)=0 | pos('CHUNKED',hu)=0 then,
  return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

chunkfeed:
 parse arg cwork
 cwork=translate(cwork)
 do while cwork\=''
  if cstate='SIZE' then do
   cb=left(cwork,2)
   cwork=substr(cwork,3)
   cline=cline||cb
   if length(cline)>128 then return 'ERROR'
   if right(cline,4)='0D0A' then do
    ch=left(cline,length(cline)-4)
    cline=''
    ep=bytepos('3B',ch)
    if ep>0 then ch=left(ch,ep-1)
    if ch='' | length(ch)//2\=0 | length(ch)>16 then,
       return 'ERROR'
    cneed=0
    do cj=1 to length(ch) by 2
     cv=x2d(substr(ch,cj,2))
     if cv>=48 & cv<=57 then cn=cv-48
     else if cv>=65 & cv<=70 then cn=cv-55
     else if cv>=97 & cv<=102 then cn=cv-87
     else return 'ERROR'
     cneed=cneed*16+cn
    end
    if cneed>1048576 then return 'ERROR'
    if cneed=0 then do
     cstate='DONE'
     chunkdone=1
     cwork=''
    end
    else cstate='DATA'
   end
  end
  else if cstate='DATA' then do
   cavail=length(cwork)%2
   ctake=cneed
   if ctake>cavail then ctake=cavail
   if ctake=0 then return 'OK'
   cpiece=left(cwork,ctake*2)
   cwork=substr(cwork,ctake*2+1)
   call pktfeed cpiece
   if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
   cneed=cneed-ctake
   if cneed=0 then do
    cstate='CRLF'
    ccrlf=''
   end
  end
  else if cstate='CRLF' then do
   ctake=4-length(ccrlf)
   if ctake>length(cwork) then ctake=length(cwork)
   ccrlf=ccrlf||left(cwork,ctake)
   cwork=substr(cwork,ctake+1)
   if length(ccrlf)=4 then do
    if ccrlf\='0D0A' then return 'ERROR'
    ccrlf=''
    cstate='SIZE'
   end
  end
  else if cstate='DONE' then cwork=''
  else return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

pktfeed:
 parse arg pwork
 pwork=translate(pwork)
 do while pwork\=''
  if pstate='HDR' then do
   ptake=8-length(phdr)
   if ptake>length(pwork) then ptake=length(pwork)
   phdr=phdr||left(pwork,ptake)
   pwork=substr(pwork,ptake+1)
   if length(phdr)<8 then iterate
   call pktlen phdr
   pn=result
   if pn='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
   phdr=''
   if pn=0 | pn=1 | pn=2 then do
    flushes=flushes+1
    iterate
   end
   if pn<4 then return 'ERROR'
   pneed=pn-4
   if pneed<1 | pneed>65516 then return 'ERROR'
   pktcount=pktcount+1
   /* The pre-pack phase holds NAK/ACK/shallow lines and is over as soon as
      either one has been seen; everything after that is side-band data.
      Keying only on NAK breaks a HAVE request, where the server replies
      "ACK <oid>" and then goes straight to side-band progress packets. */
   if nak=0 & acks=0 then do
    if pneed>200 then return 'ERROR'
    ppay=''
    pstate='PRE'
   end
   else do
    pband=''
    pstate='BAND'
   end
  end
  else if pstate='PRE' then do
   pavail=length(pwork)%2
   ptake=pneed
   if ptake>pavail then ptake=pavail
   if ptake=0 then return 'OK'
   ppay=ppay||left(pwork,ptake*2)
   pwork=substr(pwork,ptake*2+1)
   pneed=pneed-ptake
   if pneed=0 then do
    if ppay\='4E414B0A' then do
     if left(ppay,14)='7368616C6C6F77' then shallows=shallows+1
     else if left(ppay,18)='756E7368616C6C6F77' then,
      unshallows=unshallows+1
     else if left(ppay,6)='41434B' then acks=acks+1
     else return 'ERROR'
    end
    else do
     nak=nak+1
     if nak\=1 then return 'ERROR'
    end
    ppay=''
    pstate='HDR'
   end
  end
  else if pstate='BAND' then do
   if length(pwork)<2 then return 'OK'
   pband=left(pwork,2)
   pwork=substr(pwork,3)
   pneed=pneed-1
   if pband\='01' & pband\='02' & pband\='03' then,
    return 'ERROR'
   if pband='03' then return 'ERROR'
   if pband='01' then packets=packets+1
   if pneed=0 then pstate='HDR'
   else pstate='PAY'
  end
  else if pstate='PAY' then do
   pavail=length(pwork)%2
   ptake=pneed
   if ptake>pavail then ptake=pavail
   if ptake=0 then return 'OK'
   ppiece=left(pwork,ptake*2)
   pwork=substr(pwork,ptake*2+1)
   if pband='01' then do
    packbytes=packbytes+ptake
    if length(packhead)<24 then do
     htake=24-length(packhead)
     if htake>length(ppiece) then htake=length(ppiece)
     packhead=packhead||left(ppiece,htake)
    end
    if storemode then do
     call storefeed ppiece
     if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
    end
   end
   else if pband='02' then progress=progress+ptake
   pneed=pneed-ptake
   if pneed=0 then do
    pband=''
    pstate='HDR'
   end
  end
  else return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

pktlen: procedure
 parse arg h
 if length(h)\=8 then return 'ERROR'
 n=0
 do i=1 to 4
  b=x2d(substr(h,i*2-1,2))
  if b>=48 & b<=57 then v=b-48
  else if b>=65 & b<=70 then v=b-55
  else if b>=97 & b<=102 then v=b-87
  else return 'ERROR'
  n=n*16+v
 end
 return n

bytepos: procedure
 parse arg needle,hex
 do bp=1 to length(hex)-1 by 2
  if substr(hex,bp,2)=needle then return bp
 end
 return 0

authheader: procedure
 address cms
 tokenalphabet='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
 tokenalphabet=tokenalphabet||'0123456789_-'
 'STATE GHCRED REPO G'
 if rc=28 then return ''
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 drop cred.
 'EXECIO * DISKR GHCRED REPO G 1 (STEM CRED. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | cred.0<4 then return 'ERROR'
 if cred.1='GHCRED 1' then do
  authmode='APIKEY'
  userrec=2
  lenrec=3
  firstsecret=4
  lenlabel='TOKEN-LENGTH'
  chunkprefix='TOKEN'
 end
 else if cred.1='GHCRED 2' then do
  if words(cred.2)\=2 | word(cred.2,1)\='MODE' then,
   return 'ERROR'
  authmode=word(cred.2,2)
  if authmode\='APIKEY' & authmode\='USERPASS' then,
   return 'ERROR'
  userrec=3
  lenrec=4
  firstsecret=5
  lenlabel='SECRET-LENGTH'
  chunkprefix='SECRET'
 end
 else return 'ERROR'
 if words(cred.userrec)\=2 | word(cred.userrec,1)\='USER' then,
  return 'ERROR'
 authuser=word(cred.userrec,2)
 if authuser='' | length(authuser)>39 |,
    verify(translate(authuser),'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-')\=0 then,
  return 'ERROR'
 if words(cred.lenrec)\=2 | word(cred.lenrec,1)\=lenlabel then,
  return 'ERROR'
 tokenlength=word(cred.lenrec,2)
 if datatype(tokenlength,'W')\=1 | tokenlength<1 | tokenlength>240 then,
  return 'ERROR'
 chunks=(tokenlength+63)%64
 if cred.0\=firstsecret+chunks-1 then return 'ERROR'
 authtoken=''
 do authi=1 to chunks
  rec=firstsecret+authi-1
  parse var cred.rec authlabel authpart
  authpart=strip(authpart)
  if authi=1 then expected=chunkprefix
  else expected=chunkprefix||'+'||(authi-1)
  wantlen=tokenlength-((authi-1)*64)
  if wantlen>64 then wantlen=64
  if words(cred.rec)\=2 | authlabel\=expected |,
     length(authpart)\=wantlen | verify(authpart,tokenalphabet)\=0 then,
   return 'ERROR'
  authtoken=authtoken||authpart
 end
 if length(authtoken)\=tokenlength then return 'ERROR'
 call toasciihex authuser||':'||authtoken
 authbytes=result
 if authbytes='ERROR' | length(authbytes)//2\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 alphabet='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
 alphabet=alphabet||'0123456789+/'
 auth64=''
 do authi=1 to length(authbytes) by 6
  remain=length(authbytes)-authi+1
  if remain<2 then return 'ERROR'
  b1=x2d(substr(authbytes,authi,2))
  b2=0
  b3=0
  if remain>=4 then b2=x2d(substr(authbytes,authi+2,2))
  if remain>=6 then b3=x2d(substr(authbytes,authi+4,2))
  six1=b1%4
  six2=(b1//4)*16+b2%16
  six3=(b2//16)*4+b3%64
  six4=b3//64
  auth64=auth64||substr(alphabet,six1+1,1)||,
         substr(alphabet,six2+1,1)
  if remain>=4 then auth64=auth64||substr(alphabet,six3+1,1)
  else auth64=auth64||'='
  if remain>=6 then auth64=auth64||substr(alphabet,six4+1,1)
  else auth64=auth64||'='
 end
 return 'Authorization: Basic '||auth64

 if length(e2a)\=512 then return 'ERROR'
 tab=x2c(e2a)
 bytes=xrange('00'x,'FF'x)
 return translate(ascii,bytes,tab)

afree:
 /* Return the blocks left on the G disk, or ERROR. */
 drop af.
af.0=0
'PIPE CMS QUERY DISK G | STEM AF.'
if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
found=''
do afi=1 to af.0
 if word(af.afi,3)='G' & word(af.afi,4)='R/W' & words(af.afi)>=11 then,
  found=word(af.afi,10)
end
if datatype(found,'W')\=1 then return 'ERROR'
return found
files.GITPRB.EXEC:
/* M191: isolated read-only direct record validator. */
address cms
parse upper arg datafm which extra
if datafm='' | which='' | extra\='' then do
 say 'Usage: GITPRB data-filemode FIRST|MID|LAST'
 exit 4
end
if length(datafm)\=1 |,
   verify(datafm,'BCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')\=0 then do
 say 'M191 FILEMODE INVALID'
 exit 4
end
if which\='FIRST' & which\='MID' & which\='LAST' then do
 say 'M191 EXPECT FIRST MID OR LAST'
 exit 4
end
drop d.
d.0=0
'PIPE CMS QUERY DISK' datafm '| STEM d.'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M191 QUERY DISK FAILED'
 exit 8
end
matched=0
do i=1 to d.0
 if word(d.i,3)=datafm & word(d.i,7)='4096' then,
   matched=matched+1
end
if matched\=1 then do
 say 'M191 DATA DISK NOT ACCESSED 4K' datafm
 exit 8
end
'STATE M173NET STAGE' datafm
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M191 STAGE MISSING' datafm
 exit 8
end
'STATE M174NET INDEX' datafm
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M191 INDEX MISSING' datafm
 exit 8
end
'STATE GITPRBM MODULE A'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M191 MODULE MISSING'
 exit 8
end

/* An existing caller FILEDEF is never overwritten or cleared. */
drop f.
f.0=0
'PIPE CMS QUERY FILEDEF | STEM f.'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M191 FILEDEF QUERY FAILED'
 exit 8
end
do i=1 to f.0
 dd=translate(word(f.i,1))
 if dd='STGIN' | dd='IDXIN' then do
  say 'M191 DD ALREADY DEFINED' dd
  exit 8
 end
end
'FILEDEF STGIN DISK M173NET STAGE' datafm
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M191 STGIN FILEDEF FAILED'
 exit 8
end
'FILEDEF IDXIN DISK M174NET INDEX' datafm
if rc\=0 then do
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 say 'M191 IDXIN FILEDEF FAILED'
 exit 8
end

/* Direct native MODULE call: no PIPE/STEM output buffering. */
say 'M191 DIRECT CMS SEEK PROBE BEGIN' which
'GITPRBM PROBE' which
workrc=rc
'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'
idxrc=rc
'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
stgrc=rc
if workrc\=0 | idxrc\=0 | stgrc\=0 then do
 say 'M191 CMS SEEK PROBE FAIL RC' workrc idxrc stgrc
 exit 8
end
say 'M191 CMS SEEK PROBE GATE PASS' datafm which
exit 0
files.GITPUSH.EXEC:
/* M281: GIT PUSH - push local commits to a remote Git repository.
 *
 * Usage: GIT PUSH remote bridge port pack index [branch|HEAD]
 *   or:  GIT PUSH  (uses first configured remote and default bridge)
 *
 * Flow:
 *  1. Resolve remote config (GITREMOT)
 *  2. Get local branch tip from REF2
 *  3. Discover remote refs (GET info/refs?service=git-receive-pack)
 *  4. If remote already has local tip: Already up to date
 *  5. Walk local tree to enumerate reachable objects (iterative,
 *     depth-capped)
 *  6. Write staging file, call GITPMK BUILD to create packfile
 *  7. POST ref updates + packfile to git-receive-pack
 *  8. Parse response, update remote-tracking ref
 */
address cms
numeric digits 20
parse arg remote bridge port pack index rest
remote=strip(remote)
bridge=translate(bridge)
port=translate(port)
pack=translate(pack)
index=translate(index)
branch=strip(rest)
if branch='' then branch='HEAD'

if remote='' | bridge='' | port='' | pack='' | index='' then do
   say 'Usage: GIT PUSH remote bridge port pack index [branch|HEAD]'
   say '   or: GIT PUSH  (uses first configured remote)'
   exit 4
end
if datatype(port,'W')\=1 | port<1 | port>65535 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: invalid port' port
   exit 4
end
if length(pack)>8 | length(index)>8 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: pack and index names must be <= 8 characters'
   exit 4
end
call validname pack
if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: invalid pack filename' pack
   exit 4
end
call validname index
if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: invalid index filename' index
   exit 4
end

/* Object disk from GITMETA. */
objectfm='G'
'STATE GITMETA REPO G'
mstate=rc
if mstate=0 then do
   drop config.
   config.0=0
   'EXECIO * DISKR GITMETA REPO G 1 (STEM CONFIG. FINIS'
   if rc=0 & config.0>=4 & config.1='CMS-GIT-REPOSITORY 1' then do
      objectrecords=0
      do ci=1 to config.0
         if word(config.ci,1)='OBJECT-DISK' then do
            if words(config.ci)\=2 then do
               say 'GIT PUSH: invalid OBJECT-DISK setting'
               exit 8
            end
            objectrecords=objectrecords+1
            objectfm=translate(word(config.ci,2))
         end
      end
      if objectrecords>1 | length(objectfm)\=1 |,
         verify(objectfm,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')\=0 then do
         say 'GIT PUSH: invalid OBJECT-DISK setting'
         exit 8
      end
      if objectfm\='G' then do
         say 'GIT PUSH: repository OBJECT-DISK must be G'
         exit 8
      end
   end
end
else if mstate\=28 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: cannot inspect repository metadata RC' mstate
   exit 8
end

/* Resolve remote configuration. */
drop remoterec.
remoterec.0=0
'STATE GITREMOT REPO G'
rstate=rc
if rstate=0 then do
   'EXECIO * DISKR GITREMOT REPO G 1 (STEM REMOTEREC. FINIS'
   if rc\=0 | REMOTEREC.0<1 | word(REMOTEREC.1,1)\='GITREMOT' then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: invalid remote database'
      exit 8
   end
   foundremote=0
   do ri=2 to REMOTEREC.0
      if words(REMOTEREC.ri)=3 & word(REMOTEREC.ri,1)='REMOTE' then do
         if translate(word(REMOTEREC.ri,2))=translate(remote) then do
            foundremote=1
            remote=word(REMOTEREC.ri,2)
            rauthority='github.com'
            rrepo=word(REMOTEREC.ri,3)
         end
      end
   end
   if foundremote\=1 then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: remote not configured' remote
      exit 8
   end
end
else do
   say 'GIT PUSH: no remote database; configure with GIT REMOTE ADD'
   exit 8
end
call safehost rauthority
if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: invalid remote authority' rauthority
   exit 8
end
call safepath rrepo
if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: invalid remote repo path' rrepo
   exit 8
end

/* Discover remote refs via git-receive-pack advertisement. */
drop refadv.
refadv.0=0
say 'GIT PUSH: discovering remote refs...'

call authheader
authvalue=result
if authvalue='ERROR' | authvalue='' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: valid GitHub credential required for push'
   exit 8
end
if translate(rauthority)\='GITHUB.COM' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: credential limited to github.com'
   exit 8
end
path='/'||rrepo||'.git/info/refs?service=git-receive-pack'
call toasciihex 'GET '||path||' HTTP/1.1'
wire=result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex 'Host: '||rauthority
wire=wire||result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex authvalue
wire=wire||result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex 'Accept: application/x-git-receive-pack-advertisement'
wire=wire||result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex 'User-Agent: git/cms-git'
wire=wire||result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex 'Connection: close'
wire=wire||result||'0D0A0D0A'
raw=x2c(wire)

s=''
r=Socket('Initialize','GITPUSH')
parse var r src rest
if src\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: socket initialize failed RC' src
   exit 8
end
if verify(bridge,'0123456789.')=0 then ip=bridge
else do
   r=Socket('GetHostByName',bridge)
   parse var r src addrs
   if src\=0 then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: host resolution failed for' bridge
      exit 8
   end
   ip=word(addrs,1)
   if ip='' then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: no address for' bridge
      exit 8
   end
end
r=Socket('Socket')
parse var r src s
if src\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: socket creation failed'
   exit 8
end
r=Socket('GetSockOpt',s,'SOL_SOCKET','SO_ASCII')
parse var r src opt
if src\=0 | translate(opt)\='OFF' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: SO_ASCII setup failed'
   exit 8
end
r=Socket('Connect',s,'AF_INET' port ip)
parse var r src rest
if src\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: connect failed to' ip port
   exit 8
end
r=Socket('Send',s,raw)
parse var r src sent
if src\=0 | sent\=length(raw) then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: send failed'
   exit 8
end

/* Parse receive-pack advertisement response (HTTP + PKT-LINE). */
hstate='HEAD'
header=''
cstate='SIZE'
cline=''
cneed=0
ccrlf=''
chunkdone=0
refs=0
total=0
httpstatus=''
pstate='HDR'
phdr=''
pneed=0
ppkt=''

do forever
   r=Socket('Recv',s,256)
   parse var r src got data
   if src\=0 then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: receive failed'
      exit 8
   end
   if got=0 then leave
   if got>256 | length(data)\=got then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: receive length error'
      exit 8
   end
   total=total+got
   if total>4194304 then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: response too large'
      exit 8
   end
   call httpfeed c2x(data)
   if result\='OK' then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: HTTP parse failed'
      exit 8
   end
end
r=Socket('Close',s)
r=Socket('Terminate')

if hstate\='BODY' | chunkdone\=1 then do
   if httpstatus\='' then,
      say 'GIT PUSH: discovery HTTP' strip(httpstatus)
   say 'GIT PUSH: debug state='hstate 'chunk='chunkdone
   say 'GIT PUSH: debug cstate='cstate 'refs='refadv.0 'bytes='total
   if refadv.0>0 then do
      _dx=refadv.0
      say 'GIT PUSH: debug nrefs='refadv.0
   end
   say 'GIT PUSH: incomplete discovery response'
   exit 8
end

/* Parse PKT-LINE ref advertisements (lines are full pkt hex). */
refcount=0
do ri=1 to refadv.0
   line=translate(refadv.ri)
   if left(line,8)='30303030' then leave /* 0000 flush */
   /* decode pkt length from 4 ASCII hex digit chars */
   call pktlen substr(line,1,8)
   plen=result
   if plen='ERROR' | plen<4 then iterate
   /* payload as hex: (plen-4) bytes = (plen-4)*2 hex chars */
   phex=substr(line,9,(plen-4)*2)
   if plen<=4 | length(phex)<2 then iterate
   /* strip trailing LF (0A) */
   if right(phex,2)='0A' then phex=left(phex,length(phex)-2)
   posnul=pos('00',phex)
   if posnul>0 then phex=left(phex,posnul-1)
   /* first 40 ASCII chars = 80 hex chars are the OID text */
   if length(phex)<81 then iterate
   call asciitocms left(phex,80)
   refoid=translate(result)
   if length(refoid)\=40 | verify(refoid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then iterate
   call asciitocms substr(phex,83)
   refname=strip(result)
   if refname='' then iterate
   refcount=refcount+1
   advref.refcount=refname
   advid.refcount=refoid
end
say 'GIT PUSH: remote refs='||refcount

/* Every advertised tip implies the remote already holds that tip's
   full object closure.  Excluding those roots prevents the pack from
   re-walking history the remote already has (and from requiring
   local copies of objects only reachable through a remote tip). */
drop remotehave.
remotehave.0=0
do rhi=1 to refcount
   rhold=translate(advid.rhi)
   if length(rhold)=40 &,
      verify(rhold,'0123456789ABCDEF')=0 then do
      remotehave.0=remotehave.0+1
      remotehavex=remotehave.0
      remotehave.remotehavex=rhold
   end
end

if refcount=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: no remote refs advertised'
   /* debug: show first raw pkt */
   if refadv.0>0 then say 'GIT PUSH: pkt1='||left(refadv.1,72)
   exit 8
end

/* Get local branch tip from REF2. */
drop ref2.
ref2.0=0
'EXECIO * DISKR GITREF2 REPO G 1 (STEM REF2. FINIS'
if rc\=0 | REF2.0<2 | word(REF2.1,1)\='REF2' |,
   word(REF2.1,2)\='1' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: cannot read REF2 repository state'
   exit 8
end
headref=''
do ri=2 to REF2.0
   if word(REF2.ri,1)='HEAD' then do
      if words(REF2.ri)\=2 then do
         say 'GIT PUSH: invalid HEAD record'
         exit 8
      end
      headref=word(REF2.ri,2)
   end
end

if branch='HEAD' then do
   if headref='' then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: cannot determine current branch'
      exit 8
   end
   if left(headref,11)\='refs/heads/' then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: HEAD is not on a branch'
      exit 8
   end
   localbranch=headref
   shortbranch=substr(headref,12)
   localtip=''
   do ri=2 to REF2.0
      if word(REF2.ri,1)='REF' & word(REF2.ri,2)=headref then do
         localtip=translate(word(REF2.ri,3))
      end
   end
end
else do
   localbranch='refs/heads/'||branch
   shortbranch=branch
   localtip=''
   do ri=2 to REF2.0
      if word(REF2.ri,1)='REF' & word(REF2.ri,2)=localbranch then do
         localtip=translate(word(REF2.ri,3))
      end
   end
end

if localtip='' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: local branch' branch 'not found'
   exit 8
end
if length(localtip)\=40 | verify(localtip,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: invalid local tip OID' localtip
   exit 8
end

/* Check if remote already has this tip. */
remotehas=0
remoteadoid=''
do ri=1 to refcount
   if advref.ri=localbranch then do
      remotehas=1
      remoteadoid=advid.ri
   end
end
if remotehas=1 then do
   if remoteadoid=localtip then do
      say 'Already up to date' localtip
      exit 0
   end
   /* Remote has a different tip - check fast-forward via GITVREF. */
   drop ancout.
   ancout.0=0
   'PIPE CMS EXEC GITVREF IS-ANCESTOR'||' '||remoteadoid||' '||,
      localtip||' | STEM ANCOUT.'
   if rc\=0 then do
      /* A shallow local history may not reach the remote tip.  Never
         guess: refuse the update rather than risk a non-fast-forward. */
      say 'GIT PUSH: cannot prove fast-forward; remote tip is not in',
          'local history'
      say 'GIT PUSH: refusing non-fast-forward update'
      exit 8
   end
   ancestryline=''
   do ai=1 to ancout.0
      ancestryline=ancestryline||strip(ancout.ai)
   end
   if ancestryline\='ANCESTOR YES' remoteadoid localtip then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: not a fast-forward; remote has diverged'
      exit 8
   end
end

/* Enumerate objects reachable from local tip (iterative, depth-capped). */
say 'GIT PUSH: enumerating objects from' localtip
drop objlist.
objlist.0=0
drop objsseen.
objsseen.0=0
depth.0=0
call walk_commit localtip
zeroobj=0
if objlist.0=0 then do
   /* The remote already advertises the target tip (for example when the
      same commit is pushed under a second branch name).  A ref update
      still needs a valid pack, but that pack contains zero objects. */
   say 'GIT PUSH: no new objects; building empty pack'
   zeroobj=1
end
say 'GIT PUSH: enumerated' objlist.0 'objects'
/* Reuse existing pack if present (debug/fast path). */
reusepack=0
'STATE' pack 'PACK' objectfm
if rc=0 then do
   drop _RP.
   _RP.0=0
   'EXECIO 1 DISKR' pack 'PACK' objectfm '1 (STEM _RP. FINIS'
   if rc=0 & _RP.0>=1 then do
      _rp1=translate(strip(_RP.1))
      if left(_rp1,8)='5041434B' then do
         reusepack=1
         say 'GIT PUSH: reusing existing pack' pack
      end
   end
end
if zeroobj=1 then do
   /* A ref update whose target is already on the remote still needs a
      valid pack.  This is the canonical zero-object pack: PACK v2 with
      zero entries plus the SHA-1 trailer over those 12 header bytes. */
   emptypackhex='5041434B0000000200000000',
      ||'029D08823BD8A8EAB510AD6AC75C823CFD3ED31E'
   drop _ep.
   _ep.1=emptypackhex
   _ep.0=1
   'STATE' pack 'PACK' objectfm
   if rc=0 then 'ERASE' pack 'PACK' objectfm
   'EXECIO 1 DISKW' pack 'PACK' objectfm '1 (STEM _EP. FINIS'
   if rc\=0 then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: cannot write empty pack'
      exit 8
   end
   reusepack=1
end

if reusepack\=1 then do

/* Write staging file for GITPMK (literal OBJSTG STAGE <fm>). */
stagefn='OBJSTG'
'STATE' stagefn 'STAGE' objectfm
stagerc=rc
if stagerc=0 then 'ERASE' stagefn 'STAGE' objectfm
if stagerc\=0 & stagerc\=28 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: staging STATE failed RC' stagerc
   exit 8
end
drop stgout.
sn=0
do oi=1 to objlist.0
   oidcur=objlist.oi
   objfn=substr(oidcur,1,8)
   'EXECIO * DISKR' objfn 'GITOBJ' objectfm '1 (STEM OBJCUR. FINIS'
   if rc\=0 then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: cannot read object' oidcur
      exit 8
   end
   objtype=''
   objsize=0
   objhex=''
   do bi=1 to OBJCUR.0
      if word(OBJCUR.bi,1)='TYPE' then objtype=translate(word(OBJCUR.bi,2))
      else if word(OBJCUR.bi,1)='SIZE' then objsize=word(OBJCUR.bi,2)
      else if word(OBJCUR.bi,1)='DATA' then,
         objhex=objhex||translate(word(OBJCUR.bi,2))
   end
   if objtype='' | objsize='' then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: corrupt object' oidcur
      exit 8
   end
   if length(objhex)%2\=objsize then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: object size mismatch' oidcur
      exit 8
   end
   if objtype='COMMIT' then objcode=1
   else if objtype='TREE' then objcode=2
   else if objtype='BLOB' then objcode=3
   else if objtype='TAG' then objcode=4
   else do
      say 'GIT PUSH: unknown object type' objtype oidcur
      exit 8
   end
   sn=sn+1
   stgout.sn='OBJ' objcode objsize oidcur
   pos=1
   do while pos<=length(objhex)
      take=min(64,length(objhex)-pos+1)
      sn=sn+1
      stgout.sn=substr(objhex,pos,take)
      pos=pos+take
   end
   if objsize=0 then do
      sn=sn+1
      stgout.sn=''
   end
end
stgout.0=sn
'EXECIO' sn 'DISKW' stagefn 'STAGE' objectfm '1 (STEM STGOUT. FINIS'
if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: staging write failed'
   exit 8
end

/* Build packfile (native GITPMKC preferred). */
say 'GIT PUSH: building packfile...'
'STATE OBJOUT STAGE' objectfm
if rc=0 then 'ERASE OBJOUT STAGE' objectfm
'STATE GITPMKC MODULE G'
nativepmk=(rc=0)
if nativepmk then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: using native GITPMKC builder'
   'FILEDEF OBJSTG DISK' stagefn 'STAGE' objectfm
   'FILEDEF OBJOUT DISK OBJOUT STAGE' objectfm ' (RECFM V LRECL 255'
   'GITPMKC BUILD HEX'
   pmkrc=rc
   'FILEDEF OBJSTG CLEAR'
   'FILEDEF OBJOUT CLEAR'
end
else do
   say 'GIT PUSH: using REXX GITPMK builder'
   'EXEC GITPMK BUILD' objectfm
   pmkrc=rc
end
if pmkrc\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: pack creation failed'
   exit 8
end
'STATE OBJOUT STAGE' objectfm
if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: pack file not created'
   exit 8
end
'STATE' pack 'PACK' objectfm
if rc=0 then 'ERASE' pack 'PACK' objectfm
'RENAME OBJOUT STAGE' objectfm pack 'PACK' objectfm
if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: pack rename failed'
   exit 8
end
'ERASE' stagefn 'STAGE' objectfm
end

/* Send push to git-receive-pack. */
say 'GIT PUSH: sending pack to' rauthority '...'
call authheader
authvalue=result
if authvalue='ERROR' | authvalue='' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: invalid stored GitHub credential'
   exit 8
end
if translate(rauthority)\='GITHUB.COM' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: credential limited to github.com'
   exit 8
end

/* Read pack file (hex text) and compute size without concatenation. */
drop PACKHEX.
PACKHEX.0=0
'EXECIO * DISKR' pack 'PACK' objectfm '1 (STEM PACKHEX. FINIS'
if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: cannot read pack file'
   exit 8
end
packlen=0
do pi=1 to PACKHEX.0
   packlen=packlen+length(strip(translate(PACKHEX.pi)))
end
if packlen=0 | packlen//2\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: pack file is empty or malformed'
   exit 8
end
say 'GIT PUSH: pack hex bytes='||(packlen%2)
p1=translate(strip(PACKHEX.1))
if left(p1,8)\='5041434B' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: bad pack header' left(p1,16)
   exit 8
end

/* Build receive-pack command pkt + flush (hex of raw wire bytes). */
if remotehas=1 then oldoid=remoteadoid
else oldoid='0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
cmdtxt=translate(oldoid,'abcdef','ABCDEF')||' '||,
   translate(localtip,'abcdef','ABCDEF')||' '||localbranch
call toasciihex cmdtxt
datahex=result||'00'
call toasciihex ' report-status object-format=sha1 agent=git/cms-git'
/* pkt-line command payloads end with LF; without it GitHub accepts the
   update but does not emit a report-status response. */
datahex=datahex||result||'0A'
pktn=(8+length(datahex))%2
pktpfx=translate(right(d2x(pktn),4,'0'))
call toasciihex pktpfx
cmdhex=result||datahex||'30303030'

/* HTTP headers. */
clen=(length(cmdhex)+packlen)%2
path='/'||rrepo||'.git/git-receive-pack'
call toasciihex 'POST '||path||' HTTP/1.1'
wire=result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex 'Host: '||rauthority
wire=wire||result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex authvalue
wire=wire||result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex 'User-Agent: git/cms-git'
wire=wire||result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex 'Content-Type: application/x-git-receive-pack-request'
wire=wire||result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex 'Accept: application/x-git-receive-pack-result'
wire=wire||result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex 'Content-Length: '||clen
wire=wire||result||'0D0A'
call toasciihex 'Connection: close'
wire=wire||result||'0D0A0D0A'
wire=wire||cmdhex

r=Socket('Initialize','GITPUSH2')
parse var r src rest
if src\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: socket initialize failed RC' src
   exit 8
end
if verify(bridge,'0123456789.')=0 then ip=bridge
else do
   r=Socket('GetHostByName',bridge)
   parse var r src addrs
   if src\=0 then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: host resolution failed for' bridge
      exit 8
   end
   ip=word(addrs,1)
end
r=Socket('Socket')
parse var r src s
if src\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: socket creation failed'
   exit 8
end
r=Socket('GetSockOpt',s,'SOL_SOCKET','SO_ASCII')
parse var r src opt
if src\=0 | translate(opt)\='OFF' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: SO_ASCII setup failed'
   exit 8
end
r=Socket('Connect',s,'AF_INET' port ip)
parse var r src rest
if src\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: connect failed'
   exit 8
end
say 'GIT PUSH: sending' clen 'bytes...'
rawrec=x2c(wire)
off=1
do while off<=length(rawrec)
   chunk=substr(rawrec,off)
   r=Socket('Send',s,chunk)
   parse var r src sent
   if src\=0 | sent<=0 then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: send failed (headers) src='src 'sent='sent
      exit 8
   end
   off=off+sent
end
/* Coalesce pack records into large raw buffers.  One Socket('Send') per
   255-column hex record costs roughly 18 ms on CMS, so a multi-megabyte
   pack takes minutes and the peer times out mid-upload. */
carry=''
bufhex=''
do pi=1 to PACKHEX.0
   phrec=carry||strip(translate(PACKHEX.pi))
   carry=''
   if phrec='' then iterate
   if length(phrec)//2=1 then do
      carry=right(phrec,1)
      phrec=left(phrec,length(phrec)-1)
   end
   if phrec='' then iterate
   bufhex=bufhex||phrec
   if length(bufhex)>=65536 then do
      call sendpackbuf bufhex,pi
      if result\='OK' then exit 8
      bufhex=''
   end
end
if carry\='' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: pack hex nibble alignment error'
   exit 8
end
if bufhex\='' then do
   call sendpackbuf bufhex,pi
   if result\='OK' then exit 8
end

/* Receive response. */
hstate='HEAD'
header=''
cstate='SIZE'
cline=''
cneed=0
ccrlf=''
chunkdone=0
httpstatus=''
hchunked=1
hclen=-1
bodychunked=1
bodyleft=-1
bodyraw=''
bodyrawmax=512
pstate='HDR'
phdr=''
pneed=0
ppkt=''
total=0
drop pushresp.
pushresp.0=0

do forever
   r=Socket('Recv',s,256)
   parse var r src got data
   if src\=0 then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: receive failed'
      exit 8
   end
   if got=0 then leave
   if got>256 | length(data)\=got then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: receive length error'
      exit 8
   end
   total=total+got
   call httpfeed_push c2x(data)
   if result\='OK' then do
      say 'GIT PUSH: HTTP parse failed'
      exit 8
   end
end
r=Socket('Close',s)
r=Socket('Terminate')

say 'GIT PUSH: response HTTP' strip(httpstatus) 'pkts='pushresp.0
say 'GIT PUSH: resp state='hstate 'chunk='chunkdone 'cstate='cstate
say 'GIT PUSH: pkt pstate='pstate 'phdr='||length(phdr) 'pneed='pneed
say 'GIT PUSH: bchk='bodychunked
say 'GIT PUSH: phdr='||left(phdr,16)
say 'GIT PUSH: braw='||left(bodyraw,80)
if pushresp.0=0 & bodyraw\='' then do
   call asciitocms bodyraw
   say 'GIT PUSH: body='||left(strip(result),120)
end

/* Parse report-status response (plain pkt-lines or side-band-64k). */
pushok=0
pushfail=''
do ri=1 to pushresp.0
   line=translate(pushresp.ri)
   if left(line,8)='30303030' then leave
   call pktlen substr(line,1,8)
   plen=result
   if plen='ERROR' | plen<4 then iterate
   phex=substr(line,9,(plen-4)*2)
   if plen<=4 | length(phex)<2 then iterate
   /* Side-band-64k: first payload byte is channel (01=data,02=prog,03=err). */
   if left(phex,2)='01' | left(phex,2)='02' | left(phex,2)='03' then do
      chan=left(phex,2); phex=substr(phex,3)
      if chan='02' then iterate
      if chan='03' then do
         call asciitocms phex
         pushfail=strip(result); say 'GIT PUSH: sideband err' pushfail
         iterate
      end
      /* channel 1: may contain embedded pkt-line(s) */
   end
   /* Handle embedded pkt-line(s) inside channel 1, or plain pkt payload. */
   inner=phex
   do while length(inner)>=8
      if left(inner,8)='30303030' then leave
      /* is this an embedded pkt-line? starts with 4 hex-ascii digit chars */
      call pktlen left(inner,8)
      ipn=result
      if ipn='ERROR' | ipn<4 then leave
      ihex=substr(inner,9,(ipn-4)*2)
      if right(ihex,2)='0A' then ihex=left(ihex,length(ihex)-2)
      call asciitocms ihex
      msg=strip(result)
      if left(msg,7)='unpack ' then do
         say 'GIT PUSH: unpack' substr(msg,8)
         if strip(substr(msg,8))\='ok' then pushfail=msg
      end
      else if left(msg,3)='ok ' then do
         pushok=1; say 'GIT PUSH: accepted' substr(msg,4)
      end
      else if left(msg,3)='ng ' then do
         pushfail=substr(msg,4); say 'GIT PUSH: rejected' pushfail
      end
      inner=substr(inner,ipn*2+1)
   end
   if length(inner)>0 & length(inner)<8 then do
      /* plain (non-embedded) payload that wasn't an embedded pkt */
      nop=1
   end
   /* also try plain decode if nothing matched (non-embedded, no sideband) */
   if pushok=0 & pushfail='' & length(inner)>=2 &,
      length(inner)=length(phex) then do
      if right(phex,2)='0A' then phex=left(phex,length(phex)-2)
      call asciitocms phex
      msg=strip(result)
      if left(msg,7)='unpack ' then do
         say 'GIT PUSH: unpack' substr(msg,8)
         if strip(substr(msg,8))\='ok' then pushfail=msg
      end
      else if left(msg,3)='ok ' then do
         pushok=1; say 'GIT PUSH: accepted' substr(msg,4)
      end
      else if left(msg,3)='ng ' then do
         pushfail=substr(msg,4); say 'GIT PUSH: rejected' pushfail
      end
      else if msg\='' then say 'GIT PUSH:' msg
   end
end

if pushfail\='' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: push failed:' pushfail
   exit 8
end
if pushok\=1 & remotehas=0 then do
   /* empty-repo create: some flows report via unpack only; be explicit */
   say 'GIT PUSH: no ref acceptance in report-status'
   do di=1 to min(pushresp.0,5)
      dline=translate(pushresp.di)
      if left(dline,8)='30303030' then say 'GIT PUSH: pkt' di '=FLUSH'
      else do
         call pktlen substr(dline,1,8)
         if result\='ERROR' & result>4 then do
            dhex=substr(dline,9,(result-4)*2)
            if right(dhex,2)='0A' then dhex=left(dhex,length(dhex)-2)
            call asciitocms dhex
            say 'GIT PUSH: pkt' di '='||strip(result)
         end
         else say 'GIT PUSH: pkt' di '='||left(dline,40)
      end
   end
   exit 8
end

/* Update remote-tracking ref. */
trackingref='refs/remotes/'||remote||'/'||shortbranch
drop ref2upd.
ref2upd.0=0
'EXECIO * DISKR GITREF2 REPO G 1 (STEM REF2UPD. FINIS'
if rc\=0 | REF2UPD.0<2 | REF2UPD.1\='REF2 1' then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: cannot read REF2 for tracking update'
   exit 8
end
drop newrefs.
newrefs.1='REF2 1'
newrefcount=1
headwritten=0
found_tracking=0
do ri=2 to REF2UPD.0
   if word(REF2UPD.ri,1)='HEAD' then do
      /* Collapse duplicate HEAD records; never move HEAD to the
         branch being pushed. */
      if headwritten=0 then do
         newrefcount=newrefcount+1
         newrefs.newrefcount='HEAD '||word(REF2UPD.ri,2)
         headwritten=1
      end
   end
   else if word(REF2UPD.ri,1)='REF' then do
      refname3=word(REF2UPD.ri,2)
      refval3=translate(word(REF2UPD.ri,3))
      if refname3=trackingref then do
         newrefcount=newrefcount+1
         newrefs.newrefcount='REF ' trackingref ' ' localtip
         found_tracking=1
      end
      else do
         newrefcount=newrefcount+1
         newrefs.newrefcount='REF ' refname3 ' ' refval3
      end
   end
end
if headwritten=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: REF2 has no HEAD record'
   exit 8
end
if \found_tracking then do
   newrefcount=newrefcount+1
   newrefs.newrefcount='REF ' trackingref ' ' localtip
end
newrefs.0=newrefcount
'EXECIO' newrefcount 'DISKW GITREF2 REPO G 1 (STEM NEWREFS. FINIS'
if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GIT PUSH: failed to update REF2 tracking ref'
   exit 8
end

say 'PUSH COMPLETE' remote localbranch localtip
exit 0

/* ======================================================================== */
/* Helper routines                                                          */
/* ======================================================================== */

/* Walk a commit and all reachable objects iteratively (no recursion). */
walk_commit: procedure expose objlist. objsseen. objectfm ,
   remoteadoid remotehas remotehave.
   parse arg cmt .
   /* Use a queue for iterative BFS over commits. */
   drop cqueue.
   cqueue.0=1
   cqueue.1=cmt
   cnext=1
   do while cnext<=cqueue.0
      current=cqueue.cnext
      cnext=cnext+1
      seen=0
      do si=1 to objsseen.0
         if objsseen.si=current then do
            seen=1
            leave
         end
      end
      /* Stop at any advertised remote tip: its closure is present
         on the remote even when this repository is shallow. */
      do rhi=1 to remotehave.0
         if translate(current)=remotehave.rhi then do
            seen=1
            leave
         end
      end
      if seen then do
         objsseen.0=objsseen.0+1
         objsseenx=objsseen.0
         objsseen.objsseenx=current
         iterate
      end
      /* Stop at objects the remote already has. */
      if remotehas=1 & translate(current)=translate(remoteadoid) then do
         objsseen.0=objsseen.0+1
         objsseenx=objsseen.0
         objsseen.objsseenx=current
         iterate
      end
      objsseen.0=objsseen.0+1
      objsseenx=objsseen.0
      objsseen.objsseenx=current
      objlist.0=objlist.0+1
      objlistx=objlist.0
      objlist.objlistx=current

      /* Read commit object. */
      objfn=substr(current,1,8)
      drop cmtobj.
      cmtobj.0=0
      'EXECIO * DISKR' objfn 'GITOBJ' objectfm '1 (STEM CMTOBJ. FINIS'
      if rc\=0 then do
         say 'GIT PUSH: cannot read commit' current
         exit 8
      end
      ctype=''
      cdata=''
      do bi=1 to CMTOBJ.0
         if word(CMTOBJ.bi,1)='TYPE' then,
            ctype=translate(word(CMTOBJ.bi,2))
         else if word(CMTOBJ.bi,1)='DATA' then,
            cdata=cdata||translate(word(CMTOBJ.bi,2))
      end
      if ctype\='COMMIT' then do
         say 'GIT PUSH: object is not a commit' current
         exit 8
      end
      cdata=translate(cdata)

      /* Parse tree OID from commit data. */
      treepos=pos('7472656520',cdata)
      if treepos=0 then do
         say 'GIT PUSH: commit has no tree' current
         exit 8
      end
      /* The commit body is hex-encoded ASCII: a 40-character OID is
         80 hex columns.  X2C alone yields EBCDIC code points, so
         translate through the ASCII table (see asciitocms). */
      call asciitocms substr(cdata,treepos+10,80)
      treeoid=translate(result)
      if length(treeoid)\=40 |,
         verify(treeoid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then do
         say 'GIT PUSH: invalid tree OID in commit' current
         exit 8
      end

      /* Walk the commit tree and all of its subtrees. */
      call walk_tree treeoid

      /* Enqueue parents for processing. */
      ppos=1
      do forever
         ppos=pos('706172656E7420',cdata,ppos)
         if ppos=0 then leave
         call asciitocms substr(cdata,ppos+14,80)
         poid=translate(result)
         if length(poid)=40 &,
            verify(poid,'0123456789ABCDEF')=0 then do
            cqueue.0=cqueue.0+1
            cqueuex=cqueue.0
            cqueue.cqueuex=poid
         end
         ppos=ppos+96
      end
   end
   return

/* Walk a tree object and enqueue all referenced objects iteratively. */
walk_tree: procedure expose objlist. objsseen. objectfm
   parse arg treeoid
   drop tqueue.
   tqueue.0=1
   tqueue.1=treeoid
   tnext=1
   do while tnext<=tqueue.0
      current=tqueue.tnext
      tnext=tnext+1
      seen=0
      do si=1 to objsseen.0
         if objsseen.si=current then do
            seen=1
            leave
         end
      end
      if seen then iterate
      objsseen.0=objsseen.0+1
      objsseenx=objsseen.0
      objsseen.objsseenx=current
      objlist.0=objlist.0+1
      objlistx=objlist.0
      objlist.objlistx=current

      /* Read tree object. */
      objfn=substr(current,1,8)
      drop treeobj.
      treeobj.0=0
      'EXECIO * DISKR' objfn 'GITOBJ' objectfm '1 (STEM TREEOBJ. FINIS'
      if rc\=0 then do
         say 'GIT PUSH: cannot read tree' current
         exit 8
      end
      tdata=''
      do bi=1 to treeobj.0
         if word(treeobj.bi,1)='DATA' then,
            tdata=tdata||translate(word(treeobj.bi,2))
      end
      tdata=translate(tdata)

      /* Parse tree entries. */
      tpos=1
      do while tpos<=length(tdata)-2
         mend=tpos
         do while tpos<=length(tdata)-2 &,
            substr(tdata,tpos,2)\='20'
            tpos=tpos+2
         end
         if tpos>length(tdata)-2 then leave
         modehex=substr(tdata,mend,tpos-mend)
         tpos=tpos+2
         do while tpos<=length(tdata)-2 &,
            substr(tdata,tpos,2)\='00'
            tpos=tpos+2
         end
         if tpos>length(tdata)-2 then leave
         tpos=tpos+2
         childoid=substr(tdata,tpos,40)
         tpos=tpos+40
         if length(childoid)\=40 |,
            verify(childoid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then do
            say 'GIT PUSH: invalid entry OID in tree' current
            exit 8
         end
         /* Mode 40000 (hex 3430303030) is a subtree. */
         if modehex='3430303030' then do
            tqueue.0=tqueue.0+1
            tqueuex=tqueue.0
            tqueue.tqueuex=childoid
         end
         else do
            isdup=0
            do si=1 to objsseen.0
               if objsseen.si=childoid then do
                  isdup=1
                  leave
               end
            end
            if isdup\=1 then do
               objsseen.0=objsseen.0+1
               objsseenx=objsseen.0
               objsseen.objsseenx=childoid
               objlist.0=objlist.0+1
               objlistx=objlist.0
               objlist.objlistx=childoid
            end
         end
      end
   end
   return

httpfeed:
 parse arg hx
 hx=translate(hx)
 if hstate='HEAD' then do
  header=header||hx
  hp=pos('0D0A0D0A',header)
  if hp=0 then return 'OK'
  hpart=left(header,hp+7)
  call checkhdr hpart
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  leftover=substr(header,hp+8)
  hstate='BODY'
  header=''
  if leftover\='' then do
   call httpfeed_body leftover
   if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  end
  return 'OK'
 end
 if hstate\='BODY' then return 'ERROR'
 call httpfeed_body hx
 return 'OK'

httpfeed_body:
 /* Chunked transfer decoding for discovery; feeds pkt lines to pktfeed. */
 parse arg cwork
 cwork=translate(cwork)
 do while cwork\=''
  if cstate='SIZE' then do
   cb=left(cwork,2)
   cwork=substr(cwork,3)
   cline=cline||cb
   if length(cline)>128 then return 'ERROR'
   if right(cline,4)='0D0A' then do
    ch=left(cline,length(cline)-4)
    cline=''
    ep=pos('3B',ch)
    if ep>0 then ch=left(ch,ep-1)
    if ch='' | length(ch)//2\=0 | length(ch)>16 then return 'ERROR'
    cneed=0
    do cj=1 to length(ch) by 2
     cv=x2d(substr(ch,cj,2))
     if cv>=48 & cv<=57 then cn=cv-48
     else if cv>=65 & cv<=70 then cn=cv-55
     else if cv>=97 & cv<=102 then cn=cv-87
     else return 'ERROR'
     cneed=cneed*16+cn
    end
    if cneed>1048576 then return 'ERROR'
    if cneed=0 then do
     cstate='DONE'; chunkdone=1; cwork=''
    end
    else cstate='DATA'
   end
  end
  else if cstate='DATA' then do
   cavail=length(cwork)%2
   ctake=cneed
   if ctake>cavail then ctake=cavail
   if ctake=0 then return 'OK'
   cpiece=left(cwork,ctake*2)
   cwork=substr(cwork,ctake*2+1)
   call pktfeed cpiece
   if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
   cneed=cneed-ctake
   if cneed=0 then do
    cstate='CRLF'; ccrlf=''
   end
  end
  else if cstate='CRLF' then do
   ctake=4-length(ccrlf)
   if ctake>length(cwork) then ctake=length(cwork)
   ccrlf=ccrlf||left(cwork,ctake)
   cwork=substr(cwork,ctake+1)
   if length(ccrlf)=4 then do
    if ccrlf\='0D0A' then return 'ERROR'
    ccrlf=''; cstate='SIZE'
   end
  end
  else if cstate='DONE' then cwork=''
  else return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

pktfeed:
 /* Reassemble complete pkt-lines (hex) into refadv. */
 parse arg pwork
 pwork=translate(pwork)
 do while pwork\=''
  if pstate='HDR' then do
   ptake=8-length(phdr)
   if ptake>length(pwork) then ptake=length(pwork)
   phdr=phdr||left(pwork,ptake)
   pwork=substr(pwork,ptake+1)
   if length(phdr)<8 then iterate
   call pktlen phdr
   pn=result
   if pn='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
   if pn=0 then do
    refadv.0=refadv.0+1; refadvx=refadv.0
    refadv.refadvx='0000'
    phdr=''; iterate
   end
   pneed=(pn-4)*2
   ppkt=phdr
   phdr=''
   if pneed=0 then do
    refadv.0=refadv.0+1; refadvx=refadv.0
    refadv.refadvx=ppkt; ppkt=''
    iterate
   end
   pstate='BODY'
  end
  else if pstate='BODY' then do
   ptake=pneed
   if ptake>length(pwork) then ptake=length(pwork)
   ppkt=ppkt||left(pwork,ptake)
   pwork=substr(pwork,ptake+1)
   pneed=pneed-ptake
   if pneed=0 then do
    refadv.0=refadv.0+1; refadvx=refadv.0
    refadv.refadvx=ppkt
    ppkt=''; pstate='HDR'
   end
  end
  else return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

pktlen:
 /* 4-byte pkt-line length header (8 hex chars) -> integer, or 'ERROR'. */
 parse arg h
 if length(h)\=8 then return 'ERROR'
 n=0
 do pi=1 to 4
  b=x2d(substr(h,pi*2-1,2))
  if b>=48 & b<=57 then v=b-48
  else if b>=65 & b<=70 then v=b-55
  else if b>=97 & b<=102 then v=b-87
  else return 'ERROR'
  n=n*16+v
 end
 return n

checkhdr:
 parse arg hh
 /* Accept any HTTP status line (HTTP/1.x <code> ...). */
 if left(hh,14)\='485454502F312E' then return 'ERROR'
 call asciitocms hh
 ht=result
 if ht='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
 parse var ht httpstatus 13 .
 hu=translate(ht)
 if pos('CONTENT-TYPE:',hu)=0 then return 'ERROR'
 hchunked=(pos('TRANSFER-ENCODING: CHUNKED',hu)>0)
 hclen=-1
 clp=pos('CONTENT-LENGTH:',hu)
 if clp>0 then do
  clv=strip(substr(ht,clp+15))
  clv=word(translate(clv,' ','0D0A'x),1)
  if datatype(strip(clv),'W') then hclen=strip(clv)+0
 end
 return 'OK'

httpfeed_push:
 parse arg hx
 hx=translate(hx)
 if hstate='HEAD' then do
  header=header||hx
  hp=pos('0D0A0D0A',header)
  if hp=0 then return 'OK'
  hpart=left(header,hp+7)
  call checkhdr hpart
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  leftover=substr(header,hp+8)
  hstate='BODY'
  bodychunked=hchunked
  bodyleft=hclen
  bodyraw=''
  bodyrawmax=512
  header=''
  if leftover\='' then do
   call httpfeed_push_body leftover
   if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  end
  return 'OK'
 end
 if hstate='BODY' then do
  call httpfeed_push_body hx
  return result
 end
 return 'OK'

httpfeed_push_body:
 parse arg cwork
 cwork=translate(cwork)
 if length(bodyraw)<bodyrawmax*2 then,
    bodyraw=bodyraw||left(cwork,(bodyrawmax*2)-length(bodyraw))
 if \bodychunked then do
  /* Non-chunked: feed raw body to pktfeed_push; capture text preview. */
  if bodyleft>=0 then do
   take=length(cwork)
   if take>bodyleft*2 then take=bodyleft*2
   piece=left(cwork,take)
   bodyleft=bodyleft-(take%2)
  end
  else piece=cwork
  if piece\='' then do
   if length(bodyraw)<bodyrawmax*2 then,
      bodyraw=bodyraw||left(piece,(bodyrawmax*2)-length(bodyraw))
   call pktfeed_push piece
   if result\='OK' then do
    /* not pkt-formatted; keep preview only */
    nop=1
   end
  end
  if bodyleft=0 then chunkdone=1
  return 'OK'
 end
 /* Chunked transfer decoding; feeds pkt lines to pktfeed_push. */
 do while cwork\=''
  if cstate='SIZE' then do
   cb=left(cwork,2)
   cwork=substr(cwork,3)
   cline=cline||cb
   if length(cline)>128 then return 'ERROR'
   if right(cline,4)='0D0A' then do
    ch=left(cline,length(cline)-4)
    cline=''
    ep=pos('3B',ch)
    if ep>0 then ch=left(ch,ep-1)
    if ch='' | length(ch)//2\=0 | length(ch)>16 then return 'ERROR'
    cneed=0
    do cj=1 to length(ch) by 2
     cv=x2d(substr(ch,cj,2))
     if cv>=48 & cv<=57 then cn=cv-48
     else if cv>=65 & cv<=70 then cn=cv-55
     else if cv>=97 & cv<=102 then cn=cv-87
     else return 'ERROR'
     cneed=cneed*16+cn
    end
    if cneed>1048576 then return 'ERROR'
    if cneed=0 then do
     cstate='DONE'; chunkdone=1; cwork=''
    end
    else cstate='DATA'
   end
  end
  else if cstate='DATA' then do
   cavail=length(cwork)%2
   ctake=cneed
   if ctake>cavail then ctake=cavail
   if ctake=0 then return 'OK'
   cpiece=left(cwork,ctake*2)
   cwork=substr(cwork,ctake*2+1)
   call pktfeed_push cpiece
   if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
   cneed=cneed-ctake
   if cneed=0 then do
    cstate='CRLF'; ccrlf=''
   end
  end
  else if cstate='CRLF' then do
   ctake=4-length(ccrlf)
   if ctake>length(cwork) then ctake=length(cwork)
   ccrlf=ccrlf||left(cwork,ctake)
   cwork=substr(cwork,ctake+1)
   if length(ccrlf)=4 then do
    if ccrlf\='0D0A' then return 'ERROR'
    ccrlf=''; cstate='SIZE'
   end
  end
  else if cstate='DONE' then cwork=''
  else return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

pktfeed_push:
 /* Reassemble complete pkt-lines (hex) into pushresp. */
 parse arg pwork
 pwork=translate(pwork)
 do while pwork\=''
  if pstate='HDR' then do
   ptake=8-length(phdr)
   if ptake>length(pwork) then ptake=length(pwork)
   phdr=phdr||left(pwork,ptake)
   pwork=substr(pwork,ptake+1)
   if length(phdr)<8 then iterate
   call pktlen phdr
   pn=result
   if pn='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
   if pn=0 then do
    pushresp.0=pushresp.0+1; _px=pushresp.0
    pushresp._px='0000'
    phdr=''; iterate
   end
   pneed=(pn-4)*2
   ppkt=phdr
   phdr=''
   if pneed=0 then do
    pushresp.0=pushresp.0+1; _px=pushresp.0
    pushresp._px=ppkt; ppkt=''
    iterate
   end
   pstate='BODY'
  end
  else if pstate='BODY' then do
   ptake=pneed
   if ptake>length(pwork) then ptake=length(pwork)
   ppkt=ppkt||left(pwork,ptake)
   pwork=substr(pwork,ptake+1)
   pneed=pneed-ptake
   if pneed=0 then do
    pushresp.0=pushresp.0+1; _px=pushresp.0
    pushresp._px=ppkt
    ppkt=''; pstate='HDR'
   end
  end
  else return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

sendpackbuf: procedure expose s
   /* Send one decoded pack buffer, retrying partial writes. */
   address cms
   parse arg bhx pline
   br=x2c(bhx)
   boff=1
   do while boff<=length(br)
      bchunk=substr(br,boff)
      r=Socket('Send',s,bchunk)
      parse var r bsrc bsent
      if bsrc\=0 | bsent<=0 then do
         say 'GIT PUSH: send failed (pack) pi='pline 'src='bsrc,
             'sent='bsent
         return 'ERROR'
      end
      boff=boff+bsent
   end
   return 'OK'
