statepairs:
 drop trno. trchild. trparent. trcount. trstatus.
 drop tradmin. tradmax. trcdmin. trcdmax.
 drop trapos. trazero. traneg. trcpos. trczero. trcneg.
 trpairs=0
 trtotal=0
 trchanged=0
 do ei=1 to sedgecount
  ec=sedgechild.ei
  ep=sedgeparent.ei
  cv=snodever.ec
  pv=snodever.ep
  ad=sauthorwhen.ec-sauthorwhen.ep
  cd=scommitwhen.ec-scommitwhen.ep
  tk=cv||'.'||pv
  ti=trno.tk
  if datatype(ti,'W')\=1 then do
   trpairs=trpairs+1
   ti=trpairs
   trno.tk=ti
   trchild.ti=cv
   trparent.ti=pv
   trcount.ti=0
   trapos.ti=0
   trazero.ti=0
   traneg.ti=0
   trcpos.ti=0
   trczero.ti=0
   trcneg.ti=0
   if cv=pv then trstatus.ti='UNCHANGED'
   else if cv>0 & pv=0 then trstatus.ti='ADDED'
   else if cv=0 & pv>0 then trstatus.ti='DELETED'
   else trstatus.ti='MODIFIED'
   if trstatus.ti\='UNCHANGED' then trchanged=trchanged+1
  end
  trcount.ti=trcount.ti+1
  if trcount.ti=1 then do
   tradmin.ti=ad
   tradmax.ti=ad
   trcdmin.ti=cd
   trcdmax.ti=cd
  end
  else do
   if ad<tradmin.ti then tradmin.ti=ad
   if ad>tradmax.ti then tradmax.ti=ad
   if cd<trcdmin.ti then trcdmin.ti=cd
   if cd>trcdmax.ti then trcdmax.ti=cd
  end
  if ad>0 then trapos.ti=trapos.ti+1
  else if ad=0 then trazero.ti=trazero.ti+1
  else traneg.ti=traneg.ti+1
  if cd>0 then trcpos.ti=trcpos.ti+1
  else if cd=0 then trczero.ti=trczero.ti+1
  else trcneg.ti=trcneg.ti+1
 end
 do ti=1 to trpairs
  trtotal=trtotal+trcount.ti
  if trapos.ti+trazero.ti+traneg.ti\=trcount.ti then,
   return 'ERROR'
  if trcpos.ti+trczero.ti+trcneg.ti\=trcount.ti then,
   return 'ERROR'
 end
 if trtotal\=sedgecount then return 'ERROR'
 if schanged=0 & trchanged\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 if schanged>0 & trchanged=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

changecheck:
 pathoids=0
 parsednodes=0
 distinct=0
 edgecount=0
 nodes=-1
 edges=-1
 drop seen. seencommit. version. freq. mindepth. maxdepth.
 drop mincommit. maxcommit. vtype. vsize. depthseen.
 drop vcommit. vdepth. vnode. vtree. nodeversion.
 drop nodecommit. nodedepth. nodetree.
 drop edgechild. edgeparent. edgekey. parentseen.
 curnode=-1
 curdepth=-1
 curcommit=''
 curtree=''
 curtype=-1
 cursize=-1
 havecommit=1
 havetree=1
 havemeta=1
 havepath=1
 do ci=1 to out.0
  if left(out.ci,20)='HISTORYDAGPATH NODE ' then do
   if havepath=0 | havecommit=0 | havetree=0 | havemeta=0 then,
    return 'ERROR'
   parsednodes=parsednodes+1
   curnode=word(out.ci,3)
   if datatype(curnode,'W')\=1 then return 'ERROR'
   if curnode\=parsednodes | curnode>64 then return 'ERROR'
   havecommit=0
   havetree=0
   havemeta=0
   havepath=0
   curcommit=''
   curtree=''
   curtype=-1
   cursize=-1
   curdepth=word(out.ci,5)
   if datatype(curdepth,'W')\=1 then return 'ERROR'
   if curdepth<0 | curdepth>8 then return 'ERROR'
  end
  if left(out.ci,22)='HISTORYDAGPATH COMMIT ' then do
   if havecommit=1 | curnode<1 then return 'ERROR'
   curcommit=translate(word(out.ci,3))
   if length(curcommit)\=40 then return 'ERROR'
   if verify(curcommit,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   if seencommit.curcommit=1 then return 'ERROR'
   seencommit.curcommit=1
   havecommit=1
  end
  if left(out.ci,20)='HISTORYDAGPATH TREE ' then do
   if havetree=1 | havecommit=0 then return 'ERROR'
   curtree=translate(word(out.ci,3))
   if length(curtree)\=40 then return 'ERROR'
   if verify(curtree,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   havetree=1
  end
  if left(out.ci,25)='HISTORYDAGPATH PATH TYPE ' then do
   if havemeta=1 | havecommit=0 | havetree=0 then return 'ERROR'
   if word(out.ci,5)\='SIZE' then return 'ERROR'
   curtype=word(out.ci,4)
   cursize=word(out.ci,6)
   if datatype(curtype,'W')\=1 then return 'ERROR'
   if curtype<1 | curtype>3 then return 'ERROR'
   if datatype(cursize,'W')\=1 | cursize<0 then return 'ERROR'
   havemeta=1
  end
  if left(out.ci,23)='HISTORYDAGPATH PATHOID ' then do
   if havepath=1 then return 'ERROR'
   poid=translate(word(out.ci,3))
   if length(poid)\=40 then return 'ERROR'
   if verify(poid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   if curnode<1 | curdepth<0 | havecommit=0 | havetree=0 |,
      havemeta=0 then return 'ERROR'
   havepath=1
   pathoids=pathoids+1
   vi=seen.poid
   if datatype(vi,'W')\=1 then do
    distinct=distinct+1
    seen.poid=distinct
    vi=distinct
    version.distinct=poid
    freq.distinct=1
    mindepth.distinct=curdepth
    maxdepth.distinct=curdepth
    mincommit.distinct=curcommit
    maxcommit.distinct=curcommit
    vtype.distinct=curtype
    vsize.distinct=cursize
    depthseen.distinct.curdepth=1
    vcommit.distinct.1=curcommit
    vdepth.distinct.1=curdepth
    vnode.distinct.1=curnode
    vtree.distinct.1=curtree
   end
   else do
    if vtype.vi\=curtype | vsize.vi\=cursize then return 'ERROR'
    freq.vi=freq.vi+1
    depthseen.vi.curdepth=1
    vcidx=freq.vi
    vcommit.vi.vcidx=curcommit
    vdepth.vi.vcidx=curdepth
    vnode.vi.vcidx=curnode
    vtree.vi.vcidx=curtree
    if curdepth<mindepth.vi then do
     mindepth.vi=curdepth
     mincommit.vi=curcommit
    end
    if curdepth>maxdepth.vi then do
     maxdepth.vi=curdepth
     maxcommit.vi=curcommit
    end
   end
   nodeversion.curnode=vi
   nodecommit.curnode=curcommit
   nodedepth.curnode=curdepth
   nodetree.curnode=curtree
  end
  if words(out.ci)=6 & word(out.ci,1)='HISTORYDAGPATH' &,
     word(out.ci,2)='EDGE' then do
   if word(out.ci,3)\='CHILD' | word(out.ci,5)\='PARENT' then,
    return 'ERROR'
   ec=word(out.ci,4)
   ep=word(out.ci,6)
   if datatype(ec,'W')\=1 | datatype(ep,'W')\=1 then return 'ERROR'
   if ec<1 | ep<1 | ec>parsednodes | ep>parsednodes then return 'ERROR'
   if ec=ep then return 'ERROR'
   if edgekey.ec.ep=1 then return 'ERROR'
   edgekey.ec.ep=1
   edgecount=edgecount+1
   edgechild.edgecount=ec
   edgeparent.edgecount=ep
   parentseen.ep=1
  end
  if words(out.ci)=3 & word(out.ci,1)='HISTORYDAGPATH' &,
     word(out.ci,2)='EDGES' then do
   if edges\=-1 then return 'ERROR'
   edges=word(out.ci,3)
   if datatype(edges,'W')\=1 | edges<0 then return 'ERROR'
   if edges\=edgecount then return 'ERROR'
  end
  if left(out.ci,21)='HISTORYDAGPATH NODES ' then do
   if nodes\=-1 then return 'ERROR'
   nodes=word(out.ci,3)
   if datatype(nodes,'W')\=1 | nodes<1 then return 'ERROR'
  end
 end
 if havepath=0 | havecommit=0 | havetree=0 | havemeta=0 then,
  return 'ERROR'
 if edges<0 | edges\=edgecount then return 'ERROR'
 if nodes<1 | pathoids\=nodes then return 'ERROR'
 if parsednodes\=nodes then return 'ERROR'
 if parentseen.1=1 then return 'ERROR'
 do ni=2 to nodes
  if parentseen.ni\=1 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

readrefs:
 drop rr. refname. refoid.
 headref=''
 refcount=0
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITREF2 REPO G 1 (STEM RR. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then do
  say 'GITVREF: GITREF2 REPO G not found'
  return 'ERROR'
 end
 if rr.0<2 | rr.1\='REF2 1' then do
  say 'GITVREF: invalid REF2 header'
  return 'ERROR'
 end
 do i=2 to rr.0
  if word(rr.i,1)='HEAD' then do
   if words(rr.i)\=2 then return 'ERROR'
   /* Older writers could leave an identical duplicate HEAD record.
      Accept that unambiguous state; reject conflicting HEAD targets. */
   if headref='' then headref=word(rr.i,2)
   else if headref\=word(rr.i,2) then return 'ERROR'
  end
  else if word(rr.i,1)='REF' then do
   if words(rr.i)\=3 then return 'ERROR'
   name=word(rr.i,2)
   oid=translate(word(rr.i,3))
   call validref name
   if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
   if length(oid)\=40 then return 'ERROR'
   if verify(oid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   do j=1 to refcount
    if refname.j=name then return 'ERROR'
   end
   refcount=refcount+1
   refname.refcount=name
   refoid.refcount=oid
  end
  else return 'ERROR'
 end
 if left(headref,11)\='refs/heads/' then return 'ERROR'
 call validref headref
 if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

resolve:
 parse arg wanted
 rawwanted=wanted
 if translate(wanted)='HEAD' then wanted=headref
 shortname=''
 if left(wanted,11)\='refs/heads/' &,
    left(wanted,10)\='refs/tags/' &,
    translate(wanted)\='HEAD' then do
  shortname=wanted
  wanted='refs/heads/'||shortname
 end
 do i=1 to refcount
  if refname.i=wanted then do
   reskind='REF'
   return refoid.i
  end
 end
 if shortname\='' then do
  wanted='refs/tags/'||shortname
  do i=1 to refcount
   if refname.i=wanted then do
    reskind='REF'
    return refoid.i
   end
  end
 end
 direct=translate(rawwanted)
 if length(direct)=40 & verify(direct,'0123456789ABCDEF')=0 then do
  call directinput command
  if result=1 then do
   reskind='COMMIT'
   return direct
  end
 end
 say 'GITVREF: ref not found' wanted
 return 'ERROR'

validref:
 procedure
 /* Private vars: this routine is a PROCEDURE, so writing NAME here cannot
    clobber the full ref name readrefs stores across the call. */
 parse arg vr
 if length(vr)>35 then return 'ERROR'
 if left(vr,11)='refs/heads/' then do
  name=substr(vr,12)
  refchars='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
  refchars=refchars||'0123456789._/-'
  if name='' | verify(name,refchars)\=0 |,
     pos('//',name)>0 | pos('..',name)>0 |,
     left(name,1)='/' | right(name,1)='/' then return 'ERROR'
  do vi=1 to words(translate(name,' ','/'))
   part=word(translate(name,' ','/'),vi)
   if part='' | part='.' | part='..' | left(part,1)='.' |,
      right(part,1)='.' | right(part,5)='.lock' then return 'ERROR'
  end
  return 'OK'
 end
 else if left(vr,13)='refs/remotes/' then do
  vrname=substr(vr,14)
  vrslash=pos('/',vrname)
  if vrslash<2 then return 'ERROR'
  vrremote=left(vrname,vrslash-1)
  vrbranch=substr(vrname,vrslash+1)
  remotechars='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
  remotechars=remotechars||'0123456789._-'
  if length(vrremote)>16 | verify(vrremote,remotechars)\=0 |,
     vrremote='.' | vrremote='..' | pos('..',vrremote)>0 |,
     left(vrremote,1)='.' | right(vrremote,1)='.' then return 'ERROR'
  refchars='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
  refchars=refchars||'0123456789._/-'
  if vrbranch='' | verify(vrbranch,refchars)\=0 |,
     pos('//',vrbranch)>0 | pos('..',vrbranch)>0 |,
     left(vrbranch,1)='/' | right(vrbranch,1)='/' then return 'ERROR'
  do vrvi=1 to words(translate(vrbranch,' ','/'))
   vrpart=word(translate(vrbranch,' ','/'),vrvi)
   if vrpart='' | vrpart='.' | vrpart='..' | left(vrpart,1)='.' |,
      right(vrpart,1)='.' | right(vrpart,5)='.lock' then return 'ERROR'
  end
  return 'OK'
 end
 else if left(vr,10)='refs/tags/' then vrname=substr(vr,11)
 else return 'ERROR'
 refchars='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
 refchars=refchars||'0123456789._/-'
 if vrname='' | verify(vrname,refchars)\=0 | pos('//',vrname)>0 |,
    pos('..',vrname)>0 | left(vrname,1)='/' | right(vrname,1)='/' |,
    right(vrname,1)='.' | right(vrname,5)='.lock' then return 'ERROR'
 do vrvi=1 to words(translate(vrname,' ','/'))
  vrpart=word(translate(vrname,' ','/'),vrvi)
  if left(vrpart,1)='.' | right(vrpart,1)='.' |,
     right(vrpart,5)='.lock' then return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

validremotename:

 allowed='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'

buildfirstparent:
 drop fpseen. fpnode.
 fpcount=1
 fpnode.1=1
 fpseen.1=1
 cur=1
 truncated=0
 do forever
  if sdepth.cur>=depth then do
   if sparents.cur>0 then truncated=1
   leave
  end
  if sparents.cur=0 then leave
  next=sfirstnode.cur
  if datatype(next,'W')\=1 | next<1 | next>snodes then,
   return 'ERROR'
  if fpseen.next=1 then return 'ERROR'
  edgeok=0
  do ei=1 to sedgecount
   if sedgechild.ei=cur & sedgeparent.ei=next then do
    edgeok=1
    leave
   end
  end
  if edgeok=0 then return 'ERROR'
  fpcount=fpcount+1
  fpnode.fpcount=next
  fpseen.next=1
  cur=next
 end
 chainedges=fpcount-1
 offnodes=snodes-fpcount
 offedges=sedgecount-chainedges
 if offnodes<0 | offedges<0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

 end

preparefirstdiffs:
 call buildfirstparent
 if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 drop fdstatus.
 fdadd=0
 fddelete=0
 fdmodify=0
 fdunchanged=0
 fdchanged=0
 fdmin=9
 fdmax=-1
 fdnear=0
 do fi=1 to chainedges
  ec=fpnode.fi
  fj=fi+1
  ep=fpnode.fj
  cp=spresent.ec
  pp=spresent.ep
  if cp=1 & pp=1 then do
   if soid.ec=soid.ep then fdstatus.fi='UNCHANGED'
   else fdstatus.fi='MODIFIED'
  end
  else if cp=1 & pp=0 then fdstatus.fi='ADDED'
  else if cp=0 & pp=1 then fdstatus.fi='DELETED'
  else fdstatus.fi='UNCHANGED'
  if fdstatus.fi='ADDED' then fdadd=fdadd+1
  else if fdstatus.fi='DELETED' then fddelete=fddelete+1
  else if fdstatus.fi='MODIFIED' then fdmodify=fdmodify+1
  else fdunchanged=fdunchanged+1
  if fdstatus.fi\='UNCHANGED' then do
   fdchanged=fdchanged+1
   d=sdepth.ec
   if d<fdmin then do
    fdmin=d
    fdnear=1
   end
   else if d=fdmin then fdnear=fdnear+1
   if d>fdmax then fdmax=d
  end
 end
 if fdadd+fddelete+fdmodify+fdunchanged\=chainedges then,
  return 'ERROR'
 if fdchanged\=fdadd+fddelete+fdmodify then return 'ERROR'
 if fdchanged+fdunchanged\=chainedges then return 'ERROR'
 if fdchanged=0 then do
  fdmin=-1
  fdmax=-1
  fdnear=0
  fdoverall='UNCHANGED'
 end
 else do
  if fdmin<0 | fdmin>8 | fdmax<fdmin | fdmax>8 then,
   return 'ERROR'
  if fdnear<1 | fdnear>fdchanged then return 'ERROR'
  fdoverall='CHANGED'
 end
 return 'OK'

   fvabsent=fvabsent+1
   fvnodever.fi=0

  fvpresent=fvpresent+1

   fvversions=fvversions+1

preparefirstpresence:
 call preparefirstruns
 if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 drop prstate. prstart. prend. prnodes. prexact. prvers.
 drop pseen.
 prruns=0
 prev=-1
 do fi=1 to fpcount
  ni=fpnode.fi
  ps=spresent.ni
  if fi=1 | ps\=prev then do
   prruns=prruns+1
   prstate.prruns=ps
   prstart.prruns=fi
   prend.prruns=fi
   prnodes.prruns=1
   prexact.prruns=1
   prvers.prruns=0
  end
  else do
   prend.prruns=fi
   prnodes.prruns=prnodes.prruns+1
   pj=fi-1
   if fvnodever.fi\=fvnodever.pj then,
    prexact.prruns=prexact.prruns+1
  end
  if ps=1 then do
   vi=fvnodever.fi
   if vi<1 | vi>fvversions then return 'ERROR'
   if pseen.prruns.vi\=1 then do
    pseen.prruns.vi=1
    prvers.prruns=prvers.prruns+1
   end
  end
  prev=ps
 end
 if prruns<1 | prruns>fpcount then return 'ERROR'
 total=0
 exacttotal=0
 do ri=1 to prruns
  total=total+prnodes.ri
  exacttotal=exacttotal+prexact.ri
  if prstart.ri<1 | prend.ri<prstart.ri then return 'ERROR'
  if prend.ri>fpcount then return 'ERROR'
  if prnodes.ri\=prend.ri-prstart.ri+1 then return 'ERROR'
  if prexact.ri<1 | prexact.ri>prnodes.ri then return 'ERROR'
  if prstate.ri=0 & prvers.ri\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  if prstate.ri=1 & prvers.ri<1 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 if total\=fpcount then return 'ERROR'
 if exacttotal\=frruns then return 'ERROR'
 prtrans=prruns-1
 prexistchanges=fdadd+fddelete
 if prtrans\=prexistchanges then return 'ERROR'
 if frruns-prruns\=fdmodify then return 'ERROR'
 do ri=1 to prtrans
  fi=prend.ri
  if fi<1 | fi>chainedges then return 'ERROR'
  if fdstatus.fi\='ADDED' & fdstatus.fi\='DELETED' then,
   return 'ERROR'
  rj=ri+1
  if prstart.rj\=fi+1 then return 'ERROR'
  if prstate.ri=prstate.rj then return 'ERROR'
 end
 if prexistchanges>0 then prexiststatus='CHANGED'
 else prexiststatus='UNCHANGED'
 return 'OK'

   ptkind.ri='ROOT'
   ptcomplete.ri=1
   if sparents.ne\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   rj=ri-1
   ee=prend.rj
   if ee<1 | ee>chainedges then return 'ERROR'
   en=fpnode.ee
   if prstate.ri=1 then do
    if fdstatus.ee\='DELETED' then return 'ERROR'
   end
   else if fdstatus.ee\='ADDED' then return 'ERROR'
   ptauth.ri=sauthorwhen.en-sauthorwhen.ne
   ptcomm.ri=scommitwhen.en-scommitwhen.ne
  end
  else do
   ptkind.ri='TRUNCATED'
   ptauth.ri=ptaobs.ri
   ptcomm.ri=ptcobs.ri
  end
  if ptcomplete.ri=1 then do
   ptcompletecount=ptcompletecount+1
   if prstate.ri=1 then do
    ptpresentruns=ptpresentruns+1
    ptpresentauth=ptpresentauth+ptauth.ri
    ptpresentcomm=ptpresentcomm+ptcomm.ri
   end
   else do
    ptabseruns=ptabseruns+1
    ptabsenauth=ptabsenauth+ptauth.ri
    ptabsencomm=ptabsencomm+ptcomm.ri
   end
  end
  else ptincomplete=ptincomplete+1
 end
 if ptcompletecount+ptincomplete\=prruns then return 'ERROR'
 if ptcompletecount\=prruns-truncated then return 'ERROR'
 if ptincomplete\=truncated then return 'ERROR'
 if ptpresentruns+ptabseruns\=ptcompletecount then return 'ERROR'

 pfenddepth=-1

 pffrontieredge=0
 pffrontierstatus='NONE'
 if truncated=0 then do
  if ptincomplete\=0 | pcinodes\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  return 'OK'
 end
 if truncated\=1 | ptincomplete\=1 then return 'ERROR'
 pfincrun=prruns
 if ptcomplete.pfincrun\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 if pfincrun=1 then do
  if ptkind.pfincrun\='CURRENT' then return 'ERROR'
 end
 else if ptkind.pfincrun\='TRUNCATED' then return 'ERROR'
 pfstate=prstate.pfincrun
 if pfstate=0 then pfs='ABSENT'
 else if pfstate=1 then pfs='PRESENT'
 else return 'ERROR'
 pfkind=ptkind.pfincrun
 pfnodes=prnodes.pfincrun
 pfstart=prstart.pfincrun
 pfend=prend.pfincrun
 if pfstart<1 | pfend<pfstart | pfend\=fpcount then return 'ERROR'
 sn=fpnode.pfstart
 en=fpnode.pfend
 pfstartdepth=sdepth.sn
 pfenddepth=sdepth.en
 if pfnodes\=pfend-pfstart+1 then return 'ERROR'
 if pfincrun>1 then do
  pfhasfrontier=1
  pfcompletestep=pfstart-1
  if pfcompletestep<1 | pfcompletestep>fpcount then return 'ERROR'
  cn=fpnode.pfcompletestep
  pfcompletedepth=sdepth.cn
  pffrontieredge=pfcompletestep
  if pffrontieredge<1 | pffrontieredge>chainedges then,
   return 'ERROR'
  fe=pffrontieredge
  pffrontierstatus=fdstatus.fe
  if pffrontierstatus\='ADDED' &,
     pffrontierstatus\='DELETED' then return 'ERROR'

   if pffrontierstatus\='DELETED' then return 'ERROR'
  end
  else if pffrontierstatus\='ADDED' then return 'ERROR'
 end
 else do
  if ptcompletecount\=0 | pccnodes\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

tagmatch:
 parse arg tagpattern, tagvalue
 tagp=1
 tagv=1
 tagstar=0
 tagretry=0
 do while tagv<=length(tagvalue)
  if tagp<=length(tagpattern) then do
   tagpc=substr(tagpattern,tagp,1)
   tagvc=substr(tagvalue,tagv,1)
   if tagpc='?' | tagpc=tagvc then do
    tagp=tagp+1
    tagv=tagv+1
    iterate
   end
   if tagpc='*' then do
    tagstar=tagp
    tagp=tagp+1
    tagretry=tagv
    iterate
   end
  end
  if tagstar>0 then do
   tagp=tagstar+1
   tagretry=tagretry+1
   tagv=tagretry
   iterate
  end
  return 'NO'
 end
 do while tagp<=length(tagpattern) &,
    substr(tagpattern,tagp,1)='*'
  tagp=tagp+1
 end
 if tagp>length(tagpattern) then return 'MATCH'
 return 'NO'

tagbefore:
 parse arg tagleft, tagright
 tagorder='-./0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
 do tagci=1 to min(length(tagleft),length(tagright))
  taglc=pos(substr(tagleft,tagci,1),tagorder)
  tagrc=pos(substr(tagright,tagci,1),tagorder)
  if taglc<tagrc then return 'YES'
  if taglc>tagrc then return 'NO'
 end
 if length(tagleft)<length(tagright) then return 'YES'
 return 'NO'

bindnative:
 'FILEDEF SEL0 DISK M15SL0 PTR G'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 'FILEDEF SEL1 DISK M15SL1 PTR G'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 do i=1 to 4
  typ=word('STAGE INDEX SEEK GEN',i)
  dd=word('C0STG C0IDX C0SEEK C0GEN',i)
  'FILEDEF' dd 'DISK GITFIX' typ 'A'
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  dd=word('C1STG C1IDX C1SEEK C1GEN',i)
  'FILEDEF' dd 'DISK M15NEW' typ 'A'
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

/* Resolve the repository's object disk from GITMETA.  Returns NATIVE when
   no GITMETA exists (legacy layout), ERROR when it is malformed, otherwise
   the single validated filemode. */
objectdisk:
 'STATE GITMETA REPO G'
 if rc=28 then return 'NATIVE'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 drop od_meta.
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITMETA REPO G 1 (STEM OD_META. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | od_meta.0<1 |,
    od_meta.1\='CMS-GIT-REPOSITORY 1' then return 'ERROR'
 od_fm='A'
 od_seen=0
 do od_i=1 to od_meta.0
  if word(od_meta.od_i,1)='OBJECT-DISK' then do
   if words(od_meta.od_i)\=2 then return 'ERROR'
   od_seen=od_seen+1
   od_fm=translate(word(od_meta.od_i,2))
  end
 end
 if od_seen>1 | length(od_fm)\=1 |,
    verify(od_fm,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return od_fm

/* Loose-store GIT LOG fallback.  Returns OK after verifying a bounded
   first-parent log, ERROR on malformed or missing objects, or NATIVE
   when the starting commit is not in the activated loose store.
   Commits and trees are re-hashed.  Blob contents were hashed when the
   installer activated them; re-hashing them in REXX is far too slow, so
   this path verifies each blob's recorded OID, type, size and DATA
   length instead of recomputing its SHA-1. */
trylooselog:
 call objectdisk
 if result='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
 if result='NATIVE' then return 'NATIVE'
 ll_fm=result
 ll_probe=substr(oid,1,8)
 'STATE' ll_probe 'GITOBJ' ll_fm
 if rc=28 then return 'NATIVE'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 drop ll_oid. ll_tree. ll_hex. ll_size.
 ll_count=0
 ll_cur=oid
 do ll_hop=0 to depth
  ll_id=ll_cur
  ll_ofm=ll_fm
  call readllobj
  if result='MISSING' then do
   say 'LOG COMMIT NOT FOUND'
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  if rlo_type\='COMMIT' then return 'ERROR'
  ll_count=ll_count+1
  ll_oid.ll_count=ll_id
  ll_tree.ll_count=rlo_tree
  ll_hex.ll_count=rlo_hex
  ll_size.ll_count=rlo_size
  if ll_hop=depth then leave
  if rlo_parent='' then leave
  ll_cur=rlo_parent
 end
 if ll_count<1 then return 'ERROR'
 ll_vfm=ll_fm
 drop ll_bseen. ll_tseen.
 do ll_vi=1 to ll_count
  ll_vroot=ll_tree.ll_vi
  call verifylltree
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 end
 call emitverified
 say 'LOG LOOSE SNAPSHOTS VERIFIED'
 say 'LOG DATA BEGIN'
 do ll_ni=1 to ll_count
  say 'LOG NODE' ll_ni-1 'OID' ll_oid.ll_ni
  call emitllcommit ll_hex.ll_ni,ll_size.ll_ni
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 end
 say 'LOG NODES' ll_count
 say 'LOG DATA END'
 return 'OK'

/* Loose-store GIT SHOW fallback.  Returns OK after verifying the commit,
   its complete bounded root tree/blob closure, and a re-read/re-hash of
   the commit, ERROR on malformed or missing objects, or NATIVE when the
   requested commit is not in the activated loose store. */
trylooseshow:
 call objectdisk
 if result='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
 if result='NATIVE' then return 'NATIVE'
 ls_fm=result
 ls_probe=substr(oid,1,8)
 'STATE' ls_probe 'GITOBJ' ls_fm
 if rc=28 then return 'NATIVE'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 ll_id=oid
 ll_ofm=ls_fm
 call readllobj
 if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 if rlo_type\='COMMIT' then return 'ERROR'
 ls_tree=rlo_tree
 ls_hex=rlo_hex
 ls_size=rlo_size
 ll_vfm=ls_fm
 drop ll_tseen. ll_bseen.
 ll_vroot=ls_tree
 call verifylltree
 if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 /* Re-read and re-hash the commit after closure verification. */
 ll_id=oid
 ll_ofm=ls_fm
 call readllobj
 if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 if rlo_type\='COMMIT' then return 'ERROR'
 if rlo_tree\=ls_tree then return 'ERROR'
 call emitverified
 say 'SHOW FULL ROOT CLOSURE VERIFIED'
 call emitllcommit ls_hex,ls_size
 if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

/* Read and verify one loose object; parse commit tree/parent links. */
readllobj:
 rlo_type=''
 rlo_hex=''
 rlo_size=0
 rlo_tree=''
 rlo_parent=''
 rlo_msgbytes=0
 if length(ll_id)\=40 |,
    verify(ll_id,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 ll_fn=substr(ll_id,1,8)
 'STATE' ll_fn 'GITOBJ' ll_ofm
 if rc=28 then return 'MISSING'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 ll_vcmd='GIT VERIFY-OBJECT' ll_id
 drop ll_vout.
 ll_vout.0=0
 'PIPE CMS' ll_vcmd '| STEM LL_VOUT.'
 if rc\=0 | ll_vout.0\=1 |,
    strip(ll_vout.1)\=ll_id 'OK' then return 'ERROR'
 drop rlo_obj.
 'EXECIO * DISKR' ll_fn 'GITOBJ' ll_ofm '1 (STEM RLO_OBJ. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | rlo_obj.0<3 then return 'ERROR'
 if words(rlo_obj.1)\=2 | word(rlo_obj.1,1)\='OID' |,
    translate(word(rlo_obj.1,2))\=ll_id |,
    words(rlo_obj.2)\=2 | word(rlo_obj.2,1)\='TYPE' |,
    words(rlo_obj.3)\=2 | word(rlo_obj.3,1)\='SIZE' then,
  return 'ERROR'
 rlo_type=translate(word(rlo_obj.2,2))
 if rlo_type\='BLOB' & rlo_type\='TREE' &,
    rlo_type\='COMMIT' then return 'ERROR'
 rlo_size=word(rlo_obj.3,2)
 if datatype(rlo_size,'W')\=1 | rlo_size<0 |,
    rlo_size>16777216 then return 'ERROR'
 rlo_hex=''
 do rlo_i=4 to rlo_obj.0
  if words(rlo_obj.rlo_i)\=2 |,
     word(rlo_obj.rlo_i,1)\='DATA' then return 'ERROR'
  rlo_chunk=translate(word(rlo_obj.rlo_i,2))
  if rlo_chunk='' | length(rlo_chunk)>128 |,
     length(rlo_chunk)//2\=0 |,
     verify(rlo_chunk,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  rlo_hex=rlo_hex||rlo_chunk
 end
 if length(rlo_hex)\=rlo_size*2 then return 'ERROR'
 if rlo_type='COMMIT' then do
  call parsecommit
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

/* Extract tree, first parent and message length from a commit header. */
parsecommit:
 rlo_tree=''
 rlo_parent=''
 rlo_msgbytes=0
 if rlo_size<1 then return 'ERROR'
 pc_sep=pos('0A0A',rlo_hex)
 if pc_sep=0 then return 'ERROR'
 pc_hdr=left(rlo_hex,pc_sep-1)
 if length(pc_hdr)<90 | length(pc_hdr)//2\=0 |,
    left(pc_hdr,10)\='7472656520' then return 'ERROR'
 call asciitocms substr(pc_hdr,11,80)
 pc_tree=translate(result)
 if length(pc_tree)\=40 |,
    verify(pc_tree,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 pc_rest=substr(pc_hdr,93)
 if pc_rest\='' & substr(pc_hdr,91,2)\='0A' then return 'ERROR'
 pc_first=''
 do while left(pc_rest,14)='706172656E7420'
  if length(pc_rest)<94 then return 'ERROR'
  call asciitocms substr(pc_rest,15,80)
  pc_oid=translate(result)
  if length(pc_oid)\=40 |,
     verify(pc_oid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  if pc_first='' then pc_first=pc_oid
  if length(pc_rest)=94 then pc_rest=''
  else do
   if length(pc_rest)<96 |,
      substr(pc_rest,95,2)\='0A' then return 'ERROR'
   pc_rest=substr(pc_rest,97)
  end
 end
 pc_msg=rlo_size-((pc_sep-1)%2)-2
 if pc_msg<0 then return 'ERROR'
 rlo_tree=pc_tree
 rlo_parent=pc_first
 rlo_msgbytes=pc_msg
 return 'OK'

/* Emit the COMMIT metadata records the native LOGFULL path produces. */
emitllcommit:
 parse arg ec_hex,ec_size
 ec_sep=pos('0A0A',ec_hex)
 if ec_sep=0 then return 'ERROR'
 ec_hdr=left(ec_hex,ec_sep-1)
 if length(ec_hdr)<90 | length(ec_hdr)//2\=0 |,
    left(ec_hdr,10)\='7472656520' then return 'ERROR'
 call asciitocms substr(ec_hdr,11,80)
 ec_tree=translate(result)
 if length(ec_tree)\=40 |,
    verify(ec_tree,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 ec_rest=substr(ec_hdr,93)
 if ec_rest\='' & substr(ec_hdr,91,2)\='0A' then return 'ERROR'
 drop ec_oid.
 ec_count=0
 do while left(ec_rest,14)='706172656E7420'
  if length(ec_rest)<94 then return 'ERROR'
  call asciitocms substr(ec_rest,15,80)
  ec_oid=translate(result)
  if length(ec_oid)\=40 |,
     verify(ec_oid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  ec_count=ec_count+1
  ec_oid.ec_count=ec_oid
  if length(ec_rest)=94 then ec_rest=''
  else do
   if length(ec_rest)<96 |,
      substr(ec_rest,95,2)\='0A' then return 'ERROR'
   ec_rest=substr(ec_rest,97)
  end
 end
 ec_msg=ec_size-((ec_sep-1)%2)-2
 if ec_msg<0 then return 'ERROR'
 say 'COMMIT DATA BEGIN'
 say 'COMMIT TREE' ec_tree
 do ec_i=1 to ec_count
  say 'COMMIT PARENT' ec_oid.ec_i
 end
 say 'COMMIT PARENTS' ec_count
 say 'COMMIT MESSAGE BYTES' ec_msg
 say 'COMMIT DATA END'
 return 'OK'

/* Verify one tree and its complete bounded local tree/blob closure.
   Results are cached for the life of one LOG run so unchanged paths are
   not reread for every commit snapshot. */
verifylltree:
 if ll_tseen.ll_vroot='OK' then return 'OK'
 drop vt_stack.
 vt_top=1
 vt_stack.1=ll_vroot
 vt_trees=0
 do while vt_top>0
  vt_cur=vt_stack.vt_top
  vt_top=vt_top-1
  vt_trees=vt_trees+1
  if vt_trees>1024 then return 'ERROR'
  ll_id=vt_cur
  ll_ofm=ll_vfm
  call readllobj
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  if rlo_type\='TREE' then return 'ERROR'
  call parsetree rlo_hex
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  do vt_i=1 to vt_count
   if vt_mode.vt_i='40000' then do
    vt_top=vt_top+1
    if vt_top>1024 then return 'ERROR'
    vt_stack.vt_top=vt_oid.vt_i
   end
   else if vt_mode.vt_i='100644' |,
           vt_mode.vt_i='100755' |,
           vt_mode.vt_i='120000' then do
    ll_id=vt_oid.vt_i
    call verifyllblob
    if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
   end
   else if vt_mode.vt_i='160000' then nop
   else return 'ERROR'
  end
 end
 ll_tseen.ll_vroot='OK'
 return 'OK'

verifyllblob:
 if ll_bseen.ll_id='OK' then return 'OK'
 if length(ll_id)\=40 |,
    verify(ll_id,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 ll_fn=substr(ll_id,1,8)
 'STATE' ll_fn 'GITOBJ' ll_ofm
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 drop vb.
 'EXECIO * DISKR' ll_fn 'GITOBJ' ll_ofm '1 (STEM VB. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | vb.0<3 then return 'ERROR'
 if words(vb.1)\=2 | word(vb.1,1)\='OID' |,
    translate(word(vb.1,2))\=ll_id then return 'ERROR'
 if words(vb.2)\=2 | word(vb.2,1)\='TYPE' |,
    translate(word(vb.2,2))\='BLOB' then return 'ERROR'
 if words(vb.3)\=2 | word(vb.3,1)\='SIZE' then return 'ERROR'
 vb_size=word(vb.3,2)
 if datatype(vb_size,'W')\=1 | vb_size<0 |,
    vb_size>16777216 then return 'ERROR'
 vb_hex=0
 do vb_i=4 to vb.0
  if words(vb.vb_i)\=2 |,
     word(vb.vb_i,1)\='DATA' then return 'ERROR'
  vb_chunk=translate(word(vb.vb_i,2))
  if vb_chunk='' | length(vb_chunk)>128 |,
     length(vb_chunk)//2\=0 |,
     verify(vb_chunk,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  vb_hex=vb_hex+length(vb_chunk)
 end
 if vb_hex\=vb_size*2 then return 'ERROR'
 ll_bseen.ll_id='OK'
 return 'OK'

/* Parse one raw tree object into mode/oid records. */
parsetree:
 parse arg pt_hex
 drop vt_mode. vt_oid. vt_name.
 vt_count=0
 vt_at=1
 do while vt_at<=length(pt_hex)
  vt_mhex=''
  do while vt_at<=length(pt_hex) &,
           substr(pt_hex,vt_at,2)\='20'
   vt_mhex=vt_mhex||substr(pt_hex,vt_at,2)
   vt_at=vt_at+2
  end
  if vt_mhex='' | vt_at>length(pt_hex) then return 'ERROR'
  call asciitocms vt_mhex
  pt_mode=result
  if pt_mode='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
  vt_at=vt_at+2
  vt_nhex=''
  do while vt_at<=length(pt_hex) &,
           substr(pt_hex,vt_at,2)\='00'
   vt_nhex=vt_nhex||substr(pt_hex,vt_at,2)
   vt_at=vt_at+2
  end
  if vt_nhex='' | vt_at>length(pt_hex) then return 'ERROR'
  vt_at=vt_at+2
  if vt_at+39>length(pt_hex) then return 'ERROR'
  pt_oid=substr(pt_hex,vt_at,40)
  if verify(pt_oid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  vt_at=vt_at+40
  vt_count=vt_count+1
  if vt_count>256 then return 'ERROR'
  vt_mode.vt_count=pt_mode
  vt_oid.vt_count=pt_oid
  vt_name.vt_count=vt_nhex
 end
 return 'OK'

asciitocms: procedure
 /* Convert an even-length ASCII hex string to CMS characters.  X2C alone
    yields EBCDIC code points, so translate through the ASCII table. */
 parse arg ah
 if ah='' then return ''
 if length(ah)//2\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 ah=translate(ah)
 do ai=1 to length(ah)
  if pos(substr(ah,ai,1),'0123456789ABCDEF')=0 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 ascii=x2c(ah)
 e2a='000102031A091A7F1A1A1A0B0C0D0E0F'
 e2a=e2a||'101112131A1A081A18191A1A1C1D1E1F'
 e2a=e2a||'1A1A1C1A1A0A171B1A1A1A1A1A050607'
 e2a=e2a||'1A1A161A1A1E1A041A1A1A1A14151A1A'
 e2a=e2a||'20A6E180EB909FE2AB8B9B2E3C282B7C'
 e2a=e2a||'26A9AA9CDBA599E3A89E21242A293B5E'
 e2a=e2a||'2D2FDFDC9ADDDE989DACBA2C255F3E3F'
 e2a=e2a||'D78894B0B1B2FCD6FB603A2340273D22'
 e2a=e2a||'F861626364656667686996A4F3AFAEC5'
 e2a=e2a||'8C6A6B6C6D6E6F7071729787CE93F1FE'
 e2a=e2a||'C87E737475767778797AEFC0DA5BF2F9'
 e2a=e2a||'B5B6FDB7B8B9E6BBBCBD8DD9BF5DD8C4'
 e2a=e2a||'7B414243444546474849CBCABEE8ECED'
 e2a=e2a||'7D4A4B4C4D4E4F505152A1ADF5F4A38F'
 e2a=e2a||'5CE7535455565758595AA0858EE9E4D1'
 e2a=e2a||'30313233343536373839B3F7F0FAA7FF'
 if length(e2a)\=512 then return 'ERROR'
 tab=x2c(e2a)
 bytes=xrange('00'x,'FF'x)
 return translate(ascii,bytes,tab)
files.GITWT.EXEC:
/* M165: CMS worktree plumbing with staged multi-path tree rewrites. */
address cms
parse arg command rest
command=translate(command)
objectfm='G'
/* The worktree map is the path source of truth: PATH is stored as hex and
   the CMS file ID is a derived handle, so nested and long Git paths are
   representable.  512 bytes keeps one PATH record within a V-format record;
   32 components covers practical trees without unbounded REXX arrays. */
workpathhexmax=1024
workdepthmax=32
workfilemax=50
/* The mapped worktree is capped at 50 files, but pull preflight must be able
   to scan a much larger commit tree to find the few paths that are added,
   updated or removed.  Beyond this bound the pull fails closed. */
treescanmax=4096
'STATE GITMETA REPO G'
if rc=0 then do
 drop cfg.
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITMETA REPO G 1 (STEM CFG. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | cfg.0<4 | cfg.1\='CMS-GIT-REPOSITORY 1' then do
  say 'GITWT: invalid repository metadata'
  exit 8
 end
 objectrecords=0
 do ci=1 to cfg.0
  if word(cfg.ci,1)='OBJECT-DISK' then do
   if words(cfg.ci)\=2 then exit 8
   objectrecords=objectrecords+1
   objectfm=translate(word(cfg.ci,2))
  end
 end
 if objectrecords>1 | length(objectfm)\=1 |,
    verify(objectfm,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')\=0 then do
  say 'GITWT: invalid OBJECT-DISK setting'
  exit 8
 end
 if objectfm\='G' then do
  say 'GITWT: repository OBJECT-DISK must be G'
  exit 8
 end
end
else if rc\=28 then exit 8

if command='CHECKOUT' then do
 wc=words(rest)
 if wc<4 | wc>5 then do
  say 'Usage: GITWT CHECKOUT ref path fn ft [fm]'
  exit 4
 end
 spec=word(rest,1)
 path=word(rest,2)
 fn=translate(word(rest,3))
 ft=translate(word(rest,4))
 if wc=5 then fm=translate(word(rest,5))
 else fm='A'
 checkoutfn=fn
 checkoutft=ft
 checkoutfm=fm
 call validid fn
 if result\='OK' then exit 4
 call validid ft
 if result\='OK' then exit 4
 call validmode fm
 if result\='OK' then exit 4
 call toasciihex path
 pathhex=result
 if pathhex='ERROR' | length(pathhex)>workpathhexmax then do
  say 'GITWT: path must be 1-512 ASCII bytes'
  exit 4
 end
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 call findpath pathhex
 pi=result
 if pi>0 then do
  if mapfn.pi\=fn | mapft.pi\=ft | mapfm.pi\=fm then do
   say 'GITWT: path already mapped to another CMS file'
   exit 8
  end
 end
 call findfile fn,ft,fm
 fi=result
 if fi>0 & fi\=pi then do
  say 'GITWT: CMS file already mapped to another Git path'
  exit 8
 end
 'STATE' fn ft fm
 if rc=0 then do
  say 'GITWT: checkout target exists; M164 refuses overwrite'
  exit 8
 end
 if rc\=28 then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot inspect checkout target RC' rc
  exit 8
 end
 call readrefs
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 call resolve spec
 oid=result
 if oid='ERROR' then exit 8
 call bindnative
 if result\=0 then exit 8
 call pathoidfor oid,pathhex
 pathoid=result
 fn=checkoutfn
 ft=checkoutft
 fm=checkoutfm
 if pathoid='ERROR' then do
  say 'GITWT: checkout source could not be read' path
  exit 8
 end
 call bodyrecords body
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 call writework fn,ft,fm
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 call workoid fn,ft,fm,final,0
 wo=result
 if wo\=pathoid then do
  'ERASE' fn ft fm
  say 'GITWT: workfile round-trip OID mismatch'
  exit 8
 end
 if pi=0 then do
  if mapcount>=workfilemax then do
   'ERASE' fn ft fm
   say 'GITWT: worktree map limit reached'
   exit 8
  end
  mapcount=mapcount+1
  pi=mapcount
 end
 mapfn.pi=fn
 mapft.pi=ft
 mapfm.pi=fm
 maplf.pi=final
 mapbase.pi=pathoid
 mapstage.pi=pathoid
 mappath.pi=pathhex
 call savemap
 if result\='OK' then do
  'ERASE' fn ft fm
  exit 8
 end
 say 'CHECKED OUT' path 'AS' fn ft fm
 say 'WORKTREE OID' pathoid 'FINAL-LF' final
 exit 0
end

if command='CHECKOUT-TREE' then do
 if words(rest)\=1 then do
  say 'Usage: GITWT CHECKOUT-TREE ref'
  exit 4
 end
 spec=word(rest,1)
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot read worktree map'
  exit 8
 end
 call readrefs
 if result\='OK' then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot read refs'
  exit 8
 end
 call resolve spec
 treecommit=result
 if treecommit='ERROR' then exit 8
 /* Loose GITOBJ files carry their own reader; the native M15* fixtures are
    only a fallback for objects that are not on disk as loose files. */
 call readloose treecommit
 if result\='OK' & readtype\='COMMIT' then loosecommit=1
 else loosecommit=0
 if loosecommit=0 then do
  call bindnative
  if result\=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot bind native object reader'
   exit 8
  end
 end
 call rootfor treecommit
 treeroot=result
 if treeroot='ERROR' then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot read checkout root tree'
  exit 8
 end
 /* Walk the whole tree.  PATH is the identity; the CMS file ID is only a
    derived handle, so nested and long paths no longer block checkout. */
 call collecttree treeroot
 if result\='OK' then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot collect checkout tree'
  exit 8
 end
 treefiles=ccount
 if treefiles=0 then do
  say 'CHECKED OUT EMPTY TREE' treecommit
  exit 0
 end
 if treefiles>workfilemax | mapcount+treefiles>workfilemax then do
  say 'GITWT: checkout exceeds' workfilemax 'mapped workfiles'
  exit 8
 end
 drop tfn. tft. tpath. toid. tlf. treccount. trecord.
 drop pendingfn. pendingft.
 pendingcount=0
 synnext=1
 do ti=1 to treefiles
  call findpath cpath.ti
  if result>0 then do
   call asciitocms cpath.ti
   say 'GITWT: path is already mapped' result
   exit 8
  end
  call allocatename cpath.ti
  if result\='OK' then do
   call asciitocms cpath.ti
   say 'GITWT: cannot allocate a CMS file ID for' result
   exit 8
  end
  tfn.ti=allocfn
  tft.ti=allocft
  pendingcount=pendingcount+1
  pendingfn.pendingcount=tfn.ti
  pendingft.pendingcount=tft.ti
  call asciitocms cpath.ti
  tpath.ti=result
  toid.ti=coid.ti
  call readloose toid.ti
  if result\='OK' | readtype\='BLOB' then do
   say 'GITWT: checkout requires an available blob' toid.ti
   exit 8
  end
  call bodyrecords readhex
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: unsupported text workfile' tpath.ti
   exit 8
  end
  tlf.ti=final
  treccount.ti=rec.0
  do tj=1 to rec.0
   trecord.ti.tj=rec.tj
  end
 end
 drop before.
 'STATE GITWORK REPO G'
 beforeexists=0
 if rc=0 then do
  beforeexists=1
  'EXECIO * DISKR GITWORK REPO G 1 (STEM BEFORE. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot save prior worktree map'
   exit 8
  end
 end
 else if rc=28 then before.0=0
 else do
  say 'GITWT: cannot inspect prior worktree map RC' rc
  exit 8
 end
 written=0
 do ti=1 to treefiles
  drop rec.
  rec.0=treccount.ti
  do tj=1 to rec.0
   rec.tj=trecord.ti.tj
  end
  call writework tfn.ti,tft.ti,'A'
  if result\='OK' then do
   'ERASE' tfn.ti tft.ti 'A'
   do trb=1 to written
    'ERASE' tfn.trb tft.trb 'A'
   end
   exit 8
  end
  written=written+1
 end
 do ti=1 to treefiles
  mapcount=mapcount+1
  pi=mapcount
  mapfn.pi=tfn.ti
  mapft.pi=tft.ti
  mapfm.pi='A'
  maplf.pi=tlf.ti
  mapbase.pi=toid.ti
  mapstage.pi=toid.ti
  mappath.pi=cpath.ti
 end
 call savemap
 if result\='OK' then do
  'STATE GITWORK REPO G'
  if rc=0 then 'ERASE GITWORK REPO G'
  if beforeexists then,
   'EXECIO' before.0 'DISKW GITWORK REPO G 1 (STEM BEFORE. FINIS'
  do trb=1 to written
   'ERASE' tfn.trb tft.trb 'A'
  end
  exit 8
 end
 do ti=1 to treefiles
  say 'CHECKED OUT' tpath.ti 'AS' tfn.ti tft.ti 'A'
  say 'WORKTREE OID' toid.ti 'FINAL-LF' tlf.ti
 end
 say 'CHECKED OUT TREE FILES' treefiles
 exit 0
end

if command='RESTORE-WORKTREE' then do
 restorewords=words(rest)
 restorestart=1
 restoresource=0
 sourcearg=''
 if translate(word(rest,1))='--SOURCE' then do
  restoresource=1
  sourcearg=word(rest,2)
  if sourcearg='' then do
   say 'Usage: GIT RESTORE --source revision --worktree [--] path...'
   exit 4
  end
  restorestart=3
 end
 if word(rest,restorestart)='--' then restorestart=restorestart+1
 else if left(word(rest,restorestart),1)='-' then do
  say 'Usage: GIT RESTORE --worktree [--] path [path ...]'
  exit 4
 end
 restorepaths=restorewords-restorestart+1
 if restorepaths<1 | restorepaths>16 then do
  say 'Usage: GIT RESTORE --worktree [--] path [path ...] (maximum 16 paths)'
  exit 4
 end
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 if mapcount=0 & statusuntrackedfm='' then do
  say 'GITWT: no mapped paths to restore'
  exit 4
 end
 sourcecommit=''
 if restoresource=1 then do
  call readrefs
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot read refs for restore source'
   exit 8
  end
  call resolve sourcearg
  sourcecommit=result
  if sourcecommit='ERROR' then exit 8
  call bindnative
  if result\=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot bind native source reader'
   exit 8
  end
 end
 zeros='0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
 drop addpi. addpath. restorepi. restorebody. restorefinal.
 restorecount=0
 addcount=0
 do restorearg=restorestart to restorewords
  path=word(rest,restorearg)
  call toasciihex path
  pathhex=result
  if pathhex='ERROR' | length(pathhex)>workpathhexmax then do
   say 'GITWT: invalid path' path
   exit 4
  end
  wildcard=0
  do restorewi=1 to length(pathhex) by 2
   if substr(pathhex,restorewi,2)='2A' |,
      substr(pathhex,restorewi,2)='3F' |,
      substr(pathhex,restorewi,2)='5B' then wildcard=1
  end
  pathmatches=0
  if wildcard=0 then do
   do restorepiindex=1 to mapcount
    call matchliteral pathhex,mappath.restorepiindex
    if result=1 then do
     pathmatches=pathmatches+1
     call asciitocms mappath.restorepiindex
     if result='ERROR' then do
      say 'GITWT: invalid mapped path' mappath.restorepiindex
      exit 8
     end
     call addselected restorepiindex,result
    end
   end
  end
  else do
   do restorepiindex=1 to mapcount
    call matchpath pathhex,mappath.restorepiindex
    if result=1 then do
     pathmatches=pathmatches+1
     call asciitocms mappath.restorepiindex
     if result='ERROR' then do
      say 'GITWT: invalid mapped path' mappath.restorepiindex
      exit 8
     end
     call addselected restorepiindex,result
    end
   end
  end
  if pathmatches=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: pathspec did not match any checked out path' path
   exit 4
  end
 end
 restorecount=addcount
 headcommit=''
 do restorearg=1 to restorecount
  restorepi.restorearg=addpi.restorearg
  pi=restorepi.restorearg
  restoreoldlf.restorearg=maplf.pi
  /* Rollback uses the mapped name unless a caller supplies an explicit one. */
  restorefn.restorearg=''
  restoreft.restorearg=''
  restorefm.restorearg=''
  'STATE' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi
  if rc=0 then do
   restoreexists.restorearg=1
   drop restoreold.
   'EXECIO * DISKR' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi '1 (STEM RESTOREOLD. FINIS'
   if rc\=0 then do
    say 'GITWT: cannot snapshot restore target' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi
    exit 8
   end
   restoreoldcount.restorearg=restoreold.0
   do restoreline=1 to restoreold.0
    restoreoldline.restorearg.restoreline=restoreold.restoreline
   end
  end
  else if rc=28 then do
   restoreexists.restorearg=0
   restoreoldcount.restorearg=0
  end
  else do
   say 'GITWT: cannot inspect restore target RC' rc
   exit 8
  end
  if restoresource=0 & mapstage.pi=zeros then do
   restoretarget.restorearg=zeros
   restorefinal.restorearg=maplf.pi
   restorebody.restorearg='DELETE'
  end
  else do
   if restoresource=1 then do
    call pathoidfor sourcecommit,mappath.pi
    if result='ERROR' then do
     say 'GITWT: source path is absent or cannot be read' sourcearg,
         mappath.pi
     exit 8
    end
    restoretarget.restorearg=pathoid
    restorebody.restorearg=body
   end
   else if mapstage.pi=mapbase.pi & mapbase.pi\=zeros then do
    if headcommit='' then do
     call readrefs
     if result\='OK' then exit 8
     call resolve 'HEAD'
     headcommit=result
     if headcommit='ERROR' then exit 8
     call bindnative
     if result\=0 then exit 8
    end
    call pathoidfor headcommit,mappath.pi
    if result='ERROR' | pathoid\=mapstage.pi then do
     say 'GITWT: staged base blob does not match current HEAD' mapfn.pi
     exit 8
    end
    restorebody.restorearg=body
    restoretarget.restorearg=pathoid
   end
   else do
    call readrestoreblob mapstage.pi
    restorebody.restorearg=result
    if result='ERROR' then do
     say 'GITWT: cannot read staged blob' mapstage.pi
     exit 8
    end
    restoretarget.restorearg=mapstage.pi
   end
   call bodyrecords restorebody.restorearg
   if result\='OK' then exit 8
   restorefinal.restorearg=final
   restorelinecount.restorearg=rec.0
   do restoreline=1 to rec.0
    restoreline.restorearg.restoreline=rec.restoreline
   end
  end
 end
 'STATE GITWORK REPO G'
 if rc\=0 then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot snapshot worktree map'
  exit 8
 end
 drop before.
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITWORK REPO G 1 (STEM BEFORE. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot snapshot worktree map'
  exit 8
 end
 do restorearg=1 to restorecount
  pi=restorepi.restorearg
  if restorebody.restorearg='DELETE' then do
   if restoreexists.restorearg=1 then do
    'ERASE' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi
    if rc\=0 then do
     call rollbackrestore
     say 'GITWT: workfile delete failed; restore rollback RC' result
     exit 8
    end
   end
  end
  else do
   drop rec.
   rec.0=restorelinecount.restorearg
   do restoreline=1 to rec.0
    rec.restoreline=restoreline.restorearg.restoreline
   end
   call writework mapfn.pi,mapft.pi,mapfm.pi
   if result\='OK' then do
    call rollbackrestore
    say 'GITWT: workfile write failed; restore rollback RC' result
    exit 8
   end
   call workoid mapfn.pi,mapft.pi,mapfm.pi,restorefinal.restorearg,0
   if result\=restoretarget.restorearg then do
    call rollbackrestore
    say 'GITWT: workfile verification failed; restore rollback RC' result
    exit 8
   end
  end

  pi=restorepi.restorearg
  if restorebody.restorearg\='DELETE' then do
   if maplf.pi\=restorefinal.restorearg then mapchanged=1
   maplf.pi=restorefinal.restorearg
  end
 end
 if mapchanged=1 then do
  call savemap
  if result\='OK' then do
   do restorearg=1 to restorecount
    pi=restorepi.restorearg
    maplf.pi=restoreoldlf.restorearg
   end
   call restoremap
   maprc=result
   call rollbackrestore
   say 'GITWT: map save failed; restore rollback RC' maprc result
   exit 8
  end

  pi=restorepi.restorearg
  call asciitocms mappath.pi
  path=result
  if restorebody.restorearg='DELETE' then,
   say 'RESTORED WORKTREE DELETION' path
  else if restoresource=1 then,
   say 'RESTORED WORKTREE' path restoretarget.restorearg 'FROM' sourcearg
  else say 'RESTORED WORKTREE' path mapstage.pi
 end
 exit 0
end

if command='STATUS' then do
 shortstatus=0
 statusbranch=0
 statusuntrackedfm=''
 statuswords=words(rest)
 statusstart=statuswords+1
 statussep=0
 do si=1 to statuswords
  statusopt=translate(word(rest,si))
  if statusopt='--' then do
   statusstart=si+1
   statussep=1
   leave
  end
  else if statusopt='--SHORT' | statusopt='--PORCELAIN' then,
   shortstatus=1
  else if statusopt='--BRANCH' then statusbranch=1
  else if left(statusopt,18)='--UNTRACKED-FILES=' then do
   if statusuntrackedfm\='' then do
    say 'GITWT: duplicate --untracked-files option'
    exit 4
   end
   statusuntrackedfm=substr(statusopt,19)
   if length(statusuntrackedfm)\=1 |,
      verify(statusuntrackedfm,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')\=0 then do
    say 'Usage: GIT STATUS [--short|--porcelain] [--branch]',
        '[--untracked-files=FM] [--] [path ...]'
    exit 4
   end
  end
  else do
   if left(statusopt,1)='-' then do
    say 'Usage: GIT STATUS [--short|--porcelain] [--branch]',
        '[--untracked-files=FM] [--] [path ...]'
    exit 4
   end
   statusstart=si
   leave
  end
 end
 statuspaths=statuswords-statusstart+1
 if statuspaths<0 then statuspaths=0
 if statuspaths>16 | (statussep=1 & statuspaths=0) then do
  say 'Usage: GIT STATUS [--short|--porcelain] [--branch]',
      '[--untracked-files=FM] [--] paths'
  say '(maximum 16 pathspecs)'
  exit 4
 end
 if statusuntrackedfm\='' then do
  call validmode statusuntrackedfm
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: invalid untracked filemode' statusuntrackedfm
   exit 4
  end
 end
 if statusbranch=1 then do
  call readrefs
  if result\='OK' then exit 8
  branchname=substr(headref,12)
  if shortstatus=1 then say '##' branchname
  else say 'On branch' branchname
 end
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 if mapcount=0 then do
  if statuspaths>0 then do
   say 'GITWT: pathspec did not match a checked out path',
       word(rest,statusstart)
   exit 4
  end
  if shortstatus=0 then say 'STATUS NO TRACKED FILES'
  exit 0
 end
 drop statusselected. statusspec. statuswild. statuspathmatched.
 statusselectedcount=0
 if statuspaths=0 then do
  do si=1 to mapcount
   statusselected.si=1
  end
  statusselectedcount=mapcount
 end
 else do
  do si=statusstart to statuswords
   path=word(rest,si)
   call toasciihex path
   pathhex=result
   if pathhex='ERROR' | length(pathhex)>workpathhexmax then do
    say 'GITWT: invalid path' path
    exit 4
   end
   wildcard=0
   do wi=1 to length(pathhex) by 2
    if substr(pathhex,wi,2)='2A' | substr(pathhex,wi,2)='3F' |,
       substr(pathhex,wi,2)='5B' then wildcard=1
   end
   statusspec.si=pathhex
   statuswild.si=wildcard
   statuspathmatched.si=0
   pathmatches=0
   if wildcard=0 then do
    do pi=1 to mapcount
     call matchliteral pathhex,mappath.pi
     if result=1 then do
      pathmatches=pathmatches+1
      if statusselected.pi\=1 then do
       statusselected.pi=1
       statusselectedcount=statusselectedcount+1
      end
     end
    end
   end
   else do
    do pi=1 to mapcount
     call matchpath pathhex,mappath.pi
     if result=1 then do
      pathmatches=pathmatches+1
      if statusselected.pi\=1 then do
       statusselected.pi=1
       statusselectedcount=statusselectedcount+1
      end
     end
    end
   end
   if pathmatches>0 then statuspathmatched.si=1
  end
 end
 untrackedcount=0
 if statusuntrackedfm\='' then do
  call scanuntracked statusuntrackedfm
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot safely enumerate untracked files on',
       statusuntrackedfm
   exit 8
  end
 end
 drop untrackedselected.
 untrackedselectedcount=0
 if statuspaths=0 then do
  do ui=1 to untrackedcount
   untrackedselected.ui=1
  end
  untrackedselectedcount=untrackedcount
 end
 else do
  do si=statusstart to statuswords
   do ui=1 to untrackedcount
    if statuswild.si=0 then,
     call matchliteral statusspec.si,untrackedpathhex.ui
    else call matchpath statusspec.si,untrackedpathhex.ui
    if result=1 then do
     statuspathmatched.si=1
     if untrackedselected.ui\=1 then do
      untrackedselected.ui=1
      untrackedselectedcount=untrackedselectedcount+1
     end
    end
   end
   if statuspathmatched.si\=1 then do
    if statusuntrackedfm='' then,
     say 'GITWT: pathspec did not match any checked out path',
         word(rest,si)
    else say 'GITWT: pathspec did not match any checked out or',
         'untracked path' word(rest,si)
    exit 4
   end
  end
 end
 changed=0
 staged=0
 zeros='0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
 do i=1 to mapcount
  if statusselected.i\=1 then iterate
  call asciitocms mappath.i
  p=result
  if p='ERROR' then exit 8
  'STATE' mapfn.i mapft.i mapfm.i
  if rc=28 then do
   work=zeros
   if mapstage.i=zeros then state='CLEAN'
   else do
    state='DELETED'
    changed=changed+1
   end
   if mapstage.i\=mapbase.i then staged=staged+1
  end
  else if rc\=0 then exit 8
  else do
   call workoid mapfn.i,mapft.i,mapfm.i,maplf.i,0
   work=result
   if work='ERROR' then exit 8
   if work=mapstage.i then do
    if mapstage.i=mapbase.i then state='CLEAN'
    else do
     state='STAGED'
     staged=staged+1
    end
   end
   else do
    changed=changed+1
    if mapstage.i=zeros then state='ADDED'
    else if mapstage.i=mapbase.i then state='MODIFIED'
    else do
     state='STAGED+MODIFIED'
     staged=staged+1
    end
   end
  end
  if shortstatus=1 then do
   x=' '
   y=' '
   if mapstage.i\=mapbase.i then do
    if mapstage.i=zeros then x='D'
    else if mapbase.i=zeros then x='A'
    else x='M'
   end
   if state='DELETED' then y='D'
   else if state='MODIFIED' | state='STAGED+MODIFIED' then y='M'
   else if state='ADDED' then y='A'
   if x\=' ' | y\=' ' then say x||y||' '||p
  end
  else do
   say 'STATUS' p state
   say 'BASE' mapbase.i
   say 'STAGE' mapstage.i
   say 'WORK' work
  end
  end
  if mapcount=0 & shortstatus=0 then say 'STATUS NO TRACKED FILES'
  do ui=1 to untrackedcount
   if untrackedselected.ui\=1 then iterate
   call asciitocms untrackedpathhex.ui
   path=result
   if path='ERROR' then exit 8
   if shortstatus=1 then say '??' path
   else say 'STATUS' path 'UNTRACKED'
  end
  if shortstatus=0 then do
   say 'STATUS SUMMARY TRACKED' statusselectedcount,
       'CHANGED' changed 'STAGED' staged
   if statusuntrackedfm\='' then,
    say 'STATUS SUMMARY UNTRACKED' untrackedselectedcount
  end
 exit 0
end

if command='DIFF' then do
 cached=0
 diffnameonly=0
 diffwords=words(rest)
 diffstart=diffwords+1
 diffsep=0
 do di=1 to diffwords
  diffopt=translate(word(rest,di))
  if diffopt='--' then do
   diffstart=di+1
   diffsep=1
   leave
  end
  else if diffopt='--CACHED' | diffopt='--STAGED' then cached=1
  else if diffopt='--NAME-ONLY' then diffnameonly=1
  else do
   if left(diffopt,1)='-' then do
    say 'Usage: GIT DIFF [--cached|--staged] --name-only',
        '[--] [path ...]'
    exit 4
   end
   diffstart=di
   leave
  end
 end
 diffpaths=diffwords-diffstart+1
 if diffpaths<0 then diffpaths=0
 if diffnameonly=0 | diffpaths>16 then do
  say 'Usage: GIT DIFF [--cached|--staged] --name-only',
      '[--] [path ...]'
  exit 4
 end
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 drop diffselected.
 if diffpaths=0 then do
  do i=1 to mapcount
   diffselected.i=1
  end
 end
 else do
  do di=diffstart to diffwords
   path=word(rest,di)
   call toasciihex path
   pathhex=result
   if pathhex='ERROR' | length(pathhex)>workpathhexmax then do
    say 'GITWT: invalid path' path
    exit 4
   end
   wildcard=0
   do wi=1 to length(pathhex) by 2
    if substr(pathhex,wi,2)='2A' | substr(pathhex,wi,2)='3F' |,
       substr(pathhex,wi,2)='5B' then wildcard=1
   end
   pathmatches=0
   do i=1 to mapcount
    if wildcard=0 then do
     call matchliteral pathhex,mappath.i
     diffmatch=result
    end
    else do
     call matchpath pathhex,mappath.i
     diffmatch=result
    end
    if diffmatch=1 then do
     pathmatches=pathmatches+1
     diffselected.i=1
    end
   end
   if pathmatches=0 then do
    say 'GITWT: pathspec did not match any checked out path' path
    exit 4
   end
  end
 end
 zeros='0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
 do i=1 to mapcount
  if diffselected.i\=1 then iterate
  changed=0
  if cached=1 then do
   if mapstage.i\=mapbase.i then changed=1
  end
  else do
   'STATE' mapfn.i mapft.i mapfm.i
   if rc=28 then do
    if mapstage.i\=zeros then changed=1
   end
   else if rc\=0 then exit 8
   else do
    call workoid mapfn.i,mapft.i,mapfm.i,maplf.i,0
    work=result
    if work='ERROR' then exit 8
    if work\=mapstage.i then changed=1
   end
  end
  if changed=1 then do
   call asciitocms mappath.i
   path=result
   if path='ERROR' then exit 8
   say path
  end
 end
 exit 0
end

/* M273: apply a clean fast-forward with an unchanged flat path set. */
if command='CHECK-PULL' | command='APPLY-PULL' then do
 parse var rest pullbranch pullold pullnew extra
 pullref='refs/heads/'||pullbranch
 if pullbranch='' | pullold='' | pullnew='' | extra\='' then do
  say 'Usage: GITWT CHECK-PULL|APPLY-PULL branch old-commit new-commit'
  exit 4
 end
 call validref pullref
 if result\='OK' then exit 4
 pullold=translate(pullold)
 pullnew=translate(pullnew)
 if length(pullold)\=40 | length(pullnew)\=40 |,
    verify(pullold,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 |,
    verify(pullnew,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 | pullold=pullnew then exit 4
 call readrefs
 if result\='OK' | headref\=pullref then do
  say 'GITWT: current branch changed before pull'
  exit 8
 end
 foundref=0
 currentoid=''
 do ri=1 to refcount
  if refname.ri=pullref then do
   foundref=foundref+1
   currentoid=refoid.ri
  end
 end
 /* The first pull into an empty repository has no branch record yet.
    It is a create only when preflight names the zero old-commit. */
 zeros='0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
 createmode=0
 if foundref=0 & pullold=zeros & command='CHECK-PULL' then createmode=1
 if createmode=0 then do
  if foundref\=1 then exit 8
  if command='CHECK-PULL' & currentoid\=pullold then do
   say 'GITWT: local branch tip changed before pull preflight'
   exit 8
  end
  if command='APPLY-PULL' & currentoid\=pullnew then do
   say 'GITWT: local branch tip changed before pull apply'
   exit 8
  end
 end
 call preflightpull
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 if command='CHECK-PULL' then do
  say 'PULL PREFLIGHT SAFE ADDED' pulladdcount 'REMOVED' pullremcount,
      'CHANGED' pullupdcount 'MAPPED' pullkeepcount
  exit 0
 end
 if mapcount=0 then do
  say 'PULLED WORKTREE FILES 0 ADDED 0 REMOVED 0'
  exit 0
 end
 drop before.
 'STATE GITWORK REPO G'
 if rc\=0 then exit 8
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITWORK REPO G 1 (STEM BEFORE. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then exit 8
 restorecount=mapcount
 drop restorepi. restoreexists. restoreoldcount.
 drop restoreoldline. restoreline.
 drop restorefn. restoreft. restorefm.
 do pi=1 to mapcount
  restorepi.pi=pi
  restoreexists.pi=1
  restorefn.pi=mapfn.pi
  restoreft.pi=mapft.pi
  restorefm.pi=mapfm.pi
  drop pullold.
  'EXECIO * DISKR' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi,
      '1 (STEM PULLOLD. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot snapshot pull workfile' mapfn.pi mapft.pi
   exit 8
  end
  restoreoldcount.pi=pullold.0
  do li=1 to pullold.0
   restoreoldline.pi.li=pullold.li
  end
 end
 /* Reserve every new CMS file ID before the first mutation, so a name
    collision cannot leave half a pull applied. */
 drop addfn. addft. addwritten.
 addwritten=0
 pendingcount=0
 synnext=1
 do ak=1 to pulladdcount
  ni=addix.ak
  call allocatename newpath.ni
  if result\='OK' then do
   call asciitocms newpath.ni
   say 'GITWT: cannot allocate a CMS file ID for' result
   exit 8
  end
  addfn.ak=allocfn
  addft.ak=allocft
  pendingcount=pendingcount+1
  pendingfn.pendingcount=addfn.ak
  pendingft.pendingcount=addft.ak
 end
 changedfiles=0
 do uk=1 to pullupdcount
  pi=updpi.uk
  drop rec.
  rec.0=pullnewcount.pi
  do li=1 to rec.0
   rec.li=pullnewrec.pi.li
  end
  call writework mapfn.pi,mapft.pi,mapfm.pi
  if result\='OK' then do
   call eraseadditions
   call rollbackrestore
   say 'GITWT: pull write failed; workfile rollback RC' result
   exit 8
  end
  call workoid mapfn.pi,mapft.pi,mapfm.pi,pullnewlf.pi,0
  if result\=updo.uk then do
   call eraseadditions
   call rollbackrestore
   say 'GITWT: pull hash failed; workfiles restored'
   exit 8
  end
  changedfiles=changedfiles+1
 end
 do ak=1 to pulladdcount
  ni=addix.ak
  drop rec.
  rec.0=pulladdrecs.ni
  do li=1 to rec.0
   rec.li=pulladdrec.ni.li
  end
  call writework addfn.ak,addft.ak,'A'
  if result\='OK' then do
   call eraseadditions
   call rollbackrestore
   say 'GITWT: pull add failed; workfiles restored'
   exit 8
  end
  addwritten=ak
  call workoid addfn.ak,addft.ak,'A',pulladdfin.ni,0
  if result\=newoid.ni then do
   call eraseadditions
   call rollbackrestore
   say 'GITWT: pull add hash failed; workfiles restored'
   exit 8
  end
 end
 do rk=1 to pullremcount
  pi=rempi.rk
  'ERASE' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi
  if rc\=0 then do
   call eraseadditions
   call rollbackrestore
   say 'GITWT: pull remove failed; workfiles restored'
   exit 8
  end
 end
 /* Build the replacement map: kept and changed entries first, then adds. */
 drop updnew. updlf.
 do pi=1 to mapcount
  updnew.pi=''
  updlf.pi=''
 end
 do uk=1 to pullupdcount
  pi=updpi.uk
  updnew.pi=updo.uk
  updlf.pi=pullnewlf.pi
 end
 drop nmfn. nmft. nmfm. nmlf. nmbase. nmstage. nmpath.
 nmcount=0
 do pi=1 to mapcount
  if removepi.pi=1 then iterate
  nmcount=nmcount+1
  nmfn.nmcount=mapfn.pi
  nmft.nmcount=mapft.pi
  nmfm.nmcount=mapfm.pi
  nmbase.nmcount=mapbase.pi
  nmstage.nmcount=mapstage.pi
  nmpath.nmcount=mappath.pi
  if updnew.pi\='' then do
   nmbase.nmcount=updnew.pi
   nmstage.nmcount=updnew.pi
   nmlf.nmcount=updlf.pi
  end
  else do
   nmlf.nmcount=maplf.pi
   if mapstage.pi\=mapbase.pi then nmstage.nmcount=mapstage.pi
  end
 end
 do ak=1 to pulladdcount
  ni=addix.ak
  nmcount=nmcount+1
  nmfn.nmcount=addfn.ak
  nmft.nmcount=addft.ak
  nmfm.nmcount='A'
  nmlf.nmcount=pulladdfin.ni
  nmbase.nmcount=newoid.ni
  nmstage.nmcount=newoid.ni
  nmpath.nmcount=newpath.ni
 end
 drop mapfn. mapft. mapfm. maplf. mapbase. mapstage. mappath.
 mapcount=nmcount
 do pi=1 to mapcount
  mapfn.pi=nmfn.pi
  mapft.pi=nmft.pi
  mapfm.pi=nmfm.pi
  maplf.pi=nmlf.pi
  mapbase.pi=nmbase.pi
  mapstage.pi=nmstage.pi
  mappath.pi=nmpath.pi
 end
 call savemap
 if result\='OK' then do
  call eraseadditions
  call restoremap
  maprc=result
  if maprc='OK' then call loadmap
  call rollbackrestore
  filerollback=result
  say 'GITWT: pull map save failed; rollback map' maprc 'workfiles' filerollback
  exit 8
 end
 say 'PULLED WORKTREE FILES' changedfiles 'ADDED' pulladdcount,
     'REMOVED' pullremcount
 exit 0
end

/* Cleanliness and source-content preflight for a changing mapped switch. */
if command='CHECK-SWITCH-UPDATE' then do
 parse var rest expectedref targetref extra
 if expectedref='' | targetref='' | extra\='' then exit 4
 call validref expectedref
 if result\='OK' | left(expectedref,11)\='refs/heads/' then exit 4
 targetoid=''
 if length(targetref)=40 &,
    verify(translate(targetref),'0123456789ABCDEF')=0 then,
  targetoid=translate(targetref)
 else do
  call validref targetref
  if result\='OK' | left(targetref,11)\='refs/heads/' then exit 4
 end
 call readrefs
 if result\='OK' | headref\=expectedref then do
  say 'GITWT: symbolic HEAD changed during switch preflight'
  exit 8
 end
 call resolve expectedref
 switchcurrent=result
 if switchcurrent='ERROR' then exit 8
 if targetoid='' then do
  call resolve targetref
  switchtarget=result
 end
 else switchtarget=targetoid
 if switchtarget='ERROR' then exit 8
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 if mapcount=0 then do
  say 'SWITCH PREFLIGHT SAFE UNMAPPED 0'
  exit 0
 end
 call bindnative
 if result\=0 then exit 8
 do mi=1 to mapcount
  if mapstage.mi\=mapbase.mi then do
   say 'GITWT: staged changes block branch switch' mappath.mi
   exit 8
  end
  call checkworkfile mapfn.mi,mapft.mi,mapfm.mi
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: missing mapped file blocks branch switch',
       mapfn.mi mapft.mi mapfm.mi
   exit 8
  end
  call workoid mapfn.mi,mapft.mi,mapfm.mi,maplf.mi,0
  if result\=mapbase.mi then do
   say 'GITWT: modified workfile blocks branch switch' mappath.mi
   exit 8
  end
  call pathoidfor switchcurrent,mappath.mi
  if result\=mapbase.mi then do
   say 'GITWT: worktree base is stale against current branch',
       mappath.mi
   exit 8
  end
  call pathoidfor switchtarget,mappath.mi
  if result='ERROR' then do
   say 'GITWT: destination path is absent or unreadable' mappath.mi
   exit 8
  end
  call bodyrecords body
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: destination file is not CMS-compatible' mappath.mi
   exit 8
  end
 end
 say 'SWITCH PREFLIGHT SAFE MAPPED' mapcount
 exit 0
end

/* Apply a preflighted branch transition, with file and map rollback. */
if command='APPLY-SWITCH' then do
 parse var rest expectedref targetref expectedcurrent expectedtarget extra
 if expectedref='' | targetref='' | expectedcurrent='' |,
    expectedtarget='' | extra\='' then exit 4
 call validref expectedref
 if result\='OK' | left(expectedref,11)\='refs/heads/' then exit 4
 call validref targetref
 if result\='OK' | left(targetref,11)\='refs/heads/' then exit 4
 expectedcurrent=translate(expectedcurrent)
 expectedtarget=translate(expectedtarget)
 if length(expectedcurrent)\=40 | length(expectedtarget)\=40 |,
    verify(expectedcurrent,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 |,
    verify(expectedtarget,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 4
 call readrefs
 if result\='OK' | headref\=targetref then do
  say 'GITWT: HEAD changed before mapped switch apply'
  exit 8
 end
 call resolve expectedref
 switchcurrent=result
 call resolve targetref
 switchtarget=result
 if switchcurrent\=expectedcurrent | switchtarget\=expectedtarget then do
  say 'GITWT: branch tips changed before mapped switch apply'
  exit 8
 end
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 if mapcount=0 then do
  say 'SWITCHED WORKTREE PATHS 0'
  exit 0
 end
 call bindnative
 if result\=0 then exit 8
 drop restorepi. restorebody. restorefinal. restoretarget.
 drop restoreexists. restoreoldcount. restoreoldlf.
 drop restorelinecount. restoreoldline. restoreline.
 restorecount=mapcount
 do switchi=1 to mapcount
  restorepi.switchi=switchi
  pi=switchi
  if mapstage.pi\=mapbase.pi then do
   say 'GITWT: staged changes block branch switch' mappath.pi
   exit 8
  end
  'STATE' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi
  if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: missing mapped file blocks branch switch',
       mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi
   exit 8
  end
  restoreexists.switchi=1
  drop restoreold.
  'EXECIO * DISKR' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi '1 (STEM RESTOREOLD. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot snapshot switch target' mapfn.pi
   exit 8
  end
  restoreoldcount.switchi=restoreold.0
  do switchline=1 to restoreold.0
   restoreoldline.switchi.switchline=restoreold.switchline
  end
  call workoid mapfn.pi,mapft.pi,mapfm.pi,maplf.pi,0
  if result\=mapbase.pi then do
   say 'GITWT: modified workfile blocks branch switch' mappath.pi
   exit 8
  end
  call pathoidfor switchcurrent,mappath.pi
  if result\=mapbase.pi then do
   say 'GITWT: worktree base is stale against current branch',
       mappath.pi
   exit 8
  end
  call pathoidfor switchtarget,mappath.pi
  if result='ERROR' then do
   say 'GITWT: destination path is absent or unreadable' mappath.pi
   exit 8
  end
  restoretarget.switchi=pathoid
  restorebody.switchi=body
  call bodyrecords restorebody.switchi
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: destination file is not CMS-compatible' mappath.pi
   exit 8
  end
  restorefinal.switchi=final
  restorelinecount.switchi=rec.0
  do switchline=1 to rec.0
   restoreline.switchi.switchline=rec.switchline
  end
 end
 'STATE GITWORK REPO G'
 if rc\=0 then exit 8
 drop before.
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITWORK REPO G 1 (STEM BEFORE. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then exit 8
 do switchi=1 to restorecount
  pi=restorepi.switchi
  if restoretarget.switchi=mapbase.pi then iterate
  'ERASE' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi
  if rc\=0 then do
   call rollbackrestore
   say 'GITWT: switch target erase failed; rollback RC' result
   exit 8
  end
  drop rec.
  rec.0=restorelinecount.switchi
  do switchline=1 to rec.0
   rec.switchline=restoreline.switchi.switchline
  end
  call writework mapfn.pi,mapft.pi,mapfm.pi
  if result\='OK' then do
   call rollbackrestore
   say 'GITWT: switch write failed; rollback RC' result
   exit 8
  end
  call workoid mapfn.pi,mapft.pi,mapfm.pi,restorefinal.switchi,0
  if result\=restoretarget.switchi then do
   call rollbackrestore
   say 'GITWT: switch verification failed; rollback RC' result
   exit 8
  end
 end
 do switchi=1 to restorecount
  pi=restorepi.switchi
  mapbase.pi=restoretarget.switchi
  mapstage.pi=restoretarget.switchi
  maplf.pi=restorefinal.switchi
 end
 call savemap

matchpath:
 parse arg matchpattern,matchcandidate
 matchp=1
 matchc=1
 matchstar=0
 matchretry=0
 do while matchc<=length(matchcandidate)
  if matchp<=length(matchpattern) then do
   matchbyte=substr(matchpattern,matchp,2)
   matchadvance=1
   matchok=0
   if matchbyte='3F' then matchok=1
   else if matchbyte='2A' then do
    matchstar=matchp
    matchretry=matchc
    matchp=matchp+2
    matchadvance=0
   end
   else if matchbyte='5B' then do
    call matchclass matchpattern,matchp,matchc
    matchclassok=result
    if matchclose>0 then do
     if matchclassok=1 then matchok=1
    end
    else if matchbyte=substr(matchcandidate,matchc,2) then,
     matchok=1
   end
   else if matchbyte=substr(matchcandidate,matchc,2) then,
    matchok=1
   if matchadvance=1 then do
    if matchok=1 then do
     if matchbyte='5B' & matchclose>0 then,
      matchp=matchclose+2
     else matchp=matchp+2
     matchc=matchc+2
    end
    else if matchstar>0 then do
     matchp=matchstar+2
     matchretry=matchretry+2
     matchc=matchretry
    end
    else return 0
   end
  end
  else if matchstar>0 then do
   matchp=matchstar+2
   matchretry=matchretry+2
   matchc=matchretry
  end
  else return 0
 end
 do while matchp<=length(matchpattern) &,
      substr(matchpattern,matchp,2)='2A'
  matchp=matchp+2
 end
 if matchp>length(matchpattern) then return 1
 return 0

/* Bracket expression matching.  MATCHCLOSE is zero when the pattern has no
   closing bracket; the caller then treats the opening bracket literally. */
matchclass:
 parse arg mcpattern,mcstart,mccandidatepos
 mcpos=mcstart+2
 mcnegate=0
 if substr(mcpattern,mcpos,2)='21' |,
    substr(mcpattern,mcpos,2)='5E' then do
  mcnegate=1
  mcpos=mcpos+2
 end
 mcmat=0
 mcfirst=1
 matchclose=0
 mccandbyte=substr(matchcandidate,mccandidatepos,2)
 do while mcpos<=length(mcpattern)
  mcchar=substr(mcpattern,mcpos,2)
  if mcchar='5D' then do
   if mcfirst=0 then do
    matchclose=mcpos
    leave
   end
   if mccandbyte='5D' then mcmat=1
   mcfirst=0
   mcpos=mcpos+2
   iterate
  end
  mcfirst=0
  if mcpos+4<=length(mcpattern) &,
     substr(mcpattern,mcpos+2,2)='2D' &,
     substr(mcpattern,mcpos+4,2)\='5D' then do
   mclow=x2d(mcchar)
   mchigh=x2d(substr(mcpattern,mcpos+4,2))
   mccanddec=x2d(mccandbyte)
   if mccanddec>=mclow & mccanddec<=mchigh then mcmat=1
   mcpos=mcpos+6
  end
  else do
   if mcchar=mccandbyte then mcmat=1
   mcpos=mcpos+2
  end
 end
 if matchclose=0 then return 0
 if mcnegate=1 then do
  if mcmat=1 then return 0
  return 1
 end
 if mcmat=1 then return 1
 return 0

/* A literal pathspec also selects every mapped path below that directory. */
matchliteral:
 parse arg literalhex,candidatehex
 if candidatehex=literalhex then return 1
 if length(candidatehex)>length(literalhex) &,
    substr(candidatehex,1,length(literalhex))=literalhex &,
    substr(candidatehex,length(literalhex)+1,2)='2F' then return 1
 return 0

scanuntracked: procedure expose mapcount mapfn. mapft. mapfm.,
 workpathhexmax untrackedcount untrackedfn. untrackedft. untrackedfm.,
 untrackedpathhex.
 parse arg scanmode
 scanmode=translate(scanmode)
 untrackedcount=0
 drop untrackedfn. untrackedft. untrackedfm. untrackedpathhex.
 if queued()\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 listcmd='LISTFILE * * '||scanmode||' (STACK'
 address command listcmd
 listrc=rc
 listcount=queued()
 if listrc\=0 | datatype(listcount,'W')\=1 |,
    listcount>4096 then do
  do while queued()>0
   pull discard
  end
  return 'ERROR'
 end
 do while queued()>0
  pull listrecord
  if words(listrecord)\=3 then do
   do while queued()>0
    pull discard
   end
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  scanfn=translate(word(listrecord,1))
  scanft=translate(word(listrecord,2))
  scanfm=translate(word(listrecord,3))
  if left(scanfm,1)\=scanmode then iterate
  if scanft='GITOBJ' | scanft='PACK' | scanft='REPO' |,
     scanft='STAGE' | scanft='INDEX' | scanft='SEEK' |,
     scanft='GEN' | scanft='MODULE' then iterate
  mapped=0
  do mi=1 to mapcount
   if mapfn.mi=scanfn & mapft.mi=scanft &,
      mapfm.mi=scanmode then mapped=1
  end
  if mapped=1 then iterate
  if untrackedcount>=4096 then do
   do while queued()>0
    pull discard
   end
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  candidatepath=scanfn||'.'||scanft
  call toasciihex candidatepath
  candidatehex=result
  if candidatehex='ERROR' |,
     length(candidatehex)>workpathhexmax then do
   do while queued()>0
    pull discard
   end
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  duplicate=0
  do ui=1 to untrackedcount
   if compare(untrackedpathhex.ui,candidatehex)=0 then duplicate=1
  end
  if duplicate=1 then iterate
  untrackedcount=untrackedcount+1
  untrackedfn.untrackedcount=scanfn
  untrackedft.untrackedcount=scanft
  untrackedfm.untrackedcount=scanmode
  untrackedpathhex.untrackedcount=candidatehex
 end
 return 'OK'

readrestoreblob:
 parse upper arg restoreoid
 if length(restoreoid)\=40 |,
    verify(restoreoid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 verifycmd='GIT VERIFY-OBJECT'||' '||restoreoid
 drop restoreverify.
 restoreverify.0=0
 'PIPE CMS' verifycmd '| STEM RESTOREVERIFY.'
 if rc\=0 | restoreverify.0\=1 |,
    strip(restoreverify.1)\=restoreoid 'OK' then return 'ERROR'
 restorefn=substr(restoreoid,1,8)
 drop restoreobj.
 'EXECIO * DISKR' restorefn 'GITOBJ' objectfm ,
  '1 (STEM RESTOREOBJ. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | restoreobj.0<3 then return 'ERROR'
 if word(restoreobj.1,1)\='OID' | words(restoreobj.1)\=2 |,
    word(restoreobj.1,2)\=restoreoid |,
    word(restoreobj.2,1)\='TYPE' | words(restoreobj.2)\=2 |,
    word(restoreobj.2,2)\='BLOB' then,
  return 'ERROR'
 restorehex=''
 if restoreobj.0=3 & word(restoreobj.3,1)='DATA' then do
  if words(restoreobj.3)>2 then return 'ERROR'
  if words(restoreobj.3)=2 then restorehex=word(restoreobj.3,2)
  if restorehex\='' & (length(restorehex)//2\=0 |,
     length(restorehex)>128 |,
     verify(restorehex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0) then return 'ERROR'
  restoresize=length(restorehex)%2
 end
 else do
  if word(restoreobj.3,1)\='SIZE' | words(restoreobj.3)\=2 then,
   return 'ERROR'
  restoresize=word(restoreobj.3,2)
  if datatype(restoresize,'W')\=1 | restoresize<0 |,
     restoresize>65536 then return 'ERROR'
  do restoreoi=4 to restoreobj.0
   if word(restoreobj.restoreoi,1)\='DATA' |,
      words(restoreobj.restoreoi)\=2 then return 'ERROR'
   restorechunk=word(restoreobj.restoreoi,2)
   if restorechunk='' | length(restorechunk)>128 |,
      length(restorechunk)//2\=0 |,
      verify(restorechunk,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   restorehex=restorehex||restorechunk
  end
 end
 if length(restorehex)//2\=0 | length(restorehex)%2\=restoresize |,
    verify(restorehex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return restorehex

preflightpull:

  say 'GITWT: cannot read worktree map for pull'
  return 'ERROR'
 end
 zeros='0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'

 pullremcount=0
 pullupdcount=0
 drop updpi. updo. addix. rempi. removepi.
 drop oldpath. oldoid. newpath. newoid.
 if mapcount=0 then do
  /* Nothing is checked out, so a pull cannot overwrite or lose a workfile.
     The refs-only pull is safe even when the commit tree is large. */
  say 'GITWT: no mapped workfiles; pull will update refs only'
  return 'OK'
 end
 call rootfor pullold

 if oldroot='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'

  say 'GITWT: cannot collect the old commit tree'
  return 'ERROR'
 end
 oldcount=ccount
 do oi=1 to oldcount
  oldpath.oi=cpath.oi
  oldoid.oi=coid.oi

    workfile must be clean.  A path added or removed by the update is not a
    dirty worktree and no longer blocks the pull. */
 do pi=1 to mapcount
  call pathindex 'OLD',oldcount,mappath.pi
  oi=result
  if oi=0 | oldoid.oi\=mapbase.pi then do
   say 'GITWT: worktree base differs from old commit' mappath.pi
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  if mapbase.pi=zeros | mapstage.pi\=mapbase.pi then do
   say 'GITWT: dirty or incomplete worktree blocks pull' mappath.pi
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  'STATE' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi
  if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: missing mapped file blocks pull' mapfn.pi mapft.pi
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  call workoid mapfn.pi,mapft.pi,mapfm.pi,maplf.pi,0
  if result\=mapbase.pi then do
   say 'GITWT: modified mapped file blocks pull' mappath.pi
   return 'ERROR'
  end

 pullroot=result
 if pullroot='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
 call collecttree pullroot

  say 'GITWT: cannot collect the new commit tree'
  return 'ERROR'
 end
 newcount=ccount
 do ni=1 to newcount
  newpath.ni=cpath.ni
  newoid.ni=coid.ni
 end
 /* Classify the three-way difference: keep, update, add, remove. */
 do pi=1 to mapcount
  call pathindex 'NEW',newcount,mappath.pi
  if result=0 then do
   pullremcount=pullremcount+1
   rempi.pullremcount=pi
   removepi.pi=1
  end
  else do
   ni=result
   if newoid.ni\=mapbase.pi then do
    pullupdcount=pullupdcount+1
    updpi.pullupdcount=pi
    updo.pullupdcount=newoid.ni
    call readloose newoid.ni

     say 'GITWT: pulled blob is missing or invalid' newoid.ni

    pullnewcount.pi=rec.0

    end
   end
  end

  /* Add only paths the update introduced.  A path that is present in both
     commits but was never checked out is a partial worktree, not an add. */
  call pathindex 'OLD',oldcount,newpath.ni
  if result=0 then do
   pulladdcount=pulladdcount+1
   addix.pulladdcount=ni
   call readloose newoid.ni

    say 'GITWT: added blob is missing or invalid' newoid.ni

buildraw:

  if nodeentrydeleted.buildnode.buildentry\=1 then do
   call modehex nodemode.buildnode.buildentry
   mh=result
   if mh='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
   raw=raw||mh||'20'||nodenamehex.buildnode.buildentry||'00'||,
       nodechildoid.buildnode.buildentry
   buildcount=buildcount+1
  end
