insertrootadds:
 do nai=1 to newrootcount
  parentid=newrootparent.nai
  liveentries=0
  do lei=1 to nodeentries.parentid
   if nodeentrydeleted.parentid.lei\=1 then liveentries=liveentries+1
  end
  if liveentries>=256 then return 'ERROR'
  insertat=nodeentries.parentid+1
  newcompare=newrootname.nai
  if newrootmode.nai='40000' then newcompare=newcompare||'2F'
  do nej=1 to nodeentries.parentid
   compare=nodenamehex.parentid.nej
   if nodemode.parentid.nej='40000' then compare=compare||'2F'
   sortbefore=0
   sortdone=0
   commonlen=min(length(newcompare),length(compare))
   do cbi=1 to commonlen by 2
    newbyte=x2d(substr(newcompare,cbi,2))
    oldbyte=x2d(substr(compare,cbi,2))
    if newbyte<oldbyte then do
     sortbefore=1
     sortdone=1
     leave
    end
    if newbyte>oldbyte then do
     sortdone=1
     leave
    end
   end
   if sortbefore=1 then do
    insertat=nej
    leave
   end
   if sortdone=0 & length(newcompare)=length(compare) then,
    return 'ERROR'
   if sortdone=0 & length(newcompare)<length(compare) then do
    insertat=nej
    leave
   end
  end
  do nej=nodeentries.parentid to insertat by -1
   next=nej+1
   nodemode.parentid.next=nodemode.parentid.nej
   nodenamehex.parentid.next=nodenamehex.parentid.nej
   nodechildoid.parentid.next=nodechildoid.parentid.nej
   nodeentrydeleted.parentid.next=nodeentrydeleted.parentid.nej
  end
  do nji=2 to nodecount
   if nodeparent.nji=parentid & nodeisnew.nji\=1 &,
      nodeentry.nji>=insertat then nodeentry.nji=nodeentry.nji+1
  end
  nodeentries.parentid=nodeentries.parentid+1
  nodemode.parentid.insertat=newrootmode.nai
  nodenamehex.parentid.insertat=newrootname.nai
  nodechildoid.parentid.insertat=newrootoid.nai
  nodeentrydeleted.parentid.insertat=0
  nodechanged.parentid=1
 end
 return 'OK'

parsepathout:
 closure=0
 meta=0
 begins=0
 ends=0
 indata=0
 body=''
 do oi=1 to out.0
  line=out.oi
  if line='COMMIT ROOT FULL CLOSURE VERIFIED' then closure=closure+1
  else if word(line,1)='PATH' & word(line,2)='OBJECT' &,
     word(line,3)='TYPE' then do
   if meta | words(line)\=8 then return 'ERROR'
   if word(line,4)\='3' | word(line,5)\='SIZE' |,
      word(line,7)\='OID' then return 'ERROR'
   pathsize=word(line,6)
   pathoid=translate(word(line,8))
   if datatype(pathsize,'W')\=1 | pathsize<0 | pathsize>65536 then,
    return 'ERROR'
   if length(pathoid)\=40 |,
      verify(pathoid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   meta=1
  end
  else if line='PATH DATA BEGIN' then do
   if begins | indata then return 'ERROR'
   begins=1
   indata=1
  end
  else if line='PATH DATA END' then do
   if \indata | ends then return 'ERROR'
   ends=1
   indata=0
  end
  else if indata then do
   if word(line,1)\='PATH' | word(line,2)\='HEX' |,
      words(line)\=3 then return 'ERROR'
   h=translate(word(line,3))
   if h='' | length(h)>64 | length(h)//2\=0 |,
      verify(h,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   body=body||h
  end
 end
 if closure\=1 | meta\=1 | begins\=1 | ends\=1 | indata then,
  return 'ERROR'
 if length(body)%2\=pathsize then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

pathoidfor:
 parse arg pcommit,ppath
 call rootfor pcommit
 treeoid=result
 if treeoid='ERROR' then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot read root tree for commit' pcommit
  return 'ERROR'
 end
 call splitpath ppath
 if result\='OK' then do
  say 'GITWT: invalid encoded Git path'
  return 'ERROR'
 end
 do pathlevel=1 to pcnt
  call readtree treeoid,pcomp.pathlevel
  pathrc=result
  if pathrc='MISSING' then do
   say 'GITWT: path component is absent at level' pathlevel
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  if pathrc\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot read tree component' pathlevel 'of' pcnt
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  if pathlevel<pcnt then do
   if foundmode\='40000' then do
    say 'GITWT: non-tree path component at level' pathlevel
    return 'ERROR'
   end
   treeoid=foundoid
  end
  else do
   if foundmode='40000' | foundmode='160000' then do
    say 'GITWT: final path component is not a file'
    return 'ERROR'
   end
   call readloose foundoid
   if result='OK' then do
    if readtype\='BLOB' then do
     say 'GITWT: checkout path does not name a blob' foundoid
     return 'ERROR'
    end
    body=readhex
    pathoid=foundoid
   end
   else if result='MISSING' then do
    drop out.
    out.0=0
    cmd='GITREC PATHFULLCAT GITFIX M15NEW' pcommit ppath
    'PIPE CMS' cmd '| STEM OUT.'
    if rc\=0 then do
     say 'GITWT: native path reader failed' pathlevel 'RC' rc
     return 'ERROR'
    end
    call parsepathout
    if result\='OK' then do
     say 'GITWT: native path reader returned invalid data'
     return 'ERROR'
    end
   end
   else do
    say 'GITWT: cannot verify checkout blob' foundoid
    return 'ERROR'
   end
  end
 end
 return pathoid

checkworkfile:
 parse arg wfn,wft,wfm
 'STATE' wfn wft wfm
 if rc\=0 then return 'OK'
 return 'ERROR'

bodyrecords:
 parse arg h
 drop rec.
 rec.0=0
 final=0
 if h\='' & right(h,2)='0A' then do
  final=1
  h=left(h,length(h)-2)
 end
 if h='' then return 'OK'
 do forever
  call bytepos '0A',h
  bp=result
  if bp=0 then do
   part=h
   h=''
  end
  else do
   part=left(h,bp-1)
   h=substr(h,bp+2)
  end
  call validtext part
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: checkout currently supports CMS text files only'
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  if length(part)%2>80 then do
   say 'GITWT: Git line exceeds CMS LRECL 80'
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  call asciitocms part
  txt=result
  if txt='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
  rec.0=rec.0+1
  n=rec.0
  rec.n=txt
  if bp=0 then leave
 end
 return 'OK'

writework:
 parse arg wfn,wft,wfm
 if rec.0=0 then,
  'EXECIO 0 DISKW' wfn wft wfm '1 F 80 (FINIS'
 else,
  'EXECIO' rec.0 'DISKW' wfn wft wfm '1 F 80 (STEM REC. FINIS'
 wrc=rc
 if wrc\=0 then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot write CMS workfile'
  return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

workoid:
 parse arg wfn,wft,wfm,wlf,write
 if write then verb='WRITE-WORKFILE'
 else verb='HASH-WORKFILE'
 drop wh.
 wh.0=0
 'PIPE CMS GIT' verb wfn wft wfm wlf '| STEM wh.'
 wrc=rc
 if wrc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 found=0
 x=''
 do wi=1 to wh.0
  candidate=translate(strip(wh.wi))
  if length(candidate)=40 &,
     verify(candidate,'0123456789ABCDEF')=0 then do
   found=found+1
   x=candidate
  end
 end
 if found\=1 then return 'ERROR'
 return x

rootfor:
 parse arg commit
 call readloose commit
 if result='OK' then do
  if readtype\='COMMIT' | length(readhex)<92 |,
     left(readhex,10)\='7472656520' |,
     substr(readhex,91,2)\='0A' then return 'ERROR'
  call asciitocms substr(readhex,11,80)
  answer=translate(result)
  if answer='ERROR' | length(answer)\=40 |,
     verify(answer,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  return answer
 end
 if result\='MISSING' then return 'ERROR'
 drop sf.
 sf.0=0
 cmd='GITREC SHOWFULL GITFIX M15NEW' commit
 'PIPE CMS' cmd '| STEM sf.'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 marker=0
 roots=0
 answer=''
 do sfi=1 to sf.0
  if sf.sfi='SHOW FULL ROOT CLOSURE VERIFIED' then marker=marker+1
  if word(sf.sfi,1)='COMMIT' & word(sf.sfi,2)='TREE' then do
   oid=translate(word(sf.sfi,3))
   if length(oid)\=40 |,
      verify(oid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   roots=roots+1
   answer=oid
  end
 end
 if marker\=1 | roots\=1 then return 'ERROR'
 return answer

readloose:
 parse arg readid
 readid=translate(readid)
 readtype=''
 readhex=''
 if length(readid)\=40 |,
    verify(readid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 readfn=substr(readid,1,8)
 'STATE' readfn 'GITOBJ' objectfm
 if rc=28 then return 'MISSING'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 verifycmd='GIT VERIFY-OBJECT '||readid
 drop verifyout.
 verifyout.0=0
 'PIPE CMS' verifycmd '| STEM VERIFYOUT.'
 if rc\=0 | verifyout.0\=1 |,
    strip(verifyout.1)\=readid 'OK' then return 'ERROR'
 drop readobj.
 'EXECIO * DISKR' readfn 'GITOBJ' objectfm ,
    '1 (STEM READOBJ. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | readobj.0<3 then return 'ERROR'
 if words(readobj.1)\=2 | word(readobj.1,1)\='OID' |,
    translate(word(readobj.1,2))\=readid |,
    words(readobj.2)\=2 | word(readobj.2,1)\='TYPE' |,
    words(readobj.3)\=2 | word(readobj.3,1)\='SIZE' then,
  return 'ERROR'
 readtype=translate(word(readobj.2,2))
 readsize=word(readobj.3,2)
 if readtype\='BLOB' & readtype\='TREE' &,
    readtype\='COMMIT' then return 'ERROR'
 if datatype(readsize,'W')\=1 | readsize<0 |,
    readsize>16777216 then return 'ERROR'
 do readi=4 to readobj.0
  if word(readobj.readi,1)\='DATA' |,
     words(readobj.readi)\=2 then return 'ERROR'
  chunk=translate(word(readobj.readi,2))
  if chunk='' | length(chunk)>128 | length(chunk)//2\=0 |,
     verify(chunk,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  readhex=readhex||chunk
 end
 if length(readhex)%2\=readsize then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

splitpath:
 parse arg ph
 drop pcomp.
 pcnt=0
 part=''
 if ph='' | length(ph)//2\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 do spi=1 to length(ph) by 2
  b=translate(substr(ph,spi,2))
  if b='2F' then do
   if part='' then return 'ERROR'
   pcnt=pcnt+1
   pcomp.pcnt=part
   part=''
  end
  else do
   if verify(b,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   part=part||b
  end
 end
 if part='' then return 'ERROR'
 pcnt=pcnt+1
 pcomp.pcnt=part
 if pcnt<1 | pcnt>workdepthmax then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

/* Depth-first collection of every blob in a commit tree.  The result is a
   flat list of full paths (hex), so checkout and pull share one view. */
collecttree:
 parse arg croot
 drop cpath. coid. stackoid. stackprefix.
 ccount=0
 stackcount=1
 stackoid.1=croot
 stackprefix.1=''
 do while stackcount>0
  nodeoid=stackoid.stackcount
  prefix=stackprefix.stackcount
  stackcount=stackcount-1
  call readtree nodeoid,''
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot read tree' nodeoid 'at prefix' prefix
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  do cei=1 to ecount
   mode=emode.cei
   if mode='40000' then do
    if stackcount>=200 then return 'ERROR'
    stackcount=stackcount+1
    stackoid.stackcount=eoid.cei
    stackprefix.stackcount=prefix||ename.cei||'2F'
   end
   else if mode='100644' | mode='100755' then do
    ccount=ccount+1
    cpath.ccount=prefix||ename.cei
    coid.ccount=eoid.cei
    if length(cpath.ccount)>workpathhexmax then return 'ERROR'
    call splitpath cpath.ccount
    if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
    do cpi=1 to pcnt
     if pcomp.cpi='2E' | pcomp.cpi='2E2E' then return 'ERROR'
    end
    if ccount>treescanmax then do
     say 'GITWT: commit tree exceeds the scan limit'
     return 'ERROR'
    end
   end
   else do
    call asciitocms ename.cei
    say 'GITWT: tree entry mode' mode 'is not supported' prefix||ename.cei
    return 'ERROR'
   end
  end
 end
 return 'OK'

/* The natural 8.8 name is the base component only, kept for readability.
   Anything else gets a stable synthetic name, because PATH is the identity. */
naturalname:
 parse arg nah
 natfn=''
 natft=''
 call splitpath nah
 if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 call asciitocms pcomp.pcnt
 base=result
 if base='ERROR' | base='' then return 'OK'
 base=translate(base)
 if length(base)>16 then return 'OK'
 dotpos=pos('.',base)
 if dotpos=0 then do
  fn=base
  ft='TEXT'
 end
 else do
  if dotpos=1 | dotpos=length(base) then return 'OK'
  if pos('.',substr(base,dotpos+1))>0 then return 'OK'
  fn=left(base,dotpos-1)
  ft=substr(base,dotpos+1)
 end
 call validid fn
 if result\='OK' then return 'OK'
 call validid ft
 if result\='OK' then return 'OK'
 natfn=fn
 natft=ft
 return 'OK'

/* Free, unmapped, and not already reserved by this checkout batch. */
fileavailable:
 parse arg afn,aft
 call findfile afn,aft,'A'
 if result>0 then return 'USED'
 do fai=1 to pendingcount
  if pendingfn.fai=afn & pendingft.fai=aft then return 'USED'
 end
 'STATE' afn aft 'A'
 if rc=28 then return 'OK'
 if rc=0 then return 'USED'
 return 'ERROR'

allocatename:
 parse arg aah
 allocfn=''
 allocft=''
 call naturalname aah
 if result='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
 if natfn\='' then do
  call fileavailable natfn,natft
  if result='OK' then do
   allocfn=natfn
   allocft=natft
   return 'OK'
  end
  if result='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
 end
 do while synnext<=999999
  candidate='WT'||right(synnext,6,'0')
  synnext=synnext+1
  call fileavailable candidate,'GITF'
  if result='OK' then do
   allocfn=candidate
   allocft='GITF'
   return 'OK'
  end
  if result='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'ERROR'

readtree:
 parse arg toid,target
 drop tout. emode. enlen. eoid. ename.
 tout.0=0
 begin=0
 ending=0
 declared=-1
 ecount=0
 currente=0
 fn=substr(toid,1,8)
 'STATE' fn 'GITOBJ' objectfm
 localrc=rc
 if localrc=0 then do
  drop verifyout.
  verifycmd='GIT VERIFY-OBJECT '||toid
  'PIPE CMS' verifycmd '| STEM VERIFYOUT.'
  if rc\=0 | verifyout.0\=1 |,
     strip(verifyout.1)\=toid 'OK' then return 'ERROR'
  drop loose.
  'EXECIO * DISKR' fn 'GITOBJ' objectfm ,
   '1 (STEM LOOSE. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 | loose.0<3 then return 'ERROR'
  if word(loose.1,1)\='OID' |,
     translate(word(loose.1,2))\=toid |,
     words(loose.1)\=2 | word(loose.2,1)\='TYPE' |,
     word(loose.2,2)\='TREE' | words(loose.2)\=2 |,
     word(loose.3,1)\='SIZE' | words(loose.3)\=2 then return 'ERROR'
  treesize=word(loose.3,2)
  if datatype(treesize,'W')\=1 then return 'ERROR'
  raw=''
  do ti=4 to loose.0
   if word(loose.ti,1)\='DATA' | words(loose.ti)\=2 then,
    return 'ERROR'
   chunk=translate(word(loose.ti,2))
   if chunk='' | length(chunk)>128 | length(chunk)//2\=0 |,
      verify(chunk,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   raw=raw||chunk
  end
  if length(raw)%2\=treesize then return 'ERROR'
  at=1
  do while at<=length(raw)
   modehex=''
   do while at<=length(raw) & substr(raw,at,2)\='20'
    modehex=modehex||substr(raw,at,2)
    at=at+2
   end
   if modehex='' | at>length(raw) then return 'ERROR'
   call asciitocms modehex
   mode=result
   if mode='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
   at=at+2
   namehex=''
   do while at<=length(raw) & substr(raw,at,2)\='00'
    namehex=namehex||substr(raw,at,2)
    at=at+2
   end
   if namehex='' | at>length(raw) then return 'ERROR'
   at=at+2
   if at+39>length(raw) then return 'ERROR'
   oid=substr(raw,at,40)
   if verify(oid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   at=at+40
   ecount=ecount+1
   emode.ecount=mode
   enlen.ecount=length(namehex)%2
   eoid.ecount=oid
   ename.ecount=namehex
   if ecount>256 then return 'ERROR'
  end
  declared=ecount
  begin=1
  ending=1
 end
 else do
  if localrc\=28 then return 'ERROR'
  cmd='GITREC TREE GITFIX M15NEW' toid
  'PIPE CMS' cmd '| STEM tout.'
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  do ti=1 to tout.0
   line=tout.ti
   if line='TREE DATA BEGIN' then begin=begin+1
   else if line='TREE DATA END' then ending=ending+1
   else if word(line,1)='TREE' & word(line,2)='ENTRY' then do
    if word(line,3)\='MODE' | word(line,5)\='NAMELEN' |,
       word(line,7)\='OID' | words(line)\=8 then return 'ERROR'
    ecount=ecount+1
    currente=ecount
    emode.ecount=word(line,4)
    enlen.ecount=word(line,6)
    eoid.ecount=translate(word(line,8))
    ename.ecount=''
   end
   else if word(line,1)='TREE' & word(line,2)='NAMEHEX' then do
    if currente<1 | words(line)\=3 then return 'ERROR'
    ename.currente=ename.currente||translate(word(line,3))
   end
   else if word(line,1)='TREE' & word(line,2)='ENTRIES' then do
    if words(line)\=3 then return 'ERROR'
    declared=word(line,3)
   end
  end
 end
 if begin\=1 | ending\=1 then return 'ERROR'
 if datatype(declared,'W')\=1 | declared\=ecount then return 'ERROR'
 matches=0
 foundoid=''
 foundmode=''
 foundindex=0
 do ei=1 to ecount
  mode=emode.ei
  if mode\='100644' & mode\='100755' & mode\='120000' &,
     mode\='40000' & mode\='160000' then return 'ERROR'
  if datatype(enlen.ei,'W')\=1 | enlen.ei<1 then return 'ERROR'
  if length(ename.ei)\=enlen.ei*2 then return 'ERROR'
  if verify(ename.ei,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  if length(eoid.ei)\=40 |,
     verify(eoid.ei,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  if ename.ei=target then do
   matches=matches+1
   foundoid=eoid.ei
   foundmode=mode
   foundindex=ei
  end
 end
 /* An empty target means "read every entry"; only named lookups can be
    MISSING.  The recursive collector relies on this. */
 if target='' then return 'OK'
 if matches>1 then return 'ERROR'
 if matches=0 then return 'MISSING'
 return 'OK'

loadnode:
 parse arg loadid,loadtree,loadtarget
 call readtree loadtree,loadtarget
 if result\='OK' & result\='MISSING' then return 'ERROR'
 nodeentries.loadid=ecount
 do li=1 to ecount
  nodemode.loadid.li=emode.li
  nodenamehex.loadid.li=ename.li
  nodechildoid.loadid.li=eoid.li
 end
 return 'OK'

modehex:
 parse arg mode
 if mode='100644' then return '313030363434'
 if mode='100755' then return '313030373535'
 if mode='120000' then return '313230303030'
 if mode='40000' then return '3430303030'
 if mode='160000' then return '313630303030'
 return 'ERROR'

writehex:
 parse arg raw
 'STATE GITTREE REPO G'
 trc=rc
 if trc=0 then do
  'ERASE GITTREE REPO G'
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 else if trc\=28 then return 'ERROR'
 drop tr.
 tn=0
 tp=1
 if raw='' then do
  tn=1
  tr.1='EMPTY'
 end
 else do while tp<=length(raw)
  take=min(64,length(raw)-tp+1)
  tn=tn+1
  tr.tn='HEX' substr(raw,tp,take)
  tp=tp+take
 end
 tr.0=tn
 'EXECIO' tr.0 'DISKW GITTREE REPO G 1 (STEM TR. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 drop tw.
 tw.0=0
 'PIPE CMS GIT WRITE-TREE-HEXFILE GITTREE REPO G | STEM tw.'
 wrc=rc
 'ERASE GITTREE REPO G'
 erc=rc
 if wrc\=0 | erc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 found=0
 answer=''
 do wti=1 to tw.0
  candidate=translate(strip(tw.wti))
  if length(candidate)=40 &,
     verify(candidate,'0123456789ABCDEF')=0 then do
   found=found+1
   answer=candidate
  end
 end
 if found\=1 then return 'ERROR'
 return answer

loadmap:
 drop mapfn. mapft. mapfm. maplf.


 drop mapbase. mapstage. mappath.
 mapcount=0
 'STATE GITWORK REPO G'
 mrc=rc
 if mrc=28 then return 'OK'
 if mrc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 drop wm.
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITWORK REPO G 1 (STEM WM. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | wm.0<2 then return 'ERROR'
 if word(wm.1,1)\='WORK1' | words(wm.1)\=2 then return 'ERROR'
 mapcount=word(wm.1,2)
 if datatype(mapcount,'W')\=1 | mapcount<0 | mapcount>workfilemax then,
  return 'ERROR'
 if wm.0\=2+mapcount*5 then return 'ERROR'
 at=2
 do mi=1 to mapcount
  line=wm.at
  if word(line,1)\='ENTRY' | word(line,2)\=mi |,
     words(line)\=6 then return 'ERROR'
  mapfn.mi=word(line,3)
  mapft.mi=word(line,4)
  mapfm.mi=word(line,5)
  maplf.mi=word(line,6)
  call validid mapfn.mi
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  call validid mapft.mi
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  call validmode mapfm.mi
  if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
  if maplf.mi\='0' & maplf.mi\='1' then return 'ERROR'
  at=at+1
  line=wm.at
  if word(line,1)\='BASE' | word(line,2)\=mi |,
     words(line)\=3 then return 'ERROR'
  mapbase.mi=translate(word(line,3))
  if length(mapbase.mi)\=40 |,
     verify(mapbase.mi,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  at=at+1
  line=wm.at
  if word(line,1)\='STAGE' | word(line,2)\=mi |,
     words(line)\=3 then return 'ERROR'
  mapstage.mi=translate(word(line,3))
  if length(mapstage.mi)\=40 |,
     verify(mapstage.mi,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  at=at+1
  line=wm.at
  if word(line,1)\='PATH' | word(line,2)\=mi |,
     words(line)\=3 then return 'ERROR'
  mappath.mi=translate(word(line,3))
  if mappath.mi='' | length(mappath.mi)>workpathhexmax |,
     length(mappath.mi)//2\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  if verify(mappath.mi,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  at=at+1
  if wm.at\='END' mi then return 'ERROR'
  at=at+1
 end
 if wm.at\='WORKEND' mapcount then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

restoremap:
 'STATE GITWORK REPO G'
 rmc=rc
 if rmc=0 then do
  'ERASE GITWORK REPO G'
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 else if rmc\=28 then return 'ERROR'
 'EXECIO' before.0 'DISKW GITWORK REPO G 1 (STEM BEFORE. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

savemap:
 /* Refuse to persist a malformed map.  An unset REXX compound variable
    evaluates to its own name, so this validation is what keeps a partial
    rebuild from silently writing UPDNEW.n or UPDLF.n as data. */
 do si=1 to mapcount
  if length(mapbase.si)\=40 |,
     verify(mapbase.si,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 |,
     length(mapstage.si)\=40 |,
     verify(mapstage.si,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 |,
     (maplf.si\=0 & maplf.si\=1) |,
     mappath.si='' | length(mappath.si)//2\=0 |,
     verify(mappath.si,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: invalid worktree map entry' si
   return 'ERROR'
  end
 end
 drop sw.
 sw.1='WORK1' mapcount
 at=2
 do si=1 to mapcount
  sw.at='ENTRY' si mapfn.si mapft.si mapfm.si maplf.si
  at=at+1
  sw.at='BASE' si mapbase.si
  at=at+1
  sw.at='STAGE' si mapstage.si
  at=at+1
  sw.at='PATH' si mappath.si
  at=at+1
  sw.at='END' si
  at=at+1
 end
 sw.at='WORKEND' mapcount
 sw.0=at
 /* Recreate the file so a longer PATH record raises the V-format LRECL.
    The current map is snapshotted first so a failed rewrite can put it back;
    temp-and-rename remains a separate slice. */
 drop smbak.
 smbak.0=0
 smold=0
 'STATE GITWORK REPO G'
 if rc=0 then do
  smold=1
  'EXECIO * DISKR GITWORK REPO G 1 (STEM SMBAK. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot snapshot worktree map'
   return 'ERROR'
  end
  'ERASE GITWORK REPO G'
  if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot replace worktree map'
   return 'ERROR'
  end
 end
 else if rc\=28 then return 'ERROR'
 'EXECIO' sw.0 'DISKW GITWORK REPO G 1 (STEM SW. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then do
  'STATE GITWORK REPO G'
  if rc=0 then 'ERASE GITWORK REPO G'
  if smold then do
   'EXECIO' smbak.0 'DISKW GITWORK REPO G 1 (STEM SMBAK. FINIS'
   if rc\=0 then say 'GITWT: worktree map restore also failed'
  end
  say 'GITWT: cannot write worktree map'
  return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

eraseadditions:
 do eai=1 to addwritten
  'STATE' addfn.eai addft.eai 'A'
  if rc=0 then do
   'ERASE' addfn.eai addft.eai 'A'
   if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  end
  else if rc\=28 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

pathindex:
 parse arg which,count,want
 do xi=1 to count
  if which='OLD' then do
   if oldpath.xi=want then return xi
  end
  else do
   if newpath.xi=want then return xi
  end
 end
 return 0

findpath:
 parse arg wanted
 do fi=1 to mapcount
  if mappath.fi=wanted then return fi
 end
 return 0

findfile:
 parse arg wfn,wft,wfm
 do fi=1 to mapcount
  if mapfn.fi=wfn & mapft.fi=wft & mapfm.fi=wfm then return fi
 end
 return 0

readrefs:
 drop rr. refname. refoid.
 headref=''
 refcount=0
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITREF2 REPO G 1 (STEM RR. FINIS'
 /* Two lines is an unborn repository: header plus symbolic HEAD. */
 if rc\=0 | rr.0<2 | rr.1\='REF2 1' then return 'ERROR'
 do ri=2 to rr.0
  if word(rr.ri,1)='HEAD' then do
   if words(rr.ri)\=2 | headref\='' then return 'ERROR'
   headref=word(rr.ri,2)
  end
  else if word(rr.ri,1)='REF' then do
   if words(rr.ri)\=3 then return 'ERROR'
   name=word(rr.ri,2)
   roid=translate(word(rr.ri,3))
   call validref name
   if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
   if length(roid)\=40 |,
      verify(roid,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then return 'ERROR'
   refcount=refcount+1
   refname.refcount=name
   refoid.refcount=roid
  end
  else return 'ERROR'
 end
 if left(headref,11)\='refs/heads/' then return 'ERROR'
 call validref headref
 if result\='OK' then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'

validref:
 procedure
 /* Private vars: this routine is a PROCEDURE, so writing NAME here cannot
    clobber the full ref name readrefs stores across the call. */
 parse arg vr
 if length(vr)>35 then return 'ERROR'
 if left(vr,11)='refs/heads/' then do
  name=substr(vr,12)
  refchars='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
  refchars=refchars||'0123456789._/-'
  if name='' | verify(name,refchars)\=0 |,
     pos('//',name)>0 | pos('..',name)>0 |,
     left(name,1)='/' | right(name,1)='/' then return 'ERROR'
  do vi=1 to words(translate(name,' ','/'))
   part=word(translate(name,' ','/'),vi)
   if part='' | part='.' | part='..' | left(part,1)='.' |,
      right(part,1)='.' | right(part,5)='.lock' then return 'ERROR'
  end
  return 'OK'
 end
 else if left(vr,13)='refs/remotes/' then do
  vrname=substr(vr,14)
  vrslash=pos('/',vrname)
  if vrslash<2 then return 'ERROR'
  vrremote=left(vrname,vrslash-1)
  vrbranch=substr(vrname,vrslash+1)
  remotechars='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
  remotechars=remotechars||'0123456789._-'
  if length(vrremote)>16 | verify(vrremote,remotechars)\=0 |,
     vrremote='.' | vrremote='..' | pos('..',vrremote)>0 |,
     left(vrremote,1)='.' | right(vrremote,1)='.' then return 'ERROR'
  refchars='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
  refchars=refchars||'0123456789._/-'
  if vrbranch='' | verify(vrbranch,refchars)\=0 |,
     pos('//',vrbranch)>0 | pos('..',vrbranch)>0 |,
     left(vrbranch,1)='/' | right(vrbranch,1)='/' then return 'ERROR'
  do vrvi=1 to words(translate(vrbranch,' ','/'))
   vrpart=word(translate(vrbranch,' ','/'),vrvi)
   if vrpart='' | vrpart='.' | vrpart='..' | left(vrpart,1)='.' |,
      right(vrpart,1)='.' | right(vrpart,5)='.lock' then return 'ERROR'
  end
  return 'OK'
 end
 else if left(vr,10)='refs/tags/' then vrname=substr(vr,11)
 else return 'ERROR'
 refchars='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
 refchars=refchars||'0123456789._/-'
 if vrname='' | verify(vrname,refchars)\=0 | pos('//',vrname)>0 |,
    pos('..',vrname)>0 | left(vrname,1)='/' | right(vrname,1)='/' |,
    right(vrname,1)='.' | right(vrname,5)='.lock' then return 'ERROR'
 do vrvi=1 to words(translate(vrname,' ','/'))
  vrpart=word(translate(vrname,' ','/'),vrvi)
  if left(vrpart,1)='.' | right(vrpart,1)='.' |,
     right(vrpart,5)='.lock' then return 'ERROR'
 end
 return 'OK'

resolve:
 parse arg wanted

 if length(direct)=40 &,
    verify(direct,'0123456789ABCDEF')=0 then return direct
 if translate(wanted)='HEAD' then wanted=headref
 else if left(wanted,11)\='refs/heads/' then do
  /* Accept an explicit refs/remotes/... name unchanged. */
  if left(wanted,5)\='refs/' then wanted='refs/heads/'||wanted

 do ri=1 to refcount
  if refname.ri=wanted then return refoid.ri
 end
 say 'GITWT: ref not found' wanted
 return 'ERROR'

  dd=word('C0STG C0IDX C0SEEK C0GEN',bi)

   say 'GITWT: FILEDEF' dd 'M15NEW' typ 'failed RC' rc

files.GITZDOFS.EXEC:
/* M284 inlines the sole-caller OFS_DELTA resolver. */
parse arg command current offhex zdata extra
command = translate(command)
offhex = translate(offhex)
zdata = translate(zdata)
if command \= 'APPLY' | extra \= '' |,
   datatype(current,'W') \= 1 | current < 0 | offhex = '' |,
   length(offhex) // 2 \= 0 |,
   verify(offhex,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 | zdata = '' |,
   length(zdata) // 2 \= 0 |,
   verify(zdata,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
   say 'Usage: GITZDOFS APPLY current-position offset-hex zlib-hex'
   exit 4
end
call inflatez zdata
if result = 'ERROR' then exit 8
delta = result
call decodeofs offhex
if result = 'ERROR' then exit 8
distance = result
if distance <= 0 | distance > current then do
   say 'GITODLT: OFS_DELTA base precedes pack data'
   exit 8
end
basepos = current - distance
call readbase basepos
if result \= 'OK' then exit 8
'EXEC GITDAPP APPLY' basedata delta
exit rc

readbase: procedure expose basetype basedata
   parse arg wanted
   drop in.
   'EXECIO * DISKR GITPCTX PACK A 1 (STEM IN. FINIS'
   if rc \= 0 then do
      say 'GITODLT: pack context unavailable'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   found = 0
   do i = 1 to in.0
      parse var in.i tag p t d extra
      if tag \= 'ENTRY' | extra \= '' then do
         say 'GITODLT: corrupt pack context record' i
         return 'ERROR'
      end
      if datatype(p,'W') \= 1 | p < 0 then do
         say 'GITODLT: corrupt pack position' i
         return 'ERROR'
      end
      if p = wanted then do
         found = found + 1
         basetype = t
         basedata = d
      end
   end
   if found = 0 then do
      say 'GITODLT: OFS_DELTA base position not found' wanted
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if found > 1 then do
      say 'GITODLT: duplicate OFS_DELTA base position' wanted
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if basetype \= 'BLOB' & basetype \= 'TREE' &,
      basetype \= 'COMMIT' & basetype \= 'TAG' then do
      say 'GITODLT: invalid base object type' basetype
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if length(basedata) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(basedata,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'GITODLT: invalid base object data'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return 'OK'

decodeofs: procedure
   parse arg data
   pos = 1
   call nextbyte data, pos
   if result = 'ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
   b = result
   pos = pos + 2
   value = b // 128
   more = b >= 128
   do while more
      call nextbyte data, pos
      if result = 'ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
      b = result
      pos = pos + 2
      value = (value + 1) * 128 + (b // 128)
      more = b >= 128
      if value > 9007199254740991 then do
         say 'GITODLT: offset too large for exact REXX arithmetic'
         return 'ERROR'
      end
   end
   if pos <= length(data) then do
      say 'GITODLT: trailing bytes after offset'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return value

nextbyte: procedure
   parse arg data, pos
   if pos + 1 > length(data) then do
      say 'GITODLT: truncated OFS_DELTA offset'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return x2d(substr(data,pos,2))

inflatez: procedure
   parse arg z
   if length(z) < 12 then do
      say 'GITZDOFS: zlib stream too short'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   cmf = x2d(substr(z,1,2))
   flg = x2d(substr(z,3,2))
   if cmf // 16 \= 8 | cmf % 16 > 7 then do
      say 'GITZDOFS: invalid zlib method/window'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if (cmf * 256 + flg) // 31 \= 0 then do
      say 'GITZDOFS: invalid FCHECK'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if (flg % 32) // 2 then do
      say 'GITZDOFS: preset dictionary not supported'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   deflate = substr(z,5,length(z)-12)
   expected = substr(z,length(z)-7,8)
   'EXEC GITINFL INFLATESTACK' deflate
   if rc \= 0 then return 'ERROR'
   parse pull data
   s1 = 1
   s2 = 0
   do p = 1 to length(data) by 2
      b = x2d(substr(data,p,2))
      s1 = (s1 + b) // 65521
      s2 = (s2 + s1) // 65521
   end
   actual = d2x(s2,4) || d2x(s1,4)
   if actual \= expected then do
      say 'GITZDOFS: Adler-32 mismatch'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return data
files.GITZDREF.EXEC:
/* M285: compressed REF_DELTA integration with inline base lookup. */
parse arg command oid zdata extra
command = translate(command)
oid = translate(oid)
zdata = translate(zdata)

/* Loose objects may live on a disk other than A. */
objectfm = 'A'
'STATE GITMETA REPO A'
if rc = 0 then do
   drop odmeta.
   'EXECIO * DISKR GITMETA REPO A 1 (STEM ODMETA. FINIS'
   if rc = 0 & odmeta.0 >= 1 &,
      odmeta.1 = 'CMS-GIT-REPOSITORY 1' then do
      odseen = 0
      do odi = 1 to odmeta.0
         if word(odmeta.odi,1) = 'OBJECT-DISK' then do
            if words(odmeta.odi) \= 2 then exit 8
            odseen = odseen + 1
            objectfm = translate(word(odmeta.odi,2))
         end
      end
      if odseen > 1 | length(objectfm) \= 1 |,
         verify(objectfm,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ') \= 0 then,
         exit 8
   end
end

if command \= 'APPLY' | extra \= '' | length(oid) \= 40 |,
   verify(oid,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 | zdata = '' |,
   length(zdata) // 2 \= 0 |,
   verify(zdata,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
   say 'Usage: GITZDREF APPLY base-oid zlib-hex'
   exit 4
end
call inflatez zdata
if result = 'ERROR' then exit 8
delta = result
call readbase oid
if result \= 'OK' then exit 8
'EXEC GITDAPP APPLY' datahex delta
exit rc

readbase: procedure expose datahex objectfm
   parse upper arg oid
   objfn = substr(oid,1,8)
   drop obj.
   'EXECIO * DISKR' objfn 'GITOBJ' objectfm '1 (STEM OBJ. FINIS'
   if rc \= 0 then do
      say 'GITRDEL: base object not found' oid
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if obj.0 < 3 | word(obj.1,1) \= 'OID' |,
      word(obj.2,1) \= 'TYPE' then do
      say 'GITRDEL: corrupt base object' oid
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if word(obj.1,2) \= oid then do
      say 'GITRDEL: stored base OID mismatch'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   datahex = ''
   if obj.0 = 3 & word(obj.3,1) = 'DATA' then do
      datahex = word(obj.3,2)
   end
   else do
      if word(obj.3,1) \= 'SIZE' then do
         say 'GITRDEL: base SIZE record missing'
         return 'ERROR'
      end
      size = word(obj.3,2)
      if datatype(size,'W') \= 1 | size < 0 then do
         say 'GITRDEL: invalid base SIZE'
         return 'ERROR'
      end
      do i = 4 to obj.0
         if word(obj.i,1) \= 'DATA' then do
            say 'GITRDEL: invalid base DATA record'
            return 'ERROR'
         end
         chunk = word(obj.i,2)
         if length(chunk) > 128 then do
            say 'GITRDEL: base DATA chunk too long'
            return 'ERROR'
         end
         datahex = datahex || chunk
      end
      if length(datahex) % 2 \= size then do
         say 'GITRDEL: base SIZE mismatch'
         return 'ERROR'
      end
   end
   if length(datahex) // 2 \= 0 |,
      verify(datahex,'0123456789ABCDEF') \= 0 then do
      say 'GITRDEL: invalid base DATA hex'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return 'OK'

inflatez: procedure
   parse arg z
   if length(z) < 12 then do
      say 'GITZDREF: zlib stream too short'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   cmf = x2d(substr(z,1,2))
   flg = x2d(substr(z,3,2))
   if cmf // 16 \= 8 | cmf % 16 > 7 then do
      say 'GITZDREF: invalid zlib method/window'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if (cmf * 256 + flg) // 31 \= 0 then do
      say 'GITZDREF: invalid FCHECK'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   if (flg % 32) // 2 then do
      say 'GITZDREF: preset dictionary not supported'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   deflate = substr(z,5,length(z)-12)
   expected = substr(z,length(z)-7,8)
   'EXEC GITINFL INFLATESTACK' deflate
   if rc \= 0 then return 'ERROR'
   parse pull data
   s1 = 1
   s2 = 0
   do p = 1 to length(data) by 2
      b = x2d(substr(data,p,2))
      s1 = (s1 + b) // 65521
      s2 = (s2 + s1) // 65521
   end
   actual = d2x(s2,4) || d2x(s1,4)
   if actual \= expected then do
      say 'GITZDREF: Adler-32 mismatch'
      return 'ERROR'
   end
   return data
files.M274F5.EXEC:
/* M274: batch-install a verified stage as CMS loose objects. */
address cms
parse upper arg stage index datafm extra
if stage='' | index='' | datafm='' | extra\='' |,
   \validfn(stage) | \validfn(index) | stage=index |,
   length(datafm)\=1 | verify(datafm,'BCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')\=0 then do
 say 'Usage: GIT FETCH-ACTIVATE stage-file index-file data-filemode'
 exit 4
end

/* Existing repositories must select this same dedicated object disk. */
objectfm='A'
'STATE GITMETA REPO A'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: initialize the repository first with GIT INIT' datafm
 exit 8
end
drop cfg.
'EXECIO * DISKR GITMETA REPO A 1 (STEM CFG. FINIS'
if rc\=0 | cfg.0<4 | cfg.1\='CMS-GIT-REPOSITORY 1' then do
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: invalid repository metadata'
 exit 8
end
objects=0
do i=1 to cfg.0
 if word(cfg.i,1)='OBJECT-DISK' then do
  if words(cfg.i)\=2 then exit 8
  objects=objects+1
  objectfm=translate(word(cfg.i,2))
 end
end
if objects\=1 | objectfm\=datafm then do
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: repository object disk must match' datafm
 exit 8
end

/* Require the same isolated, accessed R/W 4K disk used by import. */
drop disk.
disk.0=0
'PIPE CMS QUERY DISK' datafm '| STEM DISK.'
if rc\=0 then exit 8
matched=0
freeblocks=''
do i=1 to disk.0
 if word(disk.i,3)=datafm & word(disk.i,4)='R/W' &,
    word(disk.i,7)='4096' & words(disk.i)>=11 then do
  matched=matched+1
  freeblocks=word(disk.i,10)
 end
end
if matched\=1 | datatype(freeblocks,'W')\=1 |,
   freeblocks<1 then do
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: object data disk is not ready' datafm
 exit 8
end

'STATE' stage 'STAGE' datafm
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: verified STAGE not found' stage 'STAGE' datafm
 exit 8
end
'STATE' stage 'META A'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: pack metadata not found' stage 'META A'
 exit 8
end
drop meta.
'EXECIO 1 DISKR' stage 'META A 1 (STEM META. FINIS'
if rc\=0 | meta.0\=1 then exit 8
parse var meta.1 mtag wanted packbytes packver objectcount metextra
wanted=translate(wanted)
if words(meta.1)\=5 | mtag\='META' | length(wanted)\=40 |,
   verify(wanted,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 |,
   datatype(objectcount,'W')\=1 | objectcount<1 | objectcount>100000 then do
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: invalid retained pack metadata'
 exit 8
end

'STATE' index 'INDEX' datafm
if rc=0 then do
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: index output already exists' index 'INDEX' datafm
 exit 8
end
if rc\=28 then exit 8
do i=1 to 4
 module=word('GITPIDX GITPTRE M274L5 GITPCAT',i)
 'STATE' module 'MODULE A'
 if rc\=0 then do
  say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: required CMS module missing' module
  exit 8
 end
end

/* Never replace a caller-owned data definition. */
drop defs.
defs.0=0
'PIPE CMS QUERY FILEDEF | STEM DEFS.'
if rc\=0 then exit 8
do i=1 to defs.0
 dd=translate(word(defs.i,1))
 if dd='STGIN' | dd='IDXIN' | dd='IDXOUT' | dd='OBJOUT' then do
  say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: FILEDEF already active for' dd
  exit 8
 end
end

'FILEDEF STGIN DISK' stage 'STAGE' datafm
if rc\=0 then exit 8

'FILEDEF IDXOUT DISK' index 'INDEX' datafm '(RECFM V LRECL 80'
if rc\=0 then do
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 exit 8
end
drop built.
built.0=0
say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: building object index from' stage 'STAGE' datafm
pipecmd='PIPE (ENDCHAR ?) CMS GITPIDX BUILD CHECKED | A: FANOUT'
pipecmd=pipecmd||' | STEM BUILT. ? A: | CONSOLE'
pipecmd
brc=rc
'FILEDEF IDXOUT CLEAR'
if brc\=0 then do
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: object index build failed; stage retained'
 exit 8
end
bpass=0
do i=1 to built.0
 if built.i='M174 INDEX BUILD PASS' then bpass=bpass+1
end
if bpass\=1 then do
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 exit 8
end

'FILEDEF IDXIN DISK' index 'INDEX' datafm
if rc\=0 then do
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 exit 8
end
/* BUILD CHECKED hashes every stage object while making the index. */
drop checked.
checked.0=0
say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: verifying object index ...'
pipecmd='PIPE (ENDCHAR ?) CMS GITPIDX CHECK | A: FANOUT'
pipecmd=pipecmd||' | STEM CHECKED. ? A: | CONSOLE'
pipecmd
arc=rc
if arc\=0 | checked.0<1 then do
 'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: index readback failed; stage retained'
 exit 8
end
checkpass=0
checktotal=''
checkunique=''
do i=1 to checked.0
 if word(checked.i,1)='INDEX' &,
    word(checked.i,2)='VERIFIED' &,
    word(checked.i,4)='UNIQUE' & words(checked.i)=5 then do
  checktotal=word(checked.i,3)
  checkunique=word(checked.i,5)
 end
 if checked.i='M174 INDEX CHECK PASS' then,
  checkpass=checkpass+1
end
if checkpass\=1 | checktotal\=objectcount |,
   datatype(checkunique,'W')\=1 | checkunique<1 |,
   checkunique>objectcount then do
 'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: index readback marker mismatch'
 exit 8
end

/* Resolve the advertised commit's root tree before walking its closure. */
drop commitout.
commitout.0=0
say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: resolving commit and tree closure ...'
'PIPE CMS GITPCAT INFO' wanted '| STEM COMMITOUT.'
crc=rc
if crc\=0 then do
 'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: requested commit could not be read from the stage'
 exit 8
end
treeoid=''
treecount=0
commitpass=0
do i=1 to commitout.0
 if word(commitout.i,1)='PACKOBJ' &,
    word(commitout.i,2)='COMMIT' &,
    word(commitout.i,3)='TREE' & words(commitout.i)=4 then do
  candidate=translate(word(commitout.i,4))
  if length(candidate)=40 &,
     verify(candidate,'0123456789ABCDEF')=0 then do
   treecount=treecount+1
   treeoid=candidate
  end
 end
 if commitout.i='M175 PACK INFO PASS' then,
  commitpass=commitpass+1
end
if treecount\=1 | commitpass\=1 then do
 'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: requested commit metadata is invalid'
 exit 8
end

/* Refuse a stage that does not contain a complete checkout closure. */
drop closure.
closure.0=0
'PIPE CMS GITPTRE WALK' treeoid '| STEM CLOSURE.'
crc=rc
if crc\=0 then do
 'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: requested commit closure is incomplete'
 exit 8
end
cpass=0
do i=1 to closure.0
 if closure.i='M176 TREE CLOSURE PASS' then cpass=cpass+1
end
if cpass\=1 then do
 'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 exit 8
end
'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'

/* Check the bounded index header before the native batch loader. */
'EXECIO 1 DISKR' index 'INDEX' datafm '1 (STEM IDX. FINIS'
if rc\=0 | idx.0\=1 then do
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 exit 8
end
parse var idx.1 itag total unique extra
if words(idx.1)\=3 | itag\='PIDX1' |,
   datatype(total,'W')\=1 | datatype(unique,'W')\=1 |,
   unique<1 | unique>objectcount then do
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: invalid index header'
 exit 8
end
installed=0
already=0
skipped=0
'FILEDEF IDXIN DISK' index 'INDEX' datafm
if rc\=0 then do
 'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
 exit 8
end
drop loaded.
loaded.0=0
say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: installing' objectcount 'objects as CMS loose objects ...'
pipecmd='PIPE (ENDCHAR ?) CMS M274L5 BATCH' datafm objectcount
pipecmd=pipecmd||' | A: FANOUT | STEM LOADED. ? A: | CONSOLE'
pipecmd
lrc=rc
'FILEDEF IDXIN CLEAR'
icrc=rc
'FILEDEF STGIN CLEAR'
scrc=rc
if lrc\=0 | icrc\=0 | scrc\=0 then do
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: batch object install failed' lrc icrc scrc
 exit 8
end
lpass=0
batchprocessed=''
batchunique=''
do li=1 to loaded.0
 if word(loaded.li,1)='PACKOBJ' &,
    word(loaded.li,2)='BATCH' &,
    word(loaded.li,3)='PASS' & words(loaded.li)=13 then do
  lpass=lpass+1
  installed=word(loaded.li,5)
  already=word(loaded.li,7)
  skipped=word(loaded.li,9)
  batchprocessed=word(loaded.li,11)
  batchunique=word(loaded.li,13)
 end
end
if lpass\=1 | batchprocessed\=unique | batchunique\=unique |,
   datatype(installed,'W')\=1 | datatype(already,'W')\=1 |,
   datatype(skipped,'W')\=1 |,
   installed+already+skipped\=unique then do
 say 'FETCH-ACTIVATE: batch install summary mismatch'
 exit 8
end
say 'FETCH OBJECTS ACTIVE' installed 'INSTALLED' already 'ALREADY VERIFIED',
    skipped 'TAGS SKIPPED INDEX' index 'DISK' datafm 'COMMIT' wanted
exit 0

validfn:
 parse arg value
 if value='' | length(value)>8 then return 0
 if verify(left(value,1),'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ@$#')\=0 then,
  return 0
 if verify(value,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789@$#')\=0 then,
  return 0
 return 1

 'COPYFILE GITWORK REPO A GITWRK0 REPO A'

end
wk.1='WORK1 0'

wk.0=2
'EXECIO 2 DISKW GITWORK REPO A 1 (STEM WK. FINIS'
